izzyondroid:com.fixupxer.name: FixupXer - URL Enhancer
izzyondroid:com.fixupxer.summary: Clean tracking, choose link frontends, and spot sensitive data in URLs
izzyondroid:com.fixupxer.description:
FixupXer removes tracking from URLs before you copy, share, or open them. Processing runs entirely on your device, with no ads, account, analytics, or Android permissions.
 Clean and improve links 
 Remove known tracking parameters from YouTube, Instagram, X, TikTok, Facebook, Amazon, Google, Reddit, and many other services. A universal cleaner covers other websites.
 Keep unknown and functional parameters by default. Instagram post/Reel links keep a valid carousel image selector; individual Story permalinks lose query parameters and fragments. Complete X post links remove changing share tags while retaining supported options and media path selection.
 Unwrap supported redirect links entirely offline.
 Optionally convert links to embed-friendly frontends for chat previews or readers that can display public content without an account. Choose built-in options or add custom domains in Settings.
 Use it your way 
 Share a URL to FixupXer, paste it into the app, or select text and choose "Clean link" where the source app supports it.
 Choose the next action: open in an app or browser, share, or copy.
 Shared links show the result by default. Opt in to Skip result screen & share to go straight to Android's share menu with the cleaned link; choose the recipient yourself. Link Guard warnings, incomplete processing or errors stay for review.
 Optional Auto-copy shared links starts off. It copies before the sharesheet when both options are on, and pauses for Link Guard findings or incomplete processing.
 Enable Browser Mode in Settings and select FixupXer as Android's default browser to process eligible links automatically. Verified App Links may bypass it.
 Keep Browser frontend choices separate from Main/Share choices. Remember a preferred browser or an app choice for a website host.
 Native actions restore supported X, Instagram, and TikTok embed links to the original platform. Browser, Share, and Copy keep the processed URL; failed actions offer Retry.
 Private Link Guard 
 Get an offline warning when a link still contains credentials, email addresses, auth tokens, or precise coordinates. Review the finding before sharing. Remove a flagged query parameter when available, or go back. Sensitive originals stay out of history and cache; fully cleaned results may be saved as redacted entries when History is on. The guard cannot detect every private value.
 Custom rules and local controls 
 Create optional rules for hosts or URL patterns, with ordered processing phases, templates, and Teach-from-example drafts.
 Preview changes in Test Lab, save per-rule test cases, and import or export rule bundles. Custom rules start disabled.
 Use optional local history with Undo, manual settings and rule backups, and System, Light, or Dark themes.
 Open online Help for setup, examples, and troubleshooting.
 Privacy and third-party services 
 FixupXer makes no network requests. Opening or sharing a result hands it to another app or service with its own privacy policy. Optional frontends are independently operated and may change or stop working; conversion can be disabled.
 Free and open source under GPL-3.0-or-later.
 Visit the official website or the getting started guide .

izzyondroid:in.basulabs.shakealarmclock.summary: Dismiss the alarm by simply shaking your phone!
izzyondroid:in.basulabs.shakealarmclock.description:
Tired of pressing the power button/swiping the screen every time an alarm rings? No worries! With this app, you can simply shake your phone and dismiss the alarm.

 Works offline.
 No advertisements.
 Completely open-source app.
 Alarms are unique by alarm time. This means that you cannot have two alarms at the same time, even if they are on different dates.

fdroid:app.getknit.knit.name: Knit
fdroid:app.getknit.knit.summary: Encrypted mesh chat over Wi-Fi Aware & Bluetooth — no internet, no servers.
fdroid:app.getknit.knit.description:
Knit is an end-to-end encrypted messenger that runs on the phones themselves, with no account to make and no server in the middle. Phones connect directly over Wi-Fi Aware and Bluetooth, and nearby phones pass each message along, so it can cross a crowd, a building or a campsite far beyond your own range.
PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• A fresh install makes no network calls, so no server learns who you talk to, when, or from where. Anything that uses the internet stays off until you turn it on.
• There's no account, phone number or email. You add people by QR code or by link.
• Knit has no ads, analytics or tracking, and doesn't use Google Play Services.
• A crash report stays on your phone until you read it and decide to send it.
END-TO-END ENCRYPTED
Direct messages and group chats are end-to-end encrypted with forward secrecy, and so are delivery receipts and reactions. Every phone and relay that carries a message sees only ciphertext. Keys are made on your phone and held in Android's hardware-backed keystore, and a safety number or QR scan confirms who you're talking to. Links between phones on current versions are encrypted as well, so a radio nearby can't read what passes between them.
The public Nearby room is the one exception. It has no fixed set of recipients, so it isn't encrypted, and it never leaves the radio mesh.
RELAYS YOU CHOOSE, OR RUN YOURSELF
To reach a contact who is never in radio range, turn on Internet relays. Knit leaves a sealed copy on a relay, which hands it over when their phone next connects. Before anything is sent, a one-time consent sheet sets out the trade: a relay sees your IP address, when you send and roughly how much. It never sees your messages or photos, who you're talking to, or who else is in a group. Turn relays off and uploads stop at once, and sealed copies already on a relay expire within 48 hours.
Use any relay, or run knit-spool (AGPL-3.0-or-later), the software behind Knit's own relay, and hand it out as an invite link. Calls can go through a TURN server so the person you call never sees your IP address; the server itself sees both.
OFF THE GRID
• Messages wait on the phones carrying them until the person is back in range
• Voice calls phone to phone, and walkie-talkie calls that hop across the mesh
• Big files go phone to phone over Wi-Fi, with no network around
• Install offline hands Knit to a nearby phone, no store or internet needed
• Pair an optional Meshtastic LoRa radio and direct messages and the Nearby room reach kilometres instead of metres
PERFECT FOR
• Power cuts and emergencies when networks fail
• The backcountry, ships, flights and travel abroad
• Festivals and crowded venues where signal dies
FREE SOFTWARE, BUILT REPRODUCIBLY
Knit is GPL-3.0-or-later. F-Droid builds it from source and compares the result byte for byte with the developer's signed APK before it ships that APK, so the app you install is the code at github.com/getknit/knit.
ALSO IN KNIT
• Quoted replies, emoji reactions, @-mentions and text formatting
• Photos, GIFs, short videos, voice notes and files of any type
• On-device translation, and English speech to text, after a one-time model download
• Search, and an encrypted backup for a new phone
• On-device content filtering, blurred sensitive images and one-tap blocking
• Material You dynamic colors and dark mode
ABOUT THE PERMISSIONS
Nearby devices (location before Android 13) lets Android find peers over Wi-Fi Aware and Bluetooth LE and reach a paired radio. Location itself is read only when you tap Send location. INTERNET is declared because Android counts the local Wi-Fi Aware socket as network access, and because relays, link previews and model downloads use it once you turn them on.
Knit is funded by its supporters: github.com/sponsors/getknit, ko-fi.com/knit. Liberapay.com/zaventh supports its developer alone.
Requires Android 10 or newer, and works best when allowed to run in the background.

fdroid:com.ashkanrafiee.librecontactsbac.name: Libre Contacts Backup
fdroid:com.ashkanrafiee.librecontactsbac.summary: Offline contact backups with optional encryption
fdroid:com.ashkanrafiee.librecontactsbac.description:
Libre Contacts Backup is a FLOSS native Android app for private, local-first contact backups. No account, no tracking, and no automatic uploads — your contacts stay on your device unless you choose to move a backup file, export data, or share a report.
Features:
* Lossless backup preserving the full Contact → RawContact → Data hierarchy, including contact groups
* SIM card phonebook captured on a best-effort basis when the device exposes it; if it cannot be read, the backup reports that it contains device contacts only. On restore, SIM contacts can be written back to the SIM card, into the device address book, or both
* Scheduled local backups at a time you choose — daily, weekly on a selected weekday, or monthly on a selected day (if a month is shorter than that day, it runs on the month's last day) — with no internet connection required
* Single-file LCB archives containing canonical JSON, VCF, CSV, and normalized exports
* Optional AES-256-GCM password-protected encryption (Android Keystore backed)
* Restore consolidates each source contact correctly, without merging different people who share a name
* Manual CSV and vCard exports, and the CSV opens in Excel and other spreadsheet apps
* Retention by age — keep the newest backups per day, week, and month with counts you choose (for example 7 daily, 4 weekly, 3 monthly), so the recent past stays densely backed up while older history thins out — or simply keep the last N sets
* Choose the app language and system, light, or dark theme from the Display menu
* Create a problem report from About and choose whether to include technical diagnostics before sharing it with an email or sharing app
Libre Contacts Backup is free and open source. If you find it useful, you can support its development — see the donation options in the project README: https://librecontactsbackup.ashkanrafiee.com/#donate

fdroid:com.ath0.rpn.name: RPN
fdroid:com.ath0.rpn.description:
Simple fixed-point decimal arithmetic, Reverse Polish Notation calculator. RPN
calculators may be in the minority but they are easy to learn and very
efficient. The idea is that the operator follows the operands, so that instead
of typing 2 + 2 =, one types 2 enter 2 enter +. The left arrow either deletes
the last digit or drops the last item from the stack. The up arrow show a few
other functions such as setting the number of decimal points, swapping items on
the stack and the use of exponents.

fdroid:com.blazify.music.name: Blazify
fdroid:com.blazify.music.summary: Stream millions of songs with synced lyrics, an equalizer and offline downloads
fdroid:com.blazify.music.description:
Blazify is a music player for Android devices, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It streams from YouTube Music as you want, keeps what you want for offline listening when you do not have internet, and follows the words as they are sung, with no ads, no disturbance and no account required. You can sign in with Google for better song recommendations if you want to, and there is no tracking. Every service it talks to is listed under Privacy.
 Listening 
* Millions of songs, searched by name or found by browsing: songs, albums, artists, playlists and videos
* Gapless playback, with the next track prepared ahead
* Download anything for offline listening, or let it keep songs as you play them
* Play the music already on your phone, beside everything else, in the same queue and the same player
* A queue that you can reorder by dragging, save as a playlist, or start a radio from
* Sleep timer, with an end-of-track option
* Don't play this song: keep a song out of queues, radio and suggestions
* Double-tap to seek on every player, and podcasts that keep their own speed
* A Quick Settings play/pause tile, and shortcuts for Liked, Downloads and Shuffle
* Save data on mobile networks, and download only on Wi-Fi
 Sound 
* Ten-band equalizer with a live frequency-response curve and 13 presets
* Preamp control, each preset pre-compensated so boosts never clip
* Bass boost, surround and reverb
* Volume levelling between songs
* Skip silence, playback speed and pitch
 Lyrics 
* Time-synced lyrics with word-by-word highlighting
* Several sources, asked in an order you choose
* Translation and romanisation
* A full-screen view, and lyric cards you can share as an image
 Look and feel 
* Material 3 with Material You dynamic colour
* Colour taken from the album artwork, accent only or the whole screen
* Several player designs to choose between, with a live preview while you pick
* Light, dark, pure-black, or whatever the system is doing
 Library and sharing 
* Liked songs, listening history, your own playlists and a Top 50 built from what you actually play
* Listen Together: share a room code and play in sync with friends
* Playlist import from a file or a link
* last.fm scrobbling and Discord presence, both optional and with your own credentials
* Music recognition: hold up your phone and name what is playing
* Android Auto and home-screen widgets
* Back up your whole library to a single file and restore it on another device
 Privacy 
Blazify has no advertising, no analytics and no tracking libraries of any kind. Signing in is entirely optional. Everything except your personal YouTube Music library works signed out.
It talks to YouTube Music and Google's video servers; to PipePipe's decoder (api.pipepipe.dev), which gets only YouTube's player version and the scrambled stream values; to Blazify's own repository for a table of player settings (raw.githubusercontent.com, cdn.jsdelivr.net); and to lyrics providers for the song playing. Anything else only when you turn it on, such as the Japanese reading dictionary for romanized Japanese lyrics, which is downloaded once from Maven Central (repo1.maven.org) only after you agree to it.
One thing worth stating plainly, because it is the only time the app sends anything about your own files anywhere: when you scan the music on your phone, any track whose file carries no cover art has its title looked up online so a picture can be found. Files that already have artwork are never sent. It can be turned off, and turning it off only costs you the missing covers.
 Free software 
Blazify is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Its streaming core builds on the work of the InnerTune, OuterTune and Metrolist projects, all GPL-3.0; the interface, theming, branding and feature work are original. See the NOTICE file in the source repository.
Blazify is not affiliated with, funded, authorised or endorsed by YouTube, Google LLC, or any of their aff

fdroid:com.vermont.possin.name: Lucky Cat Terminal (LCTerm)
fdroid:com.vermont.possin.summary: Lucky Cat Terminal (LCTerm), an open-source crypto POS for merchants
fdroid:com.vermont.possin.description:
LCTerm (Lucky Cat Terminal) is a free and open-source Android Point-of-Sale (POS) application designed for merchants to accept and verify cryptocurrency payments.
It works on Android phones and tablets and is also designed for Android point-of-sale devices equipped with thermal receipt printers.
LCTerm supports multiple cryptocurrencies and payment networks, QR code generation, conversion between cryptocurrencies and local currencies using current market rates, transaction verification, and receipt printing.
Supported cryptocurrencies and payment networks include:
* Bitcoin (BTC)
* Lightning Network
* Litecoin (LTC)
* Dogecoin (DOGE)
* Bitcoin Cash (BCH)
* Dash (DASH)
* Ethereum (ETH)
* Tether (USDT - TRON Network)
* Solana (SOL)
* USD Coin (USDC - Solana)
* Monero (XMR)
* Nano (XNO)
LCTerm is not a cryptocurrency wallet and does not hold customer or merchant funds. Instead, it verifies that customer payments are made to addresses or wallets specified and controlled by the merchant.
To use LCTerm, a merchant requires an API key from Vericeive.com.
Some functionality relies on the DogPay API, a non-free network service.
LCTerm is developed by Vermont Secure Computing and released as open-source software under the Apache License 2.0.

The app calculates real hourly wage, current Bitcoin value, inflation-adjusted goal progress, work time stored, time efficiency, the BTC price needed for freedom today, projected age, a projected freedom date, a compounding expense calculator, a home screen widget, and a comparison chart against S and P 500, Nasdaq-100, and gold CAGR assumptions.
WageBit does not use network access, analytics, ads, or trackers. All values are entered by the user and stored locally on the device.

fdroid:io.github.thezupzup.linthra.name: Linthra: Offline Music Player
fdroid:io.github.thezupzup.linthra.summary: Linthra: Open-source offline music player for local and self-hosted music.
fdroid:io.github.thezupzup.linthra.description:
Linthra is an open-source, offline-first music player for Android. Play the
music stored on your device without an internet connection or a Linthra
account. Optionally connect to your own Jellyfin, Navidrome / Subsonic, or
Plex server to browse and stream your personal music library.
Linthra is an independent community client and is not affiliated with
Jellyfin, Navidrome, Subsonic, or Plex.
What Linthra offers:
* Local music playback: select a music folder or use the optional
 "All music on this device" library, with support for common audio formats
 including MP3 and FLAC.
* Browse songs, albums, and artists; search your library and use playlists,
 favourites, queue / Up Next, shuffle, and repeat.
* Connect to self-hosted music servers when you want to stream your own
 collection, including over HTTPS.
* Download selected tracks for offline listening with a configurable cache.
* Background playback with notification, lock-screen, Bluetooth, headset,
 and Android Auto media controls.
* Album artwork, synced lyrics where available, and optional Chromecast

fdroid:org.rubenpgrady.dpcopycat.name: Dumpsys Packages Copycat
fdroid:org.rubenpgrady.dpcopycat.summary: Provides a detailed summary of all installed packages
fdroid:org.rubenpgrady.dpcopycat.description:
With the introduction of the QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission , as far as I understand, it became impossible to use built-in tools to list and inspect installed packages. (Please let me know if you are aware of another workaround.)
That is, of course, assuming you don't have access to root privileges. However, you might not desire to root your phone, either because it can turn out to be quite difficult to achieve, or because it has numerous disadvantages in itself, anyway.
Another option is to connect to the phone via Android Debug Bridge (ADB) and run:
 adb shell dumpsys | sed -n '/^Packages:/,/^[[:space:]]*$/p' 
The command prints the "Packages" section from dumpsys , which contains detailed information about every installed package. It works, but the downside is obvious: You need an extra device to connect and run adb .
This app strives to reproduce the output from above command, right on your phone - neither root privileges nor ADB required - using only API calls and the QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission.

fdroid:org.y20k.position.name: Position - Private Location Sharing
fdroid:org.y20k.position.summary: Ask a trusted contact for their location; their phone answers by encrypted SMS
fdroid:org.y20k.position.description:
Position lets people who trust each other ask for each other's location. You send a request to a contact; their phone answers automatically with a single encrypted SMS that carries one location fix. The location arrives as a notification; from there it opens in the map app of your choice.
Position is free software. It is published under the MIT open-source license.
 HOW IT WORKS 
 A phone looks up its location only when a request arrives. Between requests Position does nothing and uses no battery.
 Two people pair in person by scanning each other's QR code. Only paired contacts can send requests, and every request and answer is end-to-end encrypted.
 You decide per contact whether requests are answered automatically, for a limited time, or not at all.
 Every answered request shows a "location sent" notification and is kept in a per-contact history. If those notifications are blocked, Position stops answering automatically.
 Position works without mobile data. SMS and GPS are enough.
 A WORD ON PRIVACY 
Position has no servers and no accounts. The two phones talk to each other directly over SMS. Your mobile carrier can see that two numbers exchanged text messages, but not what they contain. Position has no tracking and no analytics, and it does not use Google Play Services.
Position needs permission to send and receive SMS and to access your location, also in the background. Without background access it could not answer a request while you are not using the phone. Each request and each answer is a regular SMS and is billed by your carrier as such, including when roaming.

flathub:com.cinecred.cinecred.name: Cinecred
flathub:com.cinecred.cinecred.summary: Create beautiful film credits without the pain
flathub:com.cinecred.cinecred.description:
If you’ve ever put together end credits for a film, you know they are laborious to assemble and a pain to get right. Altering the layout, font size, or spacing after the fact is incredibly time-consuming. And don’t even think about hitting an exact runtime requirement while circumnavigating the shimmer trap.
 But there is a better way: Cinecred, a free and open source program to create credits without the pain. Cinecred reads your credits data from an Excel, LibreOffice, Google, or Nextcloud spreadsheet, and then lets you interactively arrange and style the credits in any way you like. There’s a default template that gets you off the ground quickly, but everything can be customized down to the pixel. Use your own fonts or insert logos, pictures, or even videos. And once you’re done, check the scroll in the integrated player, before exporting it in a plethora of video and image sequence formats.

 It is possible allow/disable playing beep

 Use keyboard shortcuts for start, pause or stop timer and reset timer values

flathub:com.mediahuman.LyricsFinder.name: Lyrics Finder
flathub:com.mediahuman.LyricsFinder.description:
MediaHuman Lyrics Finder is a free application that finds and adds missing
 lyrics to all songs in your music library. The found lyrics are automatically
 saved to files. It's a safe operation — the application will not overwrite
 the lyrics you already have.
 Very easy to use: just drag and drop some tracks from your favorite music
 player and Lyrics Finder will do the rest. The found lyrics will be saved
 automatically.
 Lyrics are collected from various sources on the Internet including
 LRCLIB, Musixmatch, AZLyrics, Bandcamp and others.
 Features:
 Batch processing of entire music folders
 Multiple lyrics providers with automatic fallback
 Synchronized lyrics (LRC) support
 Tag correction via Last.fm
 Supports MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A, WMA and other popular formats

flathub:page.codeberg.yeldham.Librerama.name: Librerama
flathub:page.codeberg.yeldham.Librerama.summary: A free/libre collection of fast-paced mini-games
flathub:page.codeberg.yeldham.Librerama.description:
Librerama is an arcade compilation of very small, fast-paced mini-games (nicknamed "nanogames"), with the main objective being to rack up the highest score possible by winning the most nanogames you can before getting a game over, while they progressively increase in both speed and difficulty.
 While the game itself comes with its own collection of nanogames, custom ones can also be made and played.
 This game is a work-in-progress! Which means that a lot of things are missing, and what is present can change at any moment.

flathub:se.manyver.Manyverse.name: Manyverse Desktop
flathub:se.manyver.Manyverse.description:
Manyverse is a decentralized social network. Unlike most social networks today,
 it is not run by a company which has power over the communications between users.
 The developers of Manyverse can control the source code to build the app and ship
 new features, but they have no access to user data. The user has complete ownership
 and responsibility over their data.
 The primary goal of this project is to make social networking independent of internet
 connectivity. Hence the slogan "off the grid". This quality is essential for populations
 disconnected from the internet (such as in Africa and Latin America) who want to benefit
 from modern social networking to communicate in their communities.
 The secondary goal of this project is to make social networking a neutral public utility
 for people of all kinds. Neutrality requires this project to be non-commercial, so that
 profit seeking never interferes with communications between its users, even in the long run.
 Neutrality also requires that the software developers have no access to and no liability for
 user content, to create an unbiased environment. Like the internet and the web are decentralized
 protocols, their inventors are also not liable for content on the web, and thus the web
 is a more neutral space than proprietary social medias such as Twitter or LinkedIn.
 Underneath, Manyverse uses the Secure Scuttlebutt protocol, also known as SSB. This protocol
 is somewhat like HTTP or RSS, in the sense that it describes how different apps can communicate
 with each other over the internet or over other networking channels such as Bluetooth.
 There are other SSB apps which Manyverse can interoperate with, such as Patchwork,
 Patchbay, Patchfox, and others.

Next-Generation sequencing machines usually produce FASTA or FASTQ files, containing multiple short-reads sequences (possibly with quality information). The main processing of such FASTA/FASTQ files is mapping (aka aligning) the sequences to reference genomes or other databases using specialized programs. Example of such mapping programs are: Blat, SHRiMP, LastZ, MAQ and many many others. However, It is sometimes more productive to preprocess the FASTA/FASTQ files before mapping the sequences to the genome - manipulating the sequences to produce better mapping results. The FASTX-Toolkit tools perform some of these preprocessing tasks.

firefox-addons:2692047.name: Passwall - Free Password Manager
firefox-addons:2692047.summary: Passwall is the easiest and safest way to store all of your logins and passwords.
firefox-addons:2692047.description:
Passwall is an open source password manager.
All the logins and passwords you add to the Passwall Extension are securely stored by the Passwall Server, which is also an open source project. 
Passwall allows you to securely store your logins and passwords in the following categories:
1. Logins
2. Emails
3. Credit Cards
4. Bank Accounts
5. Private Notes
6. Servers
Passwall has a 4 layered encryption architecture.
Layer 1: A secure hash (master hash) is generated from your master password.
Layer 2: All your logins and passwords are encrypted on the client side with master hash. This ensures that passwords can only be decrypted by you.
Layer 3: With end-to-end encryption feature, all data sent from the client to the server is also encrypted during the transportation.
Layer 4: Finally your passwords are also encrypted with server hash just before saving them to the database.
Passwall is an open source software. The source code for Passwall is hosted on GitHub and everyone is free to review, audit, and contribute to the Passwall codebase.

firefox-addons:838382.name: Tap To Tab
firefox-addons:838382.summary: Double click (or finger tap twice) on any link to open it into a new Tab. Designed for tablets and laptop trackpads, which don't have two buttons on their mouse.
firefox-addons:838382.description:
Designed specifically for touch-screen tablets and laptops with trackpads (as those devices don't have mouses with two buttons) you can now double-click on any link to open it in a new tab.
This extension works similar to the "open link in new tab" option in the browser's popup menu. But this extension is faster, because performing the right-click action without an external mouse is much slower.
You can configure in the settings window to:
 show the newly opened tab; or open new tab in background
 Put new tab next to current tab; or put at the end of the tab strip
 Add any domain name into a blacklist
No longer will you have to hold down the button and wait for the popup menu, or perform complex mouse gestures to accomplish this seemingly common action.
Permissions disclosure:
This extension needs your browsers permission to "Access your data for all websites" because it needs to listen to websites to detect your double-click action.
Please also try my other related extension, Joystick for tablets.

See also the bug 1394304 - Support always open urlbar result in a new tab .
----
Opens new tabs from the location bar, by conditions. This provides only following features:

 * Open new tab as a "child" of the current tab if the URI is a part of the website you are browsing in the current tab.

bluejetty:00026898:ios.name: AT&T Secure Family® Parent
bluejetty:00026898:ios.summary: AT&T Secure Family® is a device locator & parental controls app to help parents or guardians stay connected to their family members by offering real-time device location tracking with safety alerts, insights into driving activity, screen ti
bluejetty:00026898:ios.description:
AT&T Secure Family® is a device locator & parental controls app to help parents or guardians stay connected to their family members by offering real-time device location tracking with safety alerts, insights into driving activity, screen time control, manage content access, and website & app usage tracking, all in one place. Secure Family is for every family, regardless of your mobile provider.
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR FAMILY’S DEVICES
* Locate devices in real-time on the family map and view location history
* Get notifications when your family member’s device arrives at or leaves important places, like school or home
* Set scheduled check-ins to stay informed about your family member’s routine
* Use breadcrumb map to see a simple path view of a family member’s recent location activity
* Get notified when a family member’s device has arrived safely at their destination
DRIVING INSIGHTS
*Explore a complete summary of each trip with distance, duration, route, timeline, and a breakdown of driving activity
*Get insights into trips even when your family member is a passenger, building awareness across every ride
*Be notified when a potential crash is detected
*See a simple score for each drive that reflects key driving patterns
MANAGE YOUR CHILD’S SCREEN TIME
* Parental controls to manage apps and website content access with age range filters
* Pause internet access instantly
* Set time limits for access to your child’s favorite apps to control screen time.
* Track web and app usage on your child devices
FAMILY SAFETY AND REWARDS
* Parents can give their child extra screen time as a reward for good behavior
* Family members can send an emergency alert to everyone with the press of a button
* Support your child’s digital journey with expert-created content designed to promote safe online habits
* Dual parent or guardian admin feature supports co-parenting needs
Legal Disclaimers
The AT&T Secure Family service is free for the first 30 days. After the first 30 days, you will be automatically billed $12 each month (includes support for up to 10 family members and up to 30 devices in total). Service auto renews every 30 days unless cancelled.  To use the AT&T Secure Family service, you must download two Apps: the AT&T Secure Family App (adults, parents or guardians) and the AT&T Secure Family Companion App (family member). Visit att.com/securefamily for details.
Install the Companion App on your child’s device and pair it with the Parent App on your device. Pairing is required to access all features. Only authorized app users have permission to use the App to locate a family member’s device. Requires iOS v.17+ or higher.
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can reduce battery life. Availability, timeliness, or accuracy of location is not guaranteed. Coverage not available in all areas. 
There is a compatibility conflict that can prevent the addition of AT&T Secure Family Companion App to your child’s companion device if you have AT&T ActiveArmor Advanced Mobile Security running on the same companion device.  If you wish to continue with the purchase, you must downgrade to the FREE version of AT&T ActiveArmor Mobile Security on the companion device before adding AT&T Secure Family Companion App.
AT&T Secure Family FAQs: https://att.com/securefamilyguides 
The collection, use, and disclosure of any personal information through this application is governed by AT&T's Privacy Policy found at: att.com/privacypolicy and the App’s End User License Agreement found at att.com/legal/terms.secureFamilyEULA.html. 
* AT&T Postpaid Wireless customers:
View, modify or cancel service anytime within the Secure Family app.
AT&T does not provide credits or refunds for partial months.
* AT&T PREPAID wireless customers and all other mobile networks billed by the App Store:
See Apple’s polices regarding cancellation in the App Store at https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

bluejetty:00013702:ios.description:
The Russian Bible has a long history that began with efforts to make the Holy Scriptures available in the Russian language. Early translations were influenced by Church Slavonic, which was widely used in religious worship and literature. Over time, scholars worked to create translations that were easier for common people to understand while remaining faithful to the original texts.
One of the most well-known translations is the Synodal Bible, published in the 19th century and still widely used today. The Russian Bible plays an important role in the spiritual, cultural, and literary life of Russia. It continues to be used in churches, homes, and personal study, helping generations stay connected to their faith and traditions.

Daily Verse: Set reminders for daily Bible verse notifications.

Then, a fearless magician appeared before the king, and offered help. But it wasn't going to be easy!

Will the town be restored to its former glory? It's up to you, young mage!

bluejetty:00062141:ios.name: Dino puzzle & games for kids
bluejetty:00062141:ios.summary: Looking for a game that actually keeps your toddler busy AND learning something? Yeah, us too. That's why we packed 32 dinosaur mini games into one app — puzzles, racing, logic, coloring, emotions, routines and a whole lot more. All designe
bluejetty:00062141:ios.description:
Looking for a game that actually keeps your toddler busy AND learning something? Yeah, us too. That's why we packed 32 dinosaur mini games into one app — puzzles, racing, logic, coloring, emotions, routines and a whole lot more. All designed for little hands aged 2 to 5.
No reading needed. No complicated menus. Your kid taps, plays, and learns. Simple as that.
Here's what's inside:
PUZZLES & LOGIC
Classic puzzles where the dino breaks into pieces and your child puts it back together — and then it animates! We also have jigsaw puzzles, shadow matching (place the right dino in its shadow), slide logic puzzles with a 3x3 grid, symmetry challenges, and a "what comes next" pattern game. Plenty to keep those little brains working.
CREATIVE & FUN ACTIVITIES
Color by number with dinosaurs, dino washing & cleaning (kids absolutely love this one), and a dig for bones activity where your toddler uncovers bones and builds a dino. These are the kind of games where they don't even realize they're learning.
LEARNING GAMES
This is where it gets really good. We've got a dino coding basics game — yes, coding for toddlers — where they figure out which direction the dino moves on a lily pad grid using arrows. There's color sorting logic with mushrooms, a memory card game, and a matching game where kids identify which part belongs to which dinosaur.
EMOTIONS & DAILY ROUTINES (NEW!)
Dino faces show different emotions and your child picks the right one when the mother dino names it. Great for emotional learning. We also added a 4-step routine game with 20 themes like bedtime, morning routine etc. — your kid puts the steps in order (brush teeth, wear pyjamas, read a story, switch off lights). All with pronunciation so they hear the words too.
SHAPES & WEATHER (NEW!)
Shape matching with increasing difficulty — shadows, rotations, halves — while a dino rides a bicycle across the screen. Plus a weather dress-up game where kids hear "Its raining! Lets dress up the dino" and pick the right clothes and accessories. 5 different weather sets inside.
RACING & ACTION GAMES
4 different dino car racing scenes, a lane racing game with AI opponents, dino bounce (pop bubbles and collect fruits), dino swim through pipes, a dino run endless runner, dino fly on a tree branch, circus ring jumping, flower grid jumping to avoid crocodiles, an egg stacking obstacle game, a planet jumping game with rotating planets, dino baby care (don't wake the baby!), and a food duel game against the computer.
Yeah… there's a LOT in here. 32 games and we keep adding more.
We built this for our own kids first and then thought — why not share it. Every game is designed so a 2 year old can figure it out on their own but a 5 year old still finds it fun. No text heavy instructions. No frustrating difficulty spikes. Just tap and play.
Perfect for:
Young Children who love dinosaurs and Jurassic World.
Kids aged 2, 3, 4, and 5
Preschool learning at home
Long car rides and waiting rooms
Screen time you don't feel guilty about
Educational skills covered: problem solving, pattern recognition, memory, color learning, shape recognition, emotional intelligence, daily routines, basic coding logic, hand-eye coordination, and sorting.
If your kid likes dinosaur games, puzzle games, or really any toddler learning games — they're going to love this one. Download and let them explore all 32 dino adventures!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

The Spectator's mission is to entertain, inform, delight and infuriate our readers. From politics to culture, current affairs to reviews, a wide range of topics are intelligently commented on daily and in our monthly magazine.
The Spectato
bluejetty:00024927:ios.description:
The Spectator's mission is to entertain, inform, delight and infuriate our readers. From politics to culture, current affairs to reviews, a wide range of topics are intelligently commented on daily and in our monthly magazine.
The Spectator was established in 1828 in Britain. In 2018, after a mere 190 years, we launched our US edition, with the goal of bringing the same insight, original thought and writing to an American audience. 
We hold no party line; our only allegiance is to clarity of thought, elegance of expression and independence of opinion. Our writers opinions range from left to right, their circumstances vary. We do not strive for impartiality — our motto is ‘firm, but unfair’ — but for originality and style.
"At last Britain’s foremost periodical, first published 1828, brings the English language to America. Here is the native tongue of wit, learning, and sense — wise rather than wised-up, clever but not too clever by half, and humorous in a way that answers to every humor including blood, phlegm, and bile of diverse colors. Civilized reading for barbarous times."
-P.J. O'Rourke on The Spectator
"You can go to hell—you and your irrelevant rag."
-Sebastian Gorka
Features
-The Spectator's US edition app is free to download. 
-Read every issue monthly before it goes on sale.
-Download the magazine and read it offline or on the move.
-Listen to Spectator podcasts.
-Share articles via email, Facebook and Twitter.
-Store and access your back issues or store individual articles in your person scrapbook.
"A fantastic magazine."
-Tucker Carlson
"The Spectator US is serious without being earnest, lively without being superficial, au courant without being trendy. You owe it to yourself to subscribe."
-Roger Kimball
Terms of Use: https://thespectator.com/terms/

bluejetty:00200142:ios.description:
THE OFFICIAL APP OF BAMBU DEPISTOLA.
BAMBU brings together music, artwork, writing, photography, video and archival material from more than two decades of independent hip-hop and community organizing.
At the center of the app is BASS BUILDING, the latest album from Bambu, presented alongside three previous releases:
SHARPEST TOOL IN THE SHED
IF YOU SEE SOMEONE STEALING FOOD, NO YOU DIDN’T
THEY’RE BURNING THE BOATS
Explore the records with full-album playback, individual track selection and background listening.
Beyond the music, the ARCHIVE collects original album artwork, liner notes, photography, flyers and posters, video, and original writing connected to the ideas and history behind the work.
INSIDE THE APP:
• Four complete Bambu releases
• Full music playback and background listening
• Original BASS BUILDING artwork and liner notes
• Archival photography
• Flyers and posters
• Original writing by Faith Santilla
• Video
• Artist information and official links
• Additional material and continuing releases
BAMBU is an evolving digital archive built around the music, politics, artwork and community that have shaped Bambu’s work.
MANY STRUGGLES. ONE FIGHT.

It uses natural language processing and machine learning techniques to understand and respond to user inquiries in a way that mimics human communication. This technology can be integrated into various platforms such as websites, mobile apps, and messaging services to provide users with quick and efficient assistance. This magical island is full of all kinds of curious and delightful things. The more you explore, the more surprises you’ll discover!

bluejetty:00070555:ios.description:
Start your journey through the Multiplication Games with Jelly!

bluejetty:00120453:ios.description:
Meet and greet the huge Pepi family in Pepi House! Join 10 lovely characters in their day to day life. Create your own scenarios, play, explore and have fun!
Pepi House is a fun and safe educational game for kids about daily life in a household. Pepi House is a digital version of a classical toy — doll house. We designed Pepi House to be as reminiscent to real life toys as possible, but the digital element allowed us to offer something even more.
While playing kids can learn basic home rules, explore daily routines, learn the names and use of different equipment, experiment with various items and discover many new things every day. There are hundreds of items within Pepi House, most of them can be interacted with and some of them can be mixed and matched for awesome results!
As always, we at Pepi Play encourage parents to play together with kids. Tidy up rooms in a fun way, create new house rules in virtual world first and then apply them to your daily life. Talk about activities, broaden your vocabulary, experiment and most importantly have some fun and healthy laughter!
Explore the house by simply checking the environment and interacting with it – fix your family car, do the laundry, dress-up characters or make them a tasty burger! Want even more? Go ahead, use our elevator to move items between the floors, discover new combinations or even prank some of the house dwellers to see their reactions! Pepi House is all about the freedom of making your own choices and learning what you can do with various different items or their combinations.
KEY FEATURES:
• 4 house floors representing different areas of a household.
• 10 different characters (Including favourite pets!).
• Hundreds of items available for play.
• Themed rooms carefully represents real life environment. Each room is filled with various items you’d expect to find in a real house.
• Great animations and sounds.
• Can be played by various methods. PEPI HOUSE is all about the freedom to experiment.
• Use the elevator to move items and characters between different floors.
• No in-app purchases.
• No third-party advertising.
• Recommended age: 3-7.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Subscription terms of use: http://www.pepiplay.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00027099:ios.name: TV Towers USA
bluejetty:00027099:ios.summary: TV Towers USA is a map of digital TV broadcasting towers in the United States and its territories plus a select number of Canadian stations. The database includes over 2000 stations and over 1000 repeaters. My users include avid RVers who r
bluejetty:00027099:ios.description:
TV Towers USA is a map of digital TV broadcasting towers in the United States and its territories plus a select number of Canadian stations. The database includes over 2000 stations and over 1000 repeaters. My users include avid RVers who roam from region to region and need to locate available TV networks, and homeowners setting up a new antenna system. 
Apple Watch (Series 5) users can make use of their compass with the optional in-app purchase of an embedded watch app. 
There is an alternate compass tab which shows the direction of stations within a 45 mile radius—given enough screen space—just look over your phone to see which way to point your antenna.
Pinch to zoom into your locality, or hit the circular location button to concentrate on local stations. If more than 80 stations are in the area being viewed, a random assortment of 80 stations will be displayed.
There is no "phoning home" with data, personal or not. If a data connection is available, the FCC servers will be asked for contour plot data when a tower is selected. This will show up as a blue overlay showing the calculated area over which the signal will drop off by at most 35 dBu. Basically, this is the area where an antenna not too near the ground has a chance to receive the signal; your luck will vary. Once downloaded, the data is stored for the next time you select the tower.
Errors and omissions are to be expected especially for stations with low power licenses. Please e-mail the support address if you find a glaring omission or error; I'll need a call sign and a TV network.

listings.name: TV Towers USA
listings.description:
TV Towers USA is a map of digital TV broadcasting towers in the United States and its territories plus a select number of Canadian stations. The database includes over 2000 stations and over 1000 repeaters. My users include avid RVers who roam from region to region and need to locate available TV networks, and homeowners setting up a new antenna system. 

Apple Watch (Series 5) users can make use of their compass with the optional in-app purchase of an embedded watch app. 
 
There is an alternate compass tab which shows the direction of stations within a 45 mile radius—given enough screen space—just look over your phone to see which way to point your antenna.

Pinch to zoom into your locality, or hit the circular location button to concentrate on local stations. If more than 80 stations are in the area being viewed, a random assortment of 80 stations will be displayed.

There is no "phoning home" with data, personal or not.  If a data connection is available, the FCC servers will be asked for contour plot data when a tower is selected. This will show up as a blue overlay showing the calculated area over which the signal will drop off by at most 35 dBu. Basically, this is the area where an antenna not too near the ground has a chance to receive the signal; your luck will vary. Once downloaded, the data is stored for the next time you select the tower.

Errors and omissions are to be expected especially for stations with low power licenses. Please e-mail the support address if you find a glaring omission or error; I'll need a call sign and a TV network.

※ 這是一個由香燈腳自發組成的「非官方團隊」所開發的 App。
※ 我們沒有大公司的資源，有的只是對媽祖的一片誠心。
※ 我們每年都會盡力提供一個穩定、方便的平台，讓信眾跟相關單位能更順利地參與這場盛事。
以下是我們想跟每位香燈腳交代的心裡話：
● 我們是怎麼定位的？
※ 為了讓大家掌握最準確的「粉紅超跑」位置，我們的團隊夥伴會背著 GPS 設備，用雙腳跟隨在媽祖轎旁。
※ 衛星訊號偶爾會因為天氣、電力或收訊死角產生誤差，定位僅供參考，我們不會承擔責任，但一定會拼盡全力修復。
※ 如果在路上看到這群努力的隊友，千萬不要推擠他們，因為他們真的很辛苦，別忘了給他們一聲鼓勵。
● 珍惜這份回憶
※ App 內完整紀錄了從 2017 年到 2025 年的所有進香移動路線。
※ 這些數據是我們團隊多年來一步一腳印流汗紀錄下來的，所有資訊皆為本團隊所有。
※ 希望大家能尊重這份勞動成果，未經授權，請勿擅自擷取或重複使用。
● 聊天室的約定
我們準備了聊天室與住宿資訊分享區，是為了讓大家在進香路上能互助、報路況。
請大家維持「香燈腳」的修養：
※ 請勿發表違反社會風俗、不雅字眼或人身攻擊。
※ 嚴禁發送惡意連結或廣告。
※ 若被檢舉成功達 5 次，系統會自動將該使用者列入黑名單（黑名單仍可看定位，但無法發言）。
※ 發言過快會被系統鎖定 15 秒，請大家耐心交流，不要洗版。
※ 管理員亦會定時巡邏維持秩序。
● 保護好自己
※ 為了保障個人安全，請絕對不要在 App 中公開您的真實姓名、電話、住址、信用卡號或身分證字號等隱私資料。
※ 系統不需要任何第三方登入，只需要您設定一個暱稱跟大頭照就能互動。
● 位置分享與隱私
※ App 會取得您的位置資訊，目的是為了分析信眾的分佈狀況，讓大家知道哪裡人多。
※ 您可以在手機設定中隨時關閉分享，我們絕對尊重您的隱私。
● 溫馨小叮嚀
※ 地圖路線僅會顯示約 500 個定位點作為參考，實際路徑請以現場為準。
※ 系統目前不會長期保留對話資料，若有重要的資訊請自行截圖備份。
※ 留言字數限制為 100 字，講重點最貼心。
※ 如果您覺得這個 App 讓您在進香路上感受到溫暖與方便，歡迎給予我們「5 顆星星」好評，這就是給我們這群肖年仔最大的鼓勵！也歡迎上臉書搜尋「白沙屯 GPS 定位」粉絲專頁，給我們按個讚。
白沙屯媽祖與山邊媽祖進香，是我們一輩子的信仰。
讓我們在丙午年這條路上，再次作伙來走。

bluejetty:00135665:ios.description:
Tut World:City Life Creator is a delightful DIY puzzle game. With its charming graphics and engaging gameplay,
 this game takes players on an exciting journey through various interactive scenes, including a kindergarten and a playground.
In Tut World:City Life Creator, you can immerse yourself in a world of creativity and problem-solving. 
Customize your own avatar and explore different areas within the town. The game offers a range of educational activities and brain-teasing puzzles that aim to enhance critical thinking, memory skills, and cognitive abilities.
With its user-friendly interface and intuitive controls, Tut World:City Life Creator provides a safe and entertaining environment where you can freely express your imagination. The game promotes independent learning and encourages players to think outside the box while having fun.
Key Features:
Interactive scenes: Explore captivating locations like the kindergarten and the playground.
Exciting puzzles: Solve challenging brain teasers to unlock new levels and achievements.
Educational content: Enhance critical thinking, memory skills, and cognitive abilities.

bluejetty:00033999:ios.description:
Introducing "FPV Strike," an exhilarating combat simulation game is not only immerses players in intense remote-controlled warfare but also enhances their FPV drone control skills with realistic controls and mechanics. Command a variety of drones and quadcopters through adrenaline-pumping missions where your objective is to annihilate enemy vehicles and soldiers.
Dive into different drone and quadcopter modes, each offering distinct strengths and strategic advantages. Whether you favor the swift agility of a quadcopter or the precision strikes of a specialized drone, "FPV Strike" ensures there's a vehicle tailored to your combat style.
Navigate a challenging battlefield teeming with real enemy vehicles determined to bring you down. From heavily armored tanks to swift assault vehicles and relentless infantry units, every encounter tests your reflexes and tactical acumen. AI adversaries adapt to your maneuvers, intensifying the need for strategic planning and split-second decision-making.
Immerse yourself in meticulously crafted environments ranging from urban cityscapes to vast desert landscapes. Each setting enhances the realism and intensity of your missions, demanding expert navigation skills to dodge enemy fire, maneuver through obstacles, and execute precision strikes.
"FPV Strike" not only provides thrilling gameplay but also serves as a training ground for improving FPV drone control skills. Realistic controls and mechanics simulate the challenges of piloting drones in dynamic combat scenarios, offering players a hands-on learning experience that translates to real-world FPV drone proficiency.
With stunning graphics and immersive sound effects, "FPV Strike" delivers a gripping gaming experience that places you at the forefront of advanced drone warfare. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or new to the genre, this game promises hours of thrilling gameplay where skill and strategy determine the outcome.
Download "FPV Strike" today and embark on a high-stakes journey where you must outwit, outmaneuver, and outgun your adversaries to secure victory in the skies while honing your FPV drone control skills.

bluejetty:00163207:ios.summary:
L'essentiel de votre santé, toujours à portée de main.

bluejetty:00163207:ios.description:
L'essentiel de votre santé, toujours à portée de main.
Ne perdez plus jamais une ordonnance, un compte-rendu d'examen ou votre historique de vaccination. Mon espace santé est l’application officielle du Ministère de la Santé et de l’Assurance Maladie pour gérer votre santé et celle de vos enfants en toute sécurité.
Vous avez la main sur votre santé !
 TOUS VOS DOCUMENTS AU MÊME ENDROIT
Fini les dossiers papier égarés. Retrouvez instantanément les documents déposés par vos médecins, laboratoires et hôpitaux :
- Ordonnances et traitements en cours.
- Résultats d'examens (biologie, radios, comptes-rendus).
- Synthèse médicale pour faciliter vos consultations.
- Historique de soins : retrouvez vos rendez-vous et médicaments remboursés sur les 24 derniers mois.
 VOTRE SANTÉ, VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE
Vos données sont hébergées en France dans un environnement sécurisé protégé par l’Assurance Maladie. Vous restez maître de votre confidentialité : vous pouvez masquer les documents de votre choix ou bloquer l’accès à certains professionnels de santé à tout moment.
 UN ACCOMPAGNEMENT PERSONNALISÉ (PRÉVENTION)
Parce que la santé, c'est aussi anticiper, l'application vous aide à prendre soin de vous :
- Agenda de santé : recevez des rappels pour vos rappels de vaccins, dépistages et examens recommandés selon votre profil.
- Conseils officiels : accédez à des articles de prévention fiables (santé mentale, alimentation, sommeil, etc.).
- Profil médical : complétez vos mesures (poids, tension, glycémie) et vos allergies pour une meilleure prise en charge en cas d’urgence.
 POUR TOUTE LA FAMILLE
Gérez la santé de vos enfants directement depuis votre application. Activez leur profil, suivez leur calendrier de vaccination et conservez leurs documents dès la naissance.

bluejetty:00161055:ios.description:
Keep your dhikr going wherever you are. Tap the screen, and Zikirmatik counts for you, just like the prayer beads in your hand.
Set a target for each dhikr and see how far you have come. When you reach it, a gentle Mashallah message lets you know.
COUNT WITHOUT LOSING YOUR PLACE
• One large tap area: count without looking at the screen
• Undo a mistaken tap with one button
• Reset with a confirmation, so nothing is lost by accident
• Click sound and vibration on every count, each can be switched off
YOUR OWN DHIKR LIST
• Add any dhikr with its name, pronunciation and meaning
• Give each one its own target: 33, 99, 100, 1000 or any number
• Every dhikr keeps its own count, so you can switch and come back later
• Salawat is ready to start the moment you open the app
A COUNTER THAT FEELS FAMILIAR
• Realistic mode turns the screen into a classic handheld zikirmatik
• Or use the clean circular counter with a progress ring
• Dark design that is easy on the eyes at night
• Available in 19 languages
FULL ACCESS
Zikirmatik is free to use with ads. Adding a new dhikr is unlocked by watching a short video, or you can get Full Access for an ad-free counter and unlimited dhikrs.
Full Access is an auto-renewing weekly subscription. Eligible new subscribers may start with a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Top Hat makes learning fun and engaging (seriously!) and sets you up for success, helping you connect with your professors, your peers and the content you’re learning in and out of the classroom.
Here’s what Top Hat offers you:
Compelling resources, delivered on your smartphone or laptop:
• Follow your prof’s lecture slides on your own device
• Contribute in class with an easy-to-use response system that’s always with you
• Participate with your profs and peers using in-app discussions
Content tailored to your course:
• Experience dynamic, interactive textbooks loaded up with images, videos, audio clips and more
• Read your digital materials from anywhere and keep them forever
Quizzes, tests and polls that improve learning comprehension:
• Challenge yourself by taking polls and quizzes on your own devices
• Improve your knowledge retention with interactive assessment elements
• Check for gaps in your understanding with graded and non-graded homework and short quizzes
Thanks for using Top Hat. As you experience the app, we’d love to get your feedback: support@tophat.com or follow us on Instagram, Twitter or Facebook @TopHat

bluejetty:00114335:ios.name: Arrow Jam Escape
bluejetty:00114335:ios.summary:
Get ready for a fast-paced and strategic arrow challenge in Arrow Exit Puzzle — an addictive arrow puzzle game built for players who love logic puzzles and intense puzzle escape moments .
Each level is a tricky arrow maze puzzle, also know
bluejetty:00114335:ios.description:
Get ready for a fast-paced and strategic arrow challenge in Arrow Exit Puzzle — an addictive arrow puzzle game built for players who love logic puzzles and intense puzzle escape moments .
Each level is a tricky arrow maze puzzle, also known as an arrow maze escape, where you must carefully study the arrow path puzzle and decide which arrow to tap first. This is not just an arrow game—it’s a true arrow exit puzzle where one correct move can open the way, but one wrong tap can cause a chain reaction. When arrows collide, you lose a heart, turning every move into a tense arrow escape decision.
You only have 3 hearts, so every tap matters. Make three mistakes and the arrow out attempt ends immediately. To win, you must clear all arrows before the timer runs out, creating a thrilling arrow rush that tests your focus and reaction speed. This pressure-filled gameplay makes every level feel like a high-stakes wiggle escape, where you must carefully wiggle out of dangerous arrow traps.
As you progress, the experience evolves into a full arrow maze adventure with twisty arrow layouts, looping paths like an arrow loop, and increasingly complex arrow maze puzzle designs. Some levels feel like an island of arrows or even the mysterious isle of arrows, where every arrowhead points to danger or opportunity. In these tight layouts, mastering wiggle escape mechanics and finding a clever way to wiggle out becomes the key to survival.
The gameplay blends tap arrows gallery mechanics with intuitive swipe arrow controls, challenging you to master advanced arrows puzzle escape techniques. Certain stages introduce movement patterns inspired by wiggle escape, wiggle out, and even worm escape, forcing you to adjust paths on the fly and escape narrow spaces with precision.
This is more than just an arrow game arrow experience—it’s a full arrow fest of strategy, speed, and skill. Whether you’re solving an arrow exit puzzle, navigating an intense arrow maze escape, or racing through a last-second arrow rush, every level pushes your brain further.
Key Features:
• Deep arrow maze puzzle and arrow path puzzle gameplay 
• Strategic arrow escape decisions with real consequences
• 3-heart system that rewards careful planning 
• Timed levels for high-pressure puzzle escape fun 
• Complex layouts inspired by island of arrows and isle of arrows
• Smooth controls with tap and swipe arrow mechanics
• Designed for fans of arrow games, logic puzzles, and tough games
If you enjoy fast-thinking arrow puzzle games, clever arrow exit puzzle design, and challenging arrow maze levels, Arrow Exit Puzzle will keep you hooked from the first tap.
Can you master the arrows, survive the maze, and wiggle out of every trap?
It’s time to think fast, tap smart, and escape.

bluejetty:00011547:android.description:
Indian Police Train Simulator is a realistic transportation train games in which cops have hired a train and converted it into a police train to transport highly dangerous criminal from one city to another city through these train games. The train has to be driven by a expert train driver that is you. This is really a urgent police transportation duty which rests on your shoulder. Complete the exciting and challenging levels and earn high ranks in your department and become the best and most patriotic officer. There are different trains you can choose from. Drive your train and transport culprits from one place to another.
You need to drive really carefully and reach the designated location on time without fail. So hop on for this thrilling classic train game and drive across hundreds of different kinds of twisting turning tracks that will test your skills and ability to the maximum and make you a really great expert.
Unlock all kinds of modern trains like bullet, and subway. Start the engines and sound the horn and try to stop at signal and then check the track on both sides so that you don't crash and cause any mishaps or accidents and lose the train game.
Please feel free to suggest us any improvements that could help us make the game better. Thank You!

bluejetty:00025462:ios.description:
Build and explore your own city in this 3D sequel to the original Pocket City! Create using roads, zones, landmarks, and special buildings. Drop your avatar into the world and roam freely. Buy your own house, host events, survive disasters, and live the life of a successful mayor!
No microtransactions or long wait times, everything is unlocked and rewarded through gameplay!
FEATURES
- Build a unique city by creating zones and new special buildings
- Explore your city by controlling your avatar directly
- Enjoy a dynamic environment with seasons and a day night cycle
- Play minigames like street racing, plane flying, and much more
- Trigger fun events like block parties, or disasters like tornadoes
- Complete quests to earn XP and money
- Customize your avatar with clothing and tools
- Become a homeowner and furnish your own house
- Visit buildings in your city to buy items and find loot
- Invest and build long-term mega projects
- Encounter and help NPCs around your city
- Spend research points to gain valuable perks
- Invite a friend to collaborate on your city in real-time
- Unlock special rewards by competing against rival towns
- Unleash your creative side in Sandbox Mode
- Play in both landscape and portrait mode

Order Pizza online From La Pino'z: Every celebration deserves Monster pizza!
Whenever a pizza craving strikes, do you head to a Nearby Pizza Store?
No need to visit the nearest pizza store, you can use our Online pizza Delivery service Through the La Pino'z pizza delivery app. Our Online Pizza Delivery service is available across India with 600+ Pizza stores.
Save Time by online pizza ordering and enjoy the tastes and toppings of pizza hassle-free
Order your favorite vegetarian or non-vegetarian pizzas directly from the La Pino’z app to fulfill your pizza cravings. With India's top food delivery app, you can order pizza from nearby pizza stores 600+ Outlets across India.
Our kitchen and pizza online delivery team ensures that you enjoy cheese loaded with exciting toppings with the safety checks and measures in place at all times when ordering food online. Along with exceptional pizza, La Pino’z ensures exceptional safety measures.
La Pino’z has a contactless pizza online delivery service that allows you to enjoy your Pizza with complete safety.
We Measure the temperatures of the staff who’s handling your food, from the kitchen to the delivery rider with temperature tracking for the pizza delivery app, you can enjoy your favorite pizza with no ambiguity.
La Pino’z Pizza delivery app brings you standout options with premium toppings like olives, jalapenos, exotic vegetables, mutton keema, and more.
To get started, download the La Pino’z Online Pizza Delivery app from the App Store
Indulge in delightful La Pino’z Pizzas
Explore the extensive menu options and discover innovative and tantalizing dishes. Whether you're seeking something new or classic, you'll find a variety of veg pizzas and non-veg Pizzas to choose from. These include the Margherita pizza with customizable crust and toppings. From chicken wings to Monster pizza, tangy dips to stuffed garlic bread, all these tempting treats are just a click away.
When you're looking for a pizza restaurant to experience mouth-watering Italian cuisine, look no further! Don't forget to explore the diverse menu for delectable side dishes and irresistible desserts. Whether it's a solo treat or a gathering, order the irresistible Chocó Lava Cake!
Convenient Online Food Delivery Services
As people increasingly prefer home comforts, food delivery apps have surged. The Zero Contact Delivery policy provides peace of mind, eliminating concerns about contracting germs or illnesses since you don't have to come into direct contact with the delivery agent.
La Pion'z Online Pizza Delivery App Features:
Personalize your orders by choosing different toppings on a variety of pizza options. From Cheese Burst Pizza to Chicken Wings, English Cheddar to Cheese, a world of flavors awaits!
Order in Advance: Plan ahead for parties or gatherings by placing advance orders using coupons.
Late-night Orders: Satisfy your hunger pangs at any hour of the night.
One-Click Reorder: Loved your previous order? Simply click a button to place the same order again.
Exciting Offers: Enjoy amazing offers available at all times, ensuring affordable meals throughout the week.
Order Tracking: Keep track of your orders effortlessly once they are placed.
Hassle-Free Payments: Convenient online payment options make the checkout process easier.
How to Place an Order:
Search for "pizza near me" or La Pino’z pizza on the App Store.
Download the official La Pino’z Pizza Delivery app.
Log in to your account.
Locate the nearest La Pino’z Pizza Store.
Explore the menu and check for offers.
Keep an eye out for exclusive app-only La Pino’z offers.
Proceed to checkout and provide your address.
Complete the payment process.
Sit back and await the arrival of your delightful box of flavors

bluejetty:00013737:ios.description:
Ancient oracle meets modern device! Deal with life's challenges more meaningfully. Tap into your inner self. Find the translation that speaks to you. Ask questions, use the oracle, manage a journal, and browse multiple book translations.
Ask questions...
* Specify a topic
* Enter a question or phrase
* Toss coins by shaking
* Or manipulate yarrow stalks
* Or toss dice
* Or use Stephen Karcher's Circle of Protectors
* Or navigate Michael Tingle's I Ching Mandala
* Or use the Quick option
* Or use manual input
Manage a journal...
* Multi-line questions & notes
* Sort by topic, hexagram or date
* Search by keyword
* Present, Changes and Future
* Add your own notes
* Switch translations for readings
* Mail journal entries
Browse the book...
* Multiple book translations
* Chinese with Pinyin phonetics
* King Wen Hexagram numbers
* Trigram descriptions
* Component Trigrams
* Ruling Lines
* Related Hexagrams
English translations...
* A Library tab makes it easy to switch books
* "Yi Jing - Book of Transformations" by Brian Arnold, featuring artwork by Elizabeth Nelson
* "A Guide to the I Ching" by Carol K. Anthony (English and German)
* "Yi Jing / Book of Changes" by Gregory C. Richter
* "I Ching Oracle" by Nigel Richmond
Other translations...
* "Language of the Lines", English (Nigel Richmond)
* Original Chinese (two versions)
* "I Ging", German (Wilhelm)
* "Yi Jing", Japanese (Yo Fujiwara)
* "Yi Jing", in French, Spanish, Dutch, Portuguese, Italian, Russian (Arnold)
More books for in-app purchase...
* "The I Ching or Book of Changes" (Book I, II and III) by Richard Wilhelm
* "The Laws of Change" by Jack Balkin
* "The Complete I Ching" by Taoist Master Alfred Huang
Other key features...
* Straightforward and elegant interface
* Option to represent coin heads as Yang
* Option to cast coins using Yarrow stalk probabilities
* Portrait and landscape orientation
* Resources to access help and online I Ching resources

IMPROVE YOUR VOCABULARY

# App Store Editors' Choice
How to turn your mobile into a professional camera in a blink? We did something cool.
Applying advanced computational photography and artificial intelligence algorithms, ReLens can instantly turn your phone into a DSLR professional camera.
With its powerful DSLR-grade large aperture that creates blur background bokeh effect and its 4K Ultra HD camera, ReLens camera portrait mode makes it easy to capture "DSLR-like" and "cinematic" shots. 
ReLens is designed to be a professional camera photography app for mobile photography enthusiasts and to help everyone enjoy the fun of photography easily.
It also lets you beautify and reshape portraits in photos and videos.

bluejetty:00017302:ios.description:
Hello there, crazy bus drivers! Are you all set to drive a city bus? 
Can you handle that responsibility? If yes, then come on! We are going on a city bus 3D driving adventure. You will have the best time of your life while the classic driving of this crazy huge vehicle modern city coach bus! If you think that you can drive a huge city bus then this is the best city bus driving simulator for you.
In this crazy passenger bus simulator, as a bus coach driver you will have to drive the bus passengers to their destinations in due time. You will have to perform your tasks hurriedly or you will run out of time. Failure to complete the tasks in given time will result in level failure and you would have to restart the level from the start and play again.
This amazing city bus simulator is your chance to have the most realistic experience of extreme city bus crazy ultimate driving. You will feel as if your are really sitting in the driving seat. This realistic 3D passenger city bus modern racing simulator will make you feel as if you are actually driving the classic city bus coach. You will be the one in control! So, kick start that engine and let’s go on a city bus driving adventure!
The cool graphics and visuals will make this modern city bus racing experience all the more realistic and adventurous for you. You will feel as if you are in a city bus! You will have to provide pick and drop service to your loyal city bus passengers. This coach bus is really easy to drive especially with such easy instructions and smooth controls! 
Come play with us if you are ready to use one of the most amazing realistic driving games!
Features:
Select your own bus or unlock and buy new crazy bus!
Unlock new crazy difficult levels by completing your previous levels!
Make sure you complete your levels in the given time or you would have to restart that level again.
Be careful not to hit another car or it would result in level failure and you would have to restart the level.
Great sound effects that enhance your pick and drop experience.
Provide pick and drop services to your loyal customers and drop them to their destination safely.
Amazing 3D graphics and animation make you feel like you are actually driving in a real life bus.

bluejetty:00163088:ios.description:
El Espectador App es una aplicación diseñada para dispositivos móviles que le permite a los usuarios tener acceso a la edición del periódico impreso, así como a actualizaciones de la misma.
Su diseño intuitivo y de fácil uso, con navegación en formato vertical, permite a los usuarios mantenerse actualizados de todas las noticias de Colombia y el mundo.

*Featured in the App Store for Making Family Memories and Photo Projects* 
*Rated Best Photo Quality by Digital Photography Review*
Mail REAL one-of-a-kind cards without a trip to the store! Create cards right from your iPhone or iPad and send them straight to your lucky recipient’s mailbox. And now, you can let us do the writing with our newest feature, MagicMessage™! Just tell us their name, the occasion and other detail you’d like and watch the magic happen! For a more personalized touch, use our NEW RealScript® technology. Choose real handwriting options for your cards and envelopes for a true pen-to-paper style! Upgrade to a premium card and embossed envelope or order packs of personalized cards, ideal for holiday photo cards and thank you cards. 
Customizable cards for every occasion:
- Holidays
- Thank You
- Birthdays
- Grandparents
- Babies
- Weddings
- Graduations
- Travel
- Invitations
- Valentine’s Day
- Easter
- Father’s Day
- Mother’s Day
- Anniversary & Love
- Thinking of You
- Get Well Soon
- Congratulations
- Thanksgiving
Ink Cards are printed on thick, glossy 5x7-inch cardstock at a resolution of 300 dpi. (That’s printing-nerd-speak for “super detailed on really nice paper.”) And they cost just $2 each (with free postage)! Upgrade from postcard-style to a premium card to mail a thicker, matte card in an envelope. You can even make your card extra special by adding a gift card for virtually any special occasion! Choose from dozens of brands and restaurant gift cards. Purchase with Apple Pay, PayPal or scan your credit card at checkout.
You create. We deliver.
- Cards are delivered to the U.S. and Canada in 3-7 business days and to anywhere else in the world in one to three weeks.
- Card packs are delivered in just days to anywhere in the U.S.
- Receive email and push notifications to know when your card has been ordered and shipped.

Our app is FREE to download. We can’t wait for you to make someone’s day!

bluejetty:00021708:ios.name: Calculator PanecalST
bluejetty:00021708:ios.summary: This is calculator app that allows you to display and modify formulas. It allows you to enter formulas while checking them, which prevents you from typing incorrectly or making calculation errors. It is also possible to reuse past formulas
bluejetty:00021708:ios.description:
This is calculator app that allows you to display and modify formulas. It allows you to enter formulas while checking them, which prevents you from typing incorrectly or making calculation errors. It is also possible to reuse past formulas to change only certain values to calculate them.
 The cursor indicates on the display, and you can tap or press the arrow keys to quickly navigate to where you want to edit. It has a powerful, flexible and intuitive user interface with support for swiping to scroll through formulas and long-tap to copy and paste.
[ Features ]
- Easy operation for editing formulas
- Re-calculation by using history
- Four arithmetic operations, root, percentages, time, tax and parentheses calculations
- Memory, M+, M-, MR, MC 
- Scroll up/down lines
- Cut, copy and paste
- Expressions history and answer history
- Grouping separator and decimal point 
- Various settings (Long tap MENU key)
[ What do you use "Calculator" for ]
- General calculator
- Tax and VAT
- Sales, profit and cost
- Split a payments at restaurant
- Long formulas calculation
- Formula include parenthesis
- Elapsed time, time addition and subtraction, production time, costing from time 
[ Four arithmetic operations ]
1 + 2 - 3 × 4 ÷ 5 = 0.6
[ Time calculation ]
16:15 - 12:45 = 3:30:00
1.5 × (16:15 - 12:45) = 5:15:00
Press [H:M:S] key for changing value after calculation.
=5.25
[ Root calculation (Long press)]
√( 2 × 2) = 2
[ Percentage calculation ]
500 + 20% = 600
500 - 20% = 400
500 × 20% = 100
100 ÷ 500% = 20
[ Tax calculation ]
500 Tax+ = 525
525 Tax- = 500
[ Parenthesis calculation ]
( 1 + 2 ) × ( 3 + 4 ) = 21
( 1 + 2 ) ( 3 + 4 ) ( 5 + 6 ) = 231
[ Grouping separator and decimal point ]
123,456,789.1 + 0.02 = 123,456,789.12
123.456.789,1 + 0,02 = 123.456.789,12
(Depends on setting)
[ Display ]
Calculator indicates long expressions on the display. If you may mistake to input expressions, you can correct this expressions easily and quickly using by back space key, arrow keys and C(clear) key.
[ Re-play and history functions ]
Calculator has "Re-play function". It indicates expressions that you inputted in the recently using by △(re-play)key. If you long-press re-play key, expressions history table is available. 
[ Last answer and history functions ]
Last answer is that indicates the last calculation result by using Ans key. If you long-press Ans key, a last answer history table is available.
[ Percent calculator ]
If you would like to calculate “20% more $50”, you can input 50+20% and get a result.
[ Tax calculator ]
This calculator can store tax rate in the setting. And you can get price including / excluding tax easily and quickly using by Tax+/Tax- keys.
[ Disclaimer ] 
Please note in advance that Appsys is not responsible for any damage or lost profits caused by the use of this software, or any claims from third parties.
