bluejetty:00186972:ios.name: Learn Euphonium - tonestro
bluejetty:00186972:ios.summary:
Learn to play euphonium and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the euphonium or baritone horn and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your euphonium easily.
tonestro
bluejetty:00186972:ios.description:
Learn to play euphonium and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the euphonium or baritone horn and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your euphonium easily.
tonestro for Euphonium offers a large collection of songs, exercises and guided lessons for every skill level. Learn how to read music notes and improve your euphonium skills by playing many songs and exercises.
With the tuner you tune your euphonium fast and easily for perfect pitch. A metronome and specially composed background music with play alongs for many songs guide you the way to perfect rhythm.
Weekly challenges with hand-picked songs give you the extra motivation to improve your skills when you compare yourself with euphonium players from around the world.
OVERVIEW
- Get instant feedback on rhythm & pitch
- Learn to play the euphonium or learn something new
- Enjoy a large collection of songs
- Discover euphonium lessons & exercises
- Start with your first lessons on music notes or choose from many songs
- Learn the correct fingerings with fingering charts
- Tune your euphonium with our integrated tuner
- Enjoy songs with play alongs
- Stay motivated with weekly challenges
LEARN
Learn how to play the euphonium or improve your skills with lessons, fingering charts and exercises. Step-by-step lessons will guide you through your first notes on the euphonium. Detailed explanations and fingering charts tell you how to play a certain note. A tuner helps you find the correct pitch. Test your knowledge in exams and see how fast you progress. Use your newly learned skills and play your first songs on your euphonium.
For experienced euphonium players there’s always something new to learn with advanced lessons, songs and exercises.
PRACTICE
Use tonestro’s live-feedback feature on rhythm and pitch to improve your skills. See where you struggle with intonation and work on your pitch to become a better euphonium player. Switch to practice mode and choose a slower tempo to work on getting that rhythm right. Let the metronome guide you through the songs and use the tuner to not only tune your euphonium but also to see which notes are the ones you have to be very careful with pitch.
PLAY
Discover songs from all music genres and play euphonium songs for every skill level. Whether you’re a fan of classical music or you prefer jazz songs instead: With tonestro’s large sheet music library you’ll find just the songs you need for playing your euphonium.
And you don’t have to play alone: With play alongs you’re playing with a whole band in the background. Always on your side is the tonestro tuner, which is an easy-to-use tuner that will make sure that you’re in tune. And there’s always the metronome that will guide you through the songs.
COMPETE
Do you want to prove your skills? Enter our weekly challenges! Compete with euphonium players from around the world and fight for the podium. Practice the songs to score as many points as possible and become the best euphonium player in the tonestro world. Don’t forget to use the tuner first, so that you can start the challenge with perfect preparation.
tonestro requires a subscription to access the entire learning content and song library. Each subscription plan may include a 3-day free trial period.
Terms: https://www.tonestro.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://www.tonestro.com/privacy

bluejetty:00021572:ios.description:
Extremely fast QR & barcode scanner that supports all QR & barcode formats! It's the must-have scanner app for your iPhone. 
Features:
* Scan QR Code & Barcode
* Search and Compare Prices on Amazon, eBay and Google Shopping
* Support 19 country URLs searching
* Save unlimited scan history for price tracking
* Scan promotion and coupon codes in shops to get discounts
* Support Scan QR & Barcodes From Photo Library 
* Support generating QR Code for contacts, products, web URL, Wi-Fi password, text, books, E-mail, location, calendar and so on.
* Support generating QR Code for Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Spotify, Youtube, Whatsapp, Dropbox and so on.
* Support QR code, Data Matrix, Maxi code, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, UPC-A, EAN-8 ... 
* Support exporting scan history, create history, batch scan history
* Flashlight supported 
* Remind you by beep or vibrate when scan successfully
* Share QR & barcode with your friends
How to use:
1. Open the scanner 
2. Point the camera to the QR code / barcode 
3. Auto recognize, scan and decode 
4. Get results and relevant options 
It's very easy to use , no need to press any buttons or adjust the zoom, just open it and point to the QR code, it will auto recognize , scan and decode the QR code. After scanning, several relevant options for the results will be provided, you can search the products online, visit the websites, or even connect to Wi-Fi.
So, what are you waiting for? Download QR Code Reader to scan QR code and barcode!
Contact Us
Email: qrcode.reader@outlook.com, we are glad to hear from you!
Privacy Policy: http://cloud-record.com/qrcodereader/privacy.html
Terms of use: http://cloud-record.com/qrcodereader/Term_of_uses.pdf

CNS Tap Test is an adaptation of the Finger Tap Test (F
bluejetty:00178286:ios.description:
As featured in the book Beyond Training by Ben Greenfield.
As featured in the podcasts:
- Harder to Kill Radio 026
- Ameer Rosic Optimal Health Show #58
- Ben Greenfield Fitness #263
CNS Tap Test is an adaptation of the Finger Tap Test (FTT) or Finger Oscillation Test (FOT) which is used to measure the status of the central nervous system (CNS), and is one of the most commonly used tests in neuropsychology, because of its simplicity and reliability, and because it generates relevant data about fine motor control, which is based on motor speed as well as kinesthetic and visual-motor ability.
The application should be used on a regular basis to determine an athlete’s baseline. If the CNS Tap Test result is elevated it is suitable for a maximum effort or a heavy lifting day. If the CNS Tap Test result is lower than average it may indicate CNS fatigue and impending sickness, injury or over-training.
Both hands should be tested on a regular basis in a consistent environment, typically every morning on waking. The procedure for testing is:
 - Rest hand palm down on the heel of the hand on a flat surface
 - Tapping is done with the index (pointing finger), and all other fingers remain on the flat surface
 - The timer starts with the first tap
 - When the timer expires no further taps will be accepted
 - The result can either be saved or discarded.
Multiple samples can be saved per day.
The resulting data can be graphed, emailed or managed from within CNS Tap Test.
Using Swift Charts for improved accessibility and legibility.

CNS Tap Test is an adaptation of the Finger Tap Test (FTT) or Finger Oscillation Test (FOT) which  is used  to measure the status of the central nervous system (CNS), and is one of the most commonly used tests in neuropsychology, because of its simplicity and reliability, and because it generates relevant data about fine motor control, which is based on motor speed as well as kinesthetic and visual-motor ability.

The application should be used on a regular basis to determine an athlete’s baseline. If the CNS Tap Test result is elevated it is suitable for a  maximum effort or a heavy lifting day. If the CNS Tap Test result is lower than average it may indicate CNS fatigue and impending sickness, injury or over-training.

Both hands should be tested on a regular basis in a consistent environment, typically every morning on waking. The procedure for testing is:

 - Rest hand palm down on the heel of the hand on a flat surface
 - Tapping is done with the index (pointing finger), and all other fingers remain on the flat surface
 - The timer starts with the first tap
 - When the timer expires no further taps will be accepted
 - The result can either be saved or discarded.

Multiple samples can be saved per day.

The resulting data can be graphed, emailed or managed from within CNS Tap Test.

Using Swift Charts for improved accessibility and legibility.

bluejetty:00177929:ios.description:
Experience word puzzles from a different perspective as Words of the World tests the boundaries of your vocabulary. An anagram based word swipe, crossword puzzle game, the rules are simple: take scrambled letters and unscramble them to make words. The only twist is, you have to solve a crossword puzzle with the words while you're at it!
What makes Words of the World different?
- Huge collection of custom word puzzles, we're word game experts!
- Interesting facts and quotes between puzzles, enjoy exploring our collection of random knowledge!
- Stunning photos and imagery from destinations around the world, explore some of the furthest reaches of the world!
- Starts easy, but progresses quickly to work your brain and keep you challenged. A perfect mix of words you know and words you'll have to really dig deep for!
The game is simple enough for anyone to learn how to play. In fact, we made the first several levels pretty easy so everyone can get the hang of it. Don’t let those first few puzzles give you a false sense of security though, because we open up the dictionary really wide as the game progresses. While making the puzzles, our team dug deep through the reaches of the collective knowledge from around the world to bring you some pretty sensational random knowledge factoids and quotes to keep things interesting!
Of course we couldn’t throw ALL those words at you without giving you some help, so we brought in some hints to give you a hand when you’re trying to finish a crossword puzzle. Earn coins along the way to exchange for hints to make your way through the game!
Brought to you by the makers of the classics Infinite Word Search and Crossword Quiz!

bluejetty:00069677:ios.description:
Tricky Gems is a fast-paced tile-matching puzzle game for iOS and macOS that will challenge your reflexes and strategic thinking from the very first drop.
Guide columns of three gems as they fall into the playing field and match lines or diagonals of three or more to score points. Clear the board efficiently, rack up combos, and climb the leaderboard as high as you can.
Every level brings a new challenge — the columns fall faster, the pressure builds, and the background shifts to keep things fresh. At the end of each level, a special bomb column sweeps the field, destroying every gem that matches its color. You can also trigger this power move manually once your Power-up Bar is full. Run out of space and the game ends in a spectacular explosion of bombs.
Prove your skills by unlocking all 23 Achievements — some require true mastery of the game. You will need sharp focus, quick reflexes, and a solid strategy to earn the ultimate title: Gem Legend.
Good luck!

bluejetty:00130539:ios.name: Return to Monkey Island
bluejetty:00130539:ios.summary: Return to Monkey Island is an unexpected, thrilling return of series creator Ron Gilbert that continues the story of the legendary adventure games The Secret of Monkey Island and Monkey Island 2: LeChuck’s Revenge developed in collaboration
bluejetty:00130539:ios.description:
Return to Monkey Island is an unexpected, thrilling return of series creator Ron Gilbert that continues the story of the legendary adventure games The Secret of Monkey Island and Monkey Island 2: LeChuck’s Revenge developed in collaboration with Lucasfilm Games.
It’s been many years since Guybrush Threepwood was last locked in a battle of wits with his nemesis, the zombie pirate LeChuck. His true love, Elaine Marley, has turned her focus away from governing and Guybrush himself is adrift and unfulfilled, having never found the Secret of Monkey Island. Hip, young pirate leaders led by Captain Madison have shuffled the old guard from power, Melee Island has taken a turn for the worse, and famed businessman Stan has been imprisoned for ‘marketing-related crimes’.
Banter with old friends and new faces on familiar islands now under dangerous new leadership. Then, take to the high seas and explore the new and unknown as you work your way out of tough predicaments. Clever puzzles, bizarre situations, and devastating ripostes are all that stand between Guybrush and glory.
Return to Point & Click Swashbuckling
Bringing classic point and click gameplay to the modern-day, intrepid pirates will solve puzzles and explore the islands with a clever evolution of classic adventure game controls. Context-sensitive interactions, reactive dialog trees, and an easy-to-use inventory system make pirating a breeze.
Embark on Archipelago Adventures
Navigate the sometimes-friendly confines of Melee Island, a familiar place that finds itself under new management by leaders who have put the squeeze on old friends and new faces. Venture out into uncharted lands like the aptly named Terror Island and the chilling outposts of Brrr Muda to make allies and enemies alike.
Created by a Legendary Crew
The new chapter in the Monkey Island series marks the return of the iconic series’ creator Ron Gilbert, joined by game co-writer Dave Grossman, art director Rex Crowle (Knights & Bikes, Tearaway) and composers Peter McConnell, Michael Land, and Clint Bajakian (Monkey Island, Monkey Island 2: LeChuck’s Revenge).

bluejetty:00177978:ios.summary: The Hero's Journey program will help you become more emotionally stable, conquer the challenges in your life, and achieve your goals! Unlike meditation, it's fun, easy, and brings fast results. Try it out, and see the effects in as little a
bluejetty:00177978:ios.description:
The Hero's Journey program will help you become more emotionally stable, conquer the challenges in your life, and achieve your goals! Unlike meditation, it's fun, easy, and brings fast results. Try it out, and see the effects in as little as 8 minutes!
VOICE WILL HELP YOU
- overcome anxiety and worry less
- complete everyday tasks easier
- get your sleep patterns back on track and improve sleep quality
- boost your self-confidence
- deal with bad mood and even mild depression
- overcome laziness and stop procrastinating
- increase your energy levels and fight apathy
- find new interests and enjoy life more
Mental health, just like physical health, is an essential part of a happy life. Voice can be your mental guide, a source of motivation and an aid in making important life decisions.
You no longer have to struggle to focus when meditating. Let yourself go and allow your imagination to run wild! You'll get all the effects of meditation without actually having to meditate.
EASIER THAN MEDITATION. FASTER RESULTS.
– Your past experiences don't matter. Even if you're brand new to this, you'll still see progress in just 8 minutes.
– You don't need to focus hard on your breathing or take a certain pose. All you need is to sit down, close your eyes, plug in your earphones and start listening. We'll take care of the rest.
HYPNOTELLING: OUR SECRET WEAPON
We like to believe we make all our decisions rationally, but that's not exactly true. Most of the time, we're driven by emotions we don't fully understand or can't entirely control.
Luckily, your subconscious mind can give you all the things you need. You just need to speak its language - images, sensations etc.
Your subconscious mind is primitive: it doesn't understand words, but it understands visual information and remembers emotions. Once you understand this, you can tune it to your liking. Voice allows you to connect to your subconscious mind. It helps, it teaches, it heals.
For example, it won't only help you deal with anxiety, sleep problems, or burnout, but will also help get to the root of your problems and the reason behind their symptoms, so you can feel calm, inspired, and motivated again.
You become the main character of an exciting adventure story. It's sort of like embarking on a psychological quest in a dreamlike state. You move through a story, face challenges along the way, and learn how to tackle them.
Unlike meditation, our stories help keep your brain alert and conscious. It enters a trance-like state where it absorbs information more effectively, giving you faster results. The closest thing it can be compared to is affirmations. You'll notice results as quick as 8 minutes into the first story.
VOICE CAN BE TRUSTED
Hypnotelling is based on a method that has been used for athlete training, supportive therapy, psychotherapy, and for scientific research.
HYPNOTELLING EFFECTIVELY HELPS
- lower anxiety and stress levels
- get you to sleep faster without meditation, and improve your sleeping habits
- boost your energy
- increase self-motivation
- improve mental health
Meditation help you develop mindfulness, but it's a slow and difficult process that can be hard to navigate on your own. Voice is like meditations 2.0: it not only allows you to expand your consciousness, but also helps you apply this experience and take action today, tomorrow, and forever. And the best thing is, you'll acquire beneficial mental skills that will stay with you for the rest of your life!
EMBARK ON AN ADVENTURE WITH VOICE RIGHT NOW!
Send your suggestions and questions to help@voice-journey.app
User terms and conditions: https://voice-journey.app/#popup-terms

bluejetty:00135734:ios.description:
Play the ultimate digital version of the multi-award-winning modern classic board game Ticket to Ride! 
Journey across various countries, connecting their vibrant cities and exploring their unique gameplay mechanics and bonuses on the way. 
Ticket to Ride offers a variety of game modes to suit you. Want to get competitive? Head online to challenge other players around the world and climb the leaderboards, or play with friends further afield in a private game. Got a packed schedule? Set up or join an asynchronous game and play across multiple days – we’ll notify you when it is your turn, so you can go at your own pace. 
Test out new strategies or keep it casual in single-player mode against state-of-the-art AI opponents. You can even make a game night of it with friends and family in couch play!
Get to know a cast of unforgettable characters, each bringing their own tales to the table. Add new locomotives and carriages to your fleet with every expansion, and cement your name in railway history on the leaderboard! 
Become a railway legend in the iconic, fan-favourite modern classic!
HOW TO PLAY TICKET TO RIDE®:
Players are dealt a number of tickets and must pick a certain number to keep (depending on the map). 
Players are also dealt four train cards of various colours. This number can also vary depending on the map you’re playing on, but don’t worry – the AI takes care of this!
Each turn, players can draw two train cards from the face-up pile, draw two train cards from the face-down pile, draw another ticket to complete, or use their train cards to claim a route! A claimed route is shown by placing train pieces along the route.
When a player has three or fewer train pieces left, the last round starts. Whoever has the most points at the end of the game is the winner! 
FEATURES
A TRULY SOCIAL TAKE ON MULTIPLAYER – Play online with friends or enjoy a seamless matchmaking experience when you challenge players from around the world. Alternatively, take on your friend sitting right next to you in couch play – use the free Ticket to Ride Companion App to really boost your couch gaming session!
PLAY AROUND YOUR BUSY DAY – Set up a game in async mode and play a game across multiple days.
SINGLE-PLAYER MODE DRIVEN BY EXPERT AIs – Powered by an innovative adaptive AI system, single-player mode offers a challenge for new and experienced players alike. 
AN IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE – Every moment has been brought to life with beautiful graphics that will immerse you in the adventure. 
STRATEGIC GAMEPLAY – Every game presents fresh challenges, and it’s your mission to work out the most efficient solutions. Collect points by completing tickets, linking destinations and building the longest route.
Join the Marmalade Game Studio Discord server to connect with players, organise matches, see the latest news and updates, and take part in events!

bluejetty:00187944:ios.description:
Welcome to Call Recorder App, a trailblazer in the realm of call recording and transcription apps. With an intuitive design and state-of-the-art technology, Call Recorder App enables you to effortlessly capture, archive, and replay your phone conversations, ensuring every word is accounted for.
But Call Recorder App is more than a call recorder - it's a game-changer. With a robust transcription feature, it breathes new life into your calls by transmuting audio interactions into text documents. With Call Recorder App at your fingertips, every conversation becomes a strategic asset, ready for instant retrieval and action.
Country Local Number Service: Belgium, Brazil, Bulgaria, Canada, Chile, China, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Rep., Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, India, Ireland, Israel, Italy, Japan, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Mexico, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Peru, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Russia, Saudi Arabia, Slovakia, Slovenia, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, Thailand, Turkey, Ukraine, United Arab Emirates, United Kingdom, United States.
Key Features:
* Record both incoming and outgoing calls without any restrictions.
* Ensure clarity with crystal-clear recordings.
* Convert call recordings into text effortlessly.
* Utilize it as a voice recorder for quick notes.
* Access local numbers in various countries for your convenience.
* Enhanced security with passcode protection for sensitive recordings.
* Organize your recordings and rename or favorite them for easy access.
* Advanced search using keywords spoken during calls.
* Seamless integration with Apple Watch and iMessage apps.
* App Clip and Widget functionality for recording without opening the app.
* Background Play for listening to recordings while multitasking.
* Prompt customer support for any inquiries or issues.
Automatic Call Recording: Easily record all outgoing calls with a single tap. Available countries with Automatic Recording: Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland, Israel, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, Norway, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States.
An Essential App for Professionals:
Call Recorder App is an indispensable tool adaptable to the unique needs of freelancers, small business owners, lawyers, journalists, consultants, sales representatives, HR professionals, and account managers.
* For Freelancers & Small Businesses: Enhance your communication. Record client conversations, improve customer relationships, and drive sales growth with every interaction just a tap away from becoming a turning point in your business's success.
* Lawyers, Journalists, and Consultants: Say goodbye to forgotten details and potential disputes. Call Recorder App serves as your memory companion, maintaining a comprehensive written record of your dialogues, allowing you to focus on well-informed decision-making.
* Sales Teams, HR, and Account Managers: Unearth valuable insights with every call through Call Recorder App. Analyze communication patterns, devise innovative solutions, and seize every opportunity. 
Please note that a subscription is required to use the Call Recorder app, available on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis, with prices varying by location. Subscriptions are set to auto-renew for your convenience.
Your calls may be charged by your operator. Call charges are determined by your operator and may vary between local and international calls. Before making a call, we recommend checking your operator’s tariff details and any potential additional charges. The app does not charge any additional fees for calls.

bluejetty:00080645:ios.description:
Aliens are descending upon Earth soon. You are tasked with building the largest gas station franchise across the world to feed the invaders with capitalism so they don’t consume and destroy humanity!
Gas cars, sell food & drinks, upgrade products, expand parking, research epic stuff, launch rockets, and craft alien technology, to build the largest gas station franchise empire the world has ever seen!

Sell snacks, drinks, cookies, ice cream, souvenirs and fast foods. Unlock supermarket quality products and restaurant quality meals. Upgrade the location and theme of your flagship gas station to multiply your fame. Claim your status among the elite circle of franchise tycoon game moguls as you save the world with capitalism!
Unlock your launch site and launch your rockets to explore other worlds and galaxies! Collect special alien technology loot from other planets, upgrade and equip the loot for bonus effects on your business!
Build your idle tycoon empire today, before someone else does!

- Playable offline without wifi internet, non stop truck stop idle style =D
- Lots of cars and trucks to unlock, they stop and you capitalize
- Launch rockets and collect, upgrade, and craft new alien tech
- Tons of research and missions, market your super cool products
- Prestige system, classic gameplay boosting style
- Endless events, adventure into the alien realm
- Leaderboards, where champions game achievements shine
- Easy to learn hard to master, casual and fun gameplay
- Classic capitalist inc style game features, familiar and relaxing
New players will have fun exploring all the game has to offer with a friendly tutorial and missions! Experienced players will find all the common idle tycoon (incremental clicker) game features, and more!

bluejetty:00034857:ios.name: Kids Spelling game Learn words
bluejetty:00034857:ios.summary: This educational game teaches various basic words in English, to the kindergarten children. For the young child, it will help them to learn alphabets and how to spell the first words. For kids of Class 1 & 2, it is a practice of the word sp
bluejetty:00034857:ios.description:
This educational game teaches various basic words in English, to the kindergarten children. For the young child, it will help them to learn alphabets and how to spell the first words. For kids of Class 1 & 2, it is a practice of the word spellings they have already learned and thus improve on their English language skills.
We have added colorful cartoon pictures of everyday objects, which the child interacts with in the house and primary school. They learn the pronunciation of alphabets as well as the words. There are multiple ways to play, from learning to practicing and simply improving on their vocabulary. They also learn to recognize the names associated with the images and by putting together the letters in words, they learn the spelling in English.
Features:
Learn - this is for beginners, where they simply match the alphabets to the shadows under the object picture and learn the pronunciation of each letter as well as the spelling for the entire word.
Practice - this is when the kids already know the spelling and are putting the letters to form the spelling of the object name.
Test - this is where it gets interesting and the children are now required to fill up the missing alphabets from the multiple correct and incorrect letters that they have at the bottom.
Difficult - this is advanced level for kids and is like preparing for the school examination. They have blank space under the image and are required to form the correct spelling from various alphabets.
Matching - this is for all ages and is like pairing the picture with the correct name. It is like recognizing the images for the names in English.
Themes - we have added multiple first words from all categories like animals, fruits, kitchen, clothes, cars, kindergarten, house tools, living room, music and more.
Different length of words for spelling - you will get some 2 letter words and 3 letter words in the beginning to get you going. And then it will increase to 4 letter words and 5 letter words and even test you for 6 letter words.
12 Languages - English, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Spanish and Swedish..
If you have any feedback and suggestions on how we could further improve the design and interaction of our games, please visit our website www.iabuzz.com or leave us a message at kids@iabuzz.com
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00018083:ios.name: Loan Calculator - Loan2Me
bluejetty:00018083:ios.summary: Loan2Me is a comprehensive loan calculator that quickly calculates loan payments by inputting the loan amount, interest rate, and term. Pro features include six additional input screens for determining loan values and date-related calculati
bluejetty:00018083:ios.description:
Loan2Me is a comprehensive loan calculator that quickly calculates loan payments by inputting the loan amount, interest rate, and term. Pro features include six additional input screens for determining loan values and date-related calculations.
Users can easily calculate loan affordability by inputting their desired monthly payment, loan duration, and interest rate. The calculator also shows how lower interest rates affect monthly payments and potential savings by shortening the loan term.
For mortgage or vehicle loans, the calculator has input screens for down payments, trade-ins, dealer incentives, insurance, property taxes, sales tax, and other expenses. Users can save loans for convenient access and they automatically synchronize across devices via iCloud (Pro Features required).
Accessing saved loans is easy, with loan details, progress tracking, and sharing options. Users can save, print, or share results with a single tap. The amortization schedule details how much of your payment goes towards interest and principal each month. 
Users can create customized reports (requires Pro Features) in PDF, text or comma-separated values (CSV) files for spreadsheet import.
Modify loan input parameters to see how they affect payments, total interest, total payments, and loan term. Enhance loan management by making additional payments to calculate savings in time and money. Use the Progress Chart slider to visualize loan progress over time.
Loan2Me provides immediate answers for informed loan decisions. For vehicle loans, it offers customizable sales tax calculations based on state regulations. Compare cashback options with lower interest rates to help your decision making. Determine substantial savings from 20-year to 30-year mortgages.
Accessibility features include VoiceOver, dynamic font sizes, five color themes, and light/dark modes. Comprehensive help screens and FAQs provide further information.
Basic features are available for FREE without any intrusive ads. Pro Features are offered as a one-time purchase. Enhance your loan management and decisions with Loan2Me.

bluejetty:00096880:ios.name: Jigsaw Block Sort
bluejetty:00096880:ios.summary: Welcome to Jigsaw Block Sort, a fresh hybrid of jigsaw puzzle, block jam, and solitaire puzzle mechanics. Inspired by jigsolitaire, jigsort puzzles, and classic picture puzzle games, this game transforms the way you experience pic jigsaw ch
bluejetty:00096880:ios.description:
Welcome to Jigsaw Block Sort, a fresh hybrid of jigsaw puzzle, block jam, and solitaire puzzle mechanics. Inspired by jigsolitaire, jigsort puzzles, and classic picture puzzle games, this game transforms the way you experience pic jigsaw challenges.
In Jigsaw Block Sort, each solitaire card holds a piece of a stunning image. These cards are scattered across the board like a mix of jigblock puzzles and sliding card puzzles. Your mission is to slide, move, and connect them to complete the whole picture puzzle.
But here’s what makes Jigsaw Block Sort different:
 When a section of the picture is completed, it doesn’t stop. It turns into a moving block on the board, continuing to glide, interact, and merge — just like in block jam or advanced jigblock puzzle systems. This moving mechanic speeds up gameplay, creates satisfying chain reactions, and keeps the board alive.
Built on jig, sliding, and dynamic design ides, this game blends art block, art jam, and modern picture puzzle games into a smart and fluid puzzle experience. As pieces connect, some groups shrink, others expand into tetra formations, and the board evolves like a living sortiment of shifting challenges.
Every move feels jiggly, responsive, and fluid — designed for both strategic depth and relaxing play. Whether you’re enjoying a quiet solitary session or diving deep into a fast-paced logic puzzle, this is your perfect stress relief game.
Jigsaw Block Sort combines:
- card jigsaw puzzle mechanics
- jigsaw solitaire inspiration
- jigblock puzzle fusion
- picture puzzle games beauty
- smooth slide, move, and moveit controls
From relaxing joy puzzle vibes to challenging brain puzzle action, this game adapts to you. It brings together the world of puzzledom, jigsort puzzles, and even experimental art concepts inspired by peking puzzle aesthetics.
With each level, new mechanics, new layouts, and new simpler yet deeper challenges are introduced. Whether you enjoy art puzzle, block jam, or modern jigsaw with cards, this game offers an evolved jigblock puzzle experience.
Play during a quick break or on a long evening — from casual fun to full immersion.
Jigsaw Block Sort is not just another puzzle — it’s a new language of sliding, moving, and connecting images into one seamless whole.
Slide. Move. Connect. Complete.
Dive into Jigsaw Block Sort today and experience a new era of picture puzzle gameplay.

bluejetty:00090361:ios.summary:
EverythingWeather utilizes all National Weather Service (NWS) and NOAA data to get current conditions and forecast data for anywhere within the United States and it's territories. 
What can be found in the app:
- Current and forecast cond
bluejetty:00090361:ios.description:
EverythingWeather utilizes all National Weather Service (NWS) and NOAA data to get current conditions and forecast data for anywhere within the United States and it's territories. 
What can be found in the app:
- Current and forecast conditions with a fully customizable home page
- Choose from countless weather stations to use as your default.
- Current hazards in effect (includes all NWS hazards/alerts)
- Realtime customizable push notifications for NWS hazards/alerts
- Daily Weather Summary and Tropical Push Notifications
- Push notifications for observed and forecast river levels.
- Easy to share Weather Stories from all NWS offices
- Current Storm Prediction Center (SPC) and Weather Prediction Center (WPC) outlooks shown on the home page
- Probabilistic precipitation data (rain/snow/ice)
- Tide data shown on the home page if you are near the coast
- NEW Tropical Center where you can follow along with all things tropical across the globe
- Real time radar with lightning data and many map overlays:
 * Lightning data from GOES satellite GLM 
 * All NWS products and you can customize the colors for each one and filter to only show what you want to see
 * GOES satellite data with a 3-hour loop
 * Composite radar and super-res level 2 radar data with split screen capability
 * Severe Weather Outlook (Days 1-8) from the SPC
 * Fire Weather Outlook (Days 1-8) from the SPC
 * Active Mesoscale Discussions from the SPC
 * Storm Reports from the last 24 hours
 * Excessive Rainfall Outlook from the WPC
 * Active Mesoscale Precipitation Discussions from the WPC
 * Forecast rainfall amounts (Days 1-7) from the WPC
 * PROBSevere information
 * Tidal information/forecasts for all of the US and it's territories
 * Tropical Outlooks and discussions from the National Hurricane Center (NHC)
 * Active Tropical Depressions/Storms/Hurricanes and their forecast tracks, watches/warnings, surface wind field, wind probabilities, wind radii, arrival time of TS force winds, and peak storm surge from the NHC
 * Current weather conditions from around the US
 * Plot your saved favorites right on the map for a quick look at conditions for all your favorites
 * Show your current location on the map
- NWS Products such as Area Forecast Discussion, Climate Reports, Local Storm Reports, etc.
- Save Favorite locations
- View detailed weekly and hourly forecast data 
- Detailed astronomy data including info on upcoming meteor showers
- Space Weather page that includes solar wind data, GOES Magnetometer, solar flare probabilities, KP conditions and forecast, and solar imagery
- Current and forecast air quality data
See the Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
See our Privacy Policy: https://everythingwx.com/privacy-policy

- 40 differents mahjong tiles to play with

- 6 different games mode

bluejetty:00019609:ios.description:
Welcome to Call of Antia world!
Call of Antia is a brand new type of match 3 RPG puzzle game. In this unique RPG game, the classic match 3 puzzle gameplay is mixed with battle, magic, and dragons as you fearlessly charge into the enemies. 
Are you ready? It's time to reveal the secrets of Antia!
The knights have waited for a hundred years, yet the mysterious Dragoneer remains a legend.
You, the chosen one, have been summoned to the fantastical land of Antia. Here you will meet more friends, recruit heroes, and unveil the secrets of this land during your journey.
The protectors are becoming forgotten, but the creator has not yet arrived. The Time Portal is damaged, and darkness is wreaking havoc.
When the Five Sages reignite the flames, the truth of the world will be revealed in the Time Portal.
In the wind is a cry for help only the chosen one can hear. 
Can you hear the Call of Antia?
• Thrilling Match 3 RPG Puzzle Gameplay
Engrossing and strategic match 3 battles.
A journey full of challenges and accomplishments!
• Build Your Shire in Call of Antia World
Build your kingdom land, train strong soldiers, and become a real ruler!
• Legendary Heroes
Collect over 50 epic heroes, level them up and upgrade their abilities.
Use different strategies and put forth your best heroes to fight the darkness.
• Ancient Dragons
Dragons, the secret weapon in battles, are your strongest allies to vanquish all your enemies!
Find legendary dragons and they will reveal the secrets buried in the world of Antia.
• Exciting Journey
You will encounter diverse and unique enemies!
A funny goblin bearing a huge treasure bag, an epic ogryn with two heads, sinister assassins, and even the headless horseman himself!
Countless bonuses are waiting for you!
• Online Battle Match 3 RPG Puzzle game
A variety of battle modes: Alliance Wars, 1v1 battle and Fallen Titans.
Experience real battles with your allies and fight for glory!
• Global Communication
Join an alliance to play with millions of players all over the world and collect great rewards!
• Tons of Events
Rich and various events that give you free items.
You can participate in multiple events at the same time. Find your allies and join those epic events!
Download Call of Antia, the new type of match 3 RPG puzzle game. 
Win battles with your dragons in this match 3 RPG puzzle game, complete the puzzles and become the master of the world of Antia.

bluejetty:00073555:ios.description:
Bible for Kids Bedtime Stories – Offline Audiobook
Bible for Kids Bedtime Stories is an offline audiobook created especially for toddlers, preschoolers, and children of all ages. Perfect for values-based parenting and families seeking meaningful screen-free time, the app features the most important Bible stories written in simple, child-friendly language and narrated by a professional voice actor.
The gentle storytelling and calming background music help children understand these ancient, timeless stories and relax before bedtime. You can listen to this audio Bible offline — at home, during road trips, or on the go — without needing an internet connection. Designed with parents in mind, the app is 100% kid-safe and completely ad-free.
THE BEST BIBLE STORIES FOR KIDS
Our Bible for Kids Bedtime Stories app includes the following Bible stories and parables in audiobook format:
- Creation of the World
- The Expulsion of Adam and Eve
- Noah and the Great Flood
- The Tower of Babel
- God’s Promise to Abraham
- Jacob and Esau
- The Story of Joseph
- The Story of Moses
- In the Promised Land
- David and Goliath
- Jonah and the Big Fish
- The Fiery Furnace
- Daniel and the Lions’ Den
- Esther Saves Her People
- The Birth of Jesus
- The Boy Jesus at the Temple
- The Miraculous Catch of Fish
- The Good Samaritan
- Jesus Calms the Storm
- Jesus Feeds 5,000 People
- The Lost Sheep
- The Prodigal Son
- The Resurrection of Lazarus
- Jesus Heals a Blind Man
- The Story of Zacchaeus
- Jesus Came to Jerusalem
- Judas’ Betrayal
- Taking Jesus into Custody
- Jesus on the Cross
- Jesus Is Resurrected
- The Road to Emmaus
- The Ascension of Jesus
- The Coming of the Holy Spirit
- Saul Becomes Paul
- Paul and Silas in Prison
- Paul Goes to Athens
- Paul Travels to Corinth and Ephesus
- Eutychus Falls from the Window
- The Storm and the Shipwreck
- Paul Teaches in Rome
- Love Is Patient and Kind
- The New Heaven and New Earth
- And more stories coming soon!
KEY BENEFITS FOR YOUR FAMILY
- 100% Kid-Safe & Ad-Free
- Fully Offline
- Professional Narration
- Calm Background Music
- Screen-Free Faith Building
UNDERSTANDING THE HOLY BIBLE
The Holy Bible is a collection of diverse texts — historical narratives, prayers, and prophecies. Because many biblical concepts need explanation for modern children, our audio Bible retells them in simple, clear, and engaging language.
THE OLD TESTAMENT
The Old Testament tells the story of how God created the world and the first people — Adam and Eve. This part of the Bible includes many stories from the lives of the ancient Hebrews: how the patriarchs lived in the lands of the Middle East, raising their flocks; how the descendants of Abraham were enslaved in Egypt and later freed by God; how the people made a covenant with the Lord on Mount Sinai and received the Ten Commandments; and how God promised to lead His people to the Promised Land.
THE NEW TESTAMENT
The New Testament tells the story of the earthly life of Jesus Christ — from His miraculous birth to His crucifixion and glorious Resurrection. In this part of the Bible, you will find stories about Jesus’ ministry, His parables and miracles, the Last Supper, His suffering, death on the cross, and Resurrection. The New Testament also describes the beginnings of the early Christian communities, the deeds of the apostles, and the letters written by Christ’s followers to believers around the world.
Believe in God and Jesus Christ, grow in faith, live with love, and enjoy these beautiful Bible audio stories together with your children. Download today for a peaceful, faith-based bedtime routine!

bluejetty:00143734:ios.description:
Bebememo was created to record your baby's every precious moment and give parents a safe and easy way to share photos and videos with loved ones.
· SMART AI DETECTION
After adding your baby’s information in Bebememo, all your baby's photos and videos will be recognized by AI detection from your phone, and you can upload them with just one simple click.
· AUTOMATICALLY PHOTO ORGANIZATION
All photos and videos you uploaded will be chronological base on the baby's age, so you will never miss a day of your baby's growth.
· TIMELINE/CALENDAR VIEW
Switch between the timeline and calendar as you like to view all your moments by date. 
· LOVING FAMILY SHARING
No more sending your baby's photos and videos to family members one by one. All the photos, videos, and favorite people in one place.
· BABY MILESTONE TRACKER
Track your baby's growth, milestones, and development, view all your baby's footprints on the map. 
· SAFE & SECURE
The baby's photos and videos are completely private. All content you upload to Bebememo belongs to you, and it can only be viewed by you and the family members you invite. All your data is encrypted and backed up in the cloud.
· OTHERS:
- AD-FREE. We don't share your data with advertisers.
- UNLIMITED LONG VIDEO. No limitation on video length, never misses a wonderful moment.
- BACKGROUND UPLOAD. You don't need to wait in the app until all your photos are finished uploading.
- VISIBILITY CONTROLS. Decide what to display to the whole family and what to keep private between you and your partner.
- LIKE & COMMENT. The interactive based on baby photos brings family members closer together.
- BABY PHOTO EDITOR. Add stickers, filters, and other effects to make your baby's photo stand out.
Privacy Policy: https://bebememo.us/privacy
Terms of Use: https://bebememo.us/terms

bluejetty:00014498:ios.description:
Digital catalog with dynamic sales force automation, fast, simple and offline for smartphones and tablets, combining products with marketing and sales.
• CATALOG: There is no loading or waiting while operating the app for catalogs or sales as every scroll and touch and process is highly optimized and native. Custom visual and identity based on the brand and company marketing without complicated technical efforts or technical tasks.
• SALES: Highly integrated to the digital catalog with products and marketing material is available the orders shortcuts and menus for efficient sales.
• CONTENTS: Resources like videos and PDFs easily distributed and accessible, supporting sharing and download. Internal and external marketing integrated in a single mobile platform.
• DYNAMIC: Only the required features are activated and configured, resulting in a fast and simple experience. Both visuals and identity of the company are dynamically applied.
• OFFLINE: Operates completely offline while supporting online operations for fast updates to information and orders. The synchronization features are really fast, taking only a few seconds.
• ANALYTICS: Event tracking for operations on catalogs, contents and orders. Which products are currently most accessed, how many contents were seen, who is making more sales, and many more.
• INTEGRATIONS: Custom integration with enterprise resource planning and other systems supporting constant and transparent updates on product information, contents and sales orders.
• MONITORING: The platform is thoroughly and constantly monitored analyzing events for trends and patterns. Alerts on availability and stability for applications, services and integrations.
Used in various markets including footwear, decor, fashion and industry, millions of sales are robustly processed automating and simplifying the job of sales reps, internal and external teams. By combining a fast and interactive products catalog with sales force automation and marketing material in a single solution, it reduces costs by automating processes and improving sales in the current frenetic Industry 4.0.
Using a single unified platform, both visual settings for the product catalog and commercial rules are adapted to every single business. Alongside the relationship between objects like prices, products, discounts, images and many more, custom adaptations are deployed using dynamic settings and scripts even though the apps are native.
Learn more at negotti.com

bluejetty:00134271:ios.summary:
CanGoal, an app that combines aesthetics and talent into a goal-tracking wonder.
Recommended by Apple editors, featured in App Store; a passionate recommendation for work friends and student partners, with numerous positive reviews! It's a
bluejetty:00134271:ios.description:
CanGoal, an app that combines aesthetics and talent into a goal-tracking wonder.
Recommended by Apple editors, featured in App Store; a passionate recommendation for work friends and student partners, with numerous positive reviews! It's an app you're worth having.
What features does CanGoal offer?
- Goal tracking
- Schedule checklists
- Fun and engaging "Goal Buddies"
- Focus timers
- Habits, quantification, and everything in between
Why should you try CanGoal?
- Created many task lists and then quickly forgot or overlooked them? CanGoal reshapes your goal-oriented approach, focusing on what you truly want to accomplish.
- Do you find it a bit boring when achieving your goals? Now, you don't have to worry, because here, "CanGoal friends" will accompany and encourage you to complete your goals, just like your best friends.
- With intuitive progress bars and charts, CanGoal helps you visualize your goal progress. This not only gives you a clear view of your completion but also motivates you to keep moving forward.
- Everyone has different goals and habits, and CanGoal offers a wealth of personalized options, allowing you to customize the interface and features according to your preferences and needs. Whether it's color themes, reminder sounds, or task categorization, CanGoal can meet your needs.
- Whether you use CanGoal on your phone, tablet, or computer, it ensures your data is synchronized through iCloud. This way, no matter where you are, you can always access and update your tasks and goals.
CanGoal's commitment:
- No registration required, no personal information collected
- Data synchronization through iCloud, developers do not have access to your data
- We do not place ads within the app.
---
About CanGoal Pro Purchase Instructions:
CanGoal offers an annual subscription plan and a one-time purchase plan.
- You can choose an annual subscription or a one-time purchase plan based on your actual usage.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase.
- If you subscribe, the subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be identified.
- Users can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in their "Account Settings" after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that part, where applicable.
- Our app can be used normally after the subscription expires, and any unlocked content will remain accessible.
Privacy Policy: https://www.canstudio.top/cangoal/agreements/privacy
Terms of Service: https://www.canstudio.top/cangoal/agreements/terms

bluejetty:00159430:ios.description:
ProxyPics is the first-of-its-kind on-demand system for getting the location-specific pictures you need from wherever you are.
Our simple-to-use app features an online marketplace, matching users needing location-based photos with local users, ready to take snapshots. Never before has it been quicker, cheaper, or simpler to get timely images from anywhere around the world. 
NEED A PHOTO OF A SPECIFIC LOCATION, ASAP?
Enter an address, a few details about the job, and submit. Your order is instantly posted to users at the location. Within minutes, you’ll receive a photo taken just for you. Pay the low one-time fee and save the photo to your camera roll.
WANT TO TAKE PHOTOS AND EARN EXTRA CASH?
ProxyPics will notify you when photo assignments are available near your current location. Accept any nearby jobs, take the pic, submit, and get paid! Work whenever it’s convenient for you, wherever you are.
FEATURES
• The built-in map makes posting jobs easy and accurate.
• GPS and notifications alert you to nearby jobs, wherever you are.
• Online payments ensure fast delivery of funds.
• Fixed pricing finally makes on-the-spot photography super affordable.
USES
• Need a photo of a house for real estate purposes? ProxyPics users can provide the latest peek at a property.
• Want to know how long the line is for that new phone release? Let ProxyPics show you if it’s worth getting out of bed for?
• Teaching a class about Roman architecture? Can’t find a decent photo of that perfect arch? Have a local send you the precise picture from across an ocean.
• And more! The possibilities are endless. If you can point to it on a map, you can have an up-to-date photo in minutes.
We are actively working on new features and improvements to bring you a better experience.

bluejetty:00068623:ios.description:
Rain Radar Australia displays up to the minute rain and wind radar data. Full screen mode, landscape support, pinch and pan zooming, favourites list, GPS location, nearest radars list, national radar, observation layers (wind speed, wind direction, rain since 9am), plus more. 
------------------ Features ------------------ 
At start up choose to display the last radar viewed, your favourite radar, or the closest radar. No tapping, just get the radar you want to display instantaneously. 
Displays animated radar images full screen, single tap to show or hide all associated controls. 
Double tap to zoom in or out, or pinch and pan. 
Updates the available list of radars, and ranges, automatically as they become available without installing version updates. 
Displays an optional map pin at your current location if you have location services enabled. 
Displays all available radar ranges; 64km, 128km, 256km, 512km, and doppler wind. 
All available overlays can be turned on/off independently; current observations (wind speed, wind direction, rain since 9am), locations, range, districts, railways, roads, catchments, lakes & rivers, topography. 
Displays the national consolidated radar & satellite images. 
Caches static images for fast & efficient display. 
Supports landscape mode in all screens.

 • Easy feedback form to contact us

bluejetty:00147109:ios.description:
Triage 2 is first aid for everybody who struggles to stay on top of their inbox. It doesn’t try to replace traditional email software, but lets you use your downtime to quickly remove the noise and stress.
New messages appear as a familiar “stack of cards” interface. With a flick or a tap, you can quickly archive messages, keep important ones in your inbox for later, forward to somebody else, or compose a short reply.
Triage 2 supports Gmail, iCloud Mail, Fastmail or any other email service that supports IMAP.
--- 
Praise for Triage:
“Since I’ve been using Triage, I’m more caught up on my email than I have been in years.” — Daring Fireball
“Triage makes it feel seamless, and even fun, to achieve—if not Inbox Zero—at least Inbox Zen.” — Macworld
“Triage is my new favorite email app for iPhone.” — MacStories
“Triage is simple, clean, fast, and one of my new favorite apps.” — iMore

bluejetty:00166979:ios.description:

Suitable for logic lovers and casual players, relax while navigating car parking games. Get ready for a thrilling journey through puzzles and jams!
Download Car Jam 3D - Parking Jam Games now and become the hero in your own car parking saga! Drive, solve problems and relax as you conquer each traffic-jammed 3D car level!

bluejetty:00082544:ios.description:
Looking for a more flexible way to enjoy YouTube? Want to keep videos playing in the background, use Picture-in-Picture while multitasking, or simply enjoy a smoother viewing experience? Tube PiP makes watching and listening easier and more convenient.
Tube PiP is a feature-rich player designed for YouTube users, offering practical tools to enhance your everyday viewing experience.
=Feature Highlights=
* Picture-in-Picture: Keep watching videos while chatting, shopping, browsing the web, or using other apps. Multitasking has never been easier!
* Background Playback: Keep listening to music, lectures, podcasts, talk shows, and more while using other apps.
* Lock Screen Playback: Continue listening even when your screen is locked—perfect for music, podcasts, and long-form content.
* Fewer Interruptions: Enjoy a cleaner, more focused viewing experience with fewer distractions.
* Sleep Timer: Set a timer to automatically stop playback when watching videos or listening to music before bed.
* Smooth & Familiar Experience: A clean, intuitive interface makes Tube PiP simple and easy to use.
=Why Choose Tube PiP?=
* Get started for free and enjoy a range of useful features.
* Simple, clean, and easy-to-use interface.
* Enjoy Picture-in-Picture, background playback, lock screen playback, and more.
* A flexible viewing experience designed for both watching and listening.
Whether you're studying, listening to music, catching up on your favorite content, or simply relaxing, Tube PiP gives you more flexibility in how you watch and listen.
Download Tube PiP today and enjoy YouTube your way!
Terms of Service: https://tubepip.com/termofservice
Privacy Policy: https://tubepip.com/privacy

bluejetty:00124276:ios.description:
You are a monster summoner contracted with a dragon.
Travel the world to collect the stronger monsters and defeat the true enemies that threaten peace.
Let's win the battle and increase the types of monsters that can be summoned.
In a certain town you can also summon rare monsters by combining monsters with each other.
You can make dungeons using your monster and items.
You can also play dungeons made by other users and get items.
Even after clearing of game
the place where you can go will increase and PvP is released.
Rival summoners appear in various places after the monster map has been completed.
It is possible to play all without charge, no internet connection required.
* Internet connection is necessary to use PvP battles and net save etc.
Tips:
Let's talk to people in the town and the castle at first.
Let's collect fellow monsters and raise the level around the town before aiming for the first dungeon.
* Monsters that are easy to appear depending on the terrain may be different.
Let's equip to monsters, not players.
Let's report to the castle after clearing the dungeon. A new way can be opened.
* We recommend that you save to the net from time to time in case you have lost the local save data.
Special thanks
R-Do http://www.geocities.co.jp/Milano-Cat/3319/ - Monster images
Twelve constellation fragments - Effect images, battle background images
Shigeru - Icon of items
Escape http://escape.client.jp/index.html - Icon of elements
First Seed Material - Graphic materials
Loose Leaf - graphic materials
DotWorld - graphic materials
Rittor Music, others - sounds
Description of status name
MHP: Maximum HP: Can't fight if it is 0.
MMP: Maximum MP: Can't use the magic if it is 0.
ATK: Attack power: It affects damage to enemies by physical attack.
DEF: Defense power: It affects defense against enemy's physical attack.
AGL: Agility: It affects the order of action and the number of actions may increase.
MGC: Sorcery: It affects magic attack.
SPR: Spirit: It affects magic defense.
If the user has the same element as the magic element, it is strengthened by 10 to 40% depending on the element level.
Conversely, If the user has the opposite element, it is weaker by 10 to 40%.
Also, if the same element as the magic element is on the side receiving the magic attack, the damage is greatly reduced depending on the element level.
* Opposite elements
Fire/Water
Earth/Wind
Light/Dark
Supplementary explanation of the battle command.
Auto: Make that character automatically act only that turn.
Attack: Make that character attack only that turn.

bluejetty:00022344:ios.description:

• Top Plays and Moments: Relive the most memorable goals, marks, and plays from each round in curated highlight reels, including Vertical Stories & Clips
NEWS:
• Breaking News: Stay informed with the latest updates and inside stories.
• Expert Summaries: Read match previews and reviews by dedicated AFLW journalists.
• Event Coverage: Get comprehensive insights into major events like the AFLW Awards, Trade Period, and the Draft.

bluejetty:00089368:ios.description:
AirGuard identifies tiny-trackers, like Samsung SmartTags or Tiles, that are following you and forwarding your location to a third-party. 
If a tracker is detected will get a notification. 
The iPhone is able to warn you if someone uses an AirTag to track you, but there is no such protection against Samsung SmartTags or Tile trackers. 
AirGuard adds this layer of protection so you can feel safe in your daily-life. 
With the scan option, you can always scan your surroundings and discover hidden trackers. You can search for a specific tracker and it tells you how close you get to it. When you reach 100% you found the device. 
If no one is trying to track you, the app will never bother you. 
How does it work?
AirGuard uses Bluetooth scans of your iPhone to find Samsung SmartTags and Tile trackers. Every tracker that is found will be saved locally on your device. 
Whenever a tracker gets detected multiple times the app will recognize this. It compares the locations where the tracker has been detected. 
If a tracker is detected at least 3 times at different locations (to make sure its not your neighbour) the app sends you a notification. 
All this happens locally on your device and the private information, like location, tracker ids, etc will never leave your device. 
Who are we?
We are part of the Technical University of Darmstadt in Germany. This project is part of a scientific research from the Secure Mobile Networking Lab. Our goal is to protect privacy and to find out how many people are opposed to tracking.
In this app you can voluntarily participate in a research study that will share anonymized data with us. 
This app will never get monetized by showing ads, in-app purchases or anything else. It's free and open-source. 
Our privacy policy can be found here: 
https://tpe.seemoo.tu-darmstadt.de/privacy-policy.html
This app is open-source: 
https://github.com/seemoo-lab/AirGuard

We are not working together with Apple Inc.

bluejetty:00014013:ios.description:
Desygner is an all-in-one graphic design app for your phone. Make social media posts, logos, promotions, business documents, ads, flyers and more. Start from a template or a short brief, change it with a few taps, and export a file you can post, send or print. No design experience needed.
WHAT YOU CAN MAKE
• Social media posts and stories for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube
• Logos, from a monogram to a full logo suite
• Business documents such as company overviews and proposals
• Promotions: sales, discounts, promo codes, product launches and grand openings
• Ads, banners and flyers for events and announcements
• Brand identity, personal branding and customer reviews
• Business cards, menus and price lists
• Presentations, resumes, certificates and invitations
• Book covers, album covers and podcast artwork
Templates are also organised by industry: real estate, food, hotels, education, health, beauty, automotive, events and more.
A REAL DESIGN EDITOR
• Layers, text, shapes, images and multiple pages
• Fonts, photos, icons and stickers included
• Remove a photo background in one tap
• Unlimited undo and redo
AI THAT HELPS YOU FINISH
• Start from a brief when you do not know where to begin
• Generate images, text and logo ideas using AI credits
• Rewrite, shorten or translate the text in a design
BRING IN WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
Import from your iPhone or iPad, from Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive and SharePoint, or straight from your Photos.
• Import a PDF and edit the text and images inside it
• Import Word and PowerPoint documents
• Import Adobe Illustrator (AI), EPS, SVG and InDesign (IDML) artwork
• Bring in designs from other design tools and keep editing
• Merge several PDF files into one document
ORDER PRINTS WITHOUT LEAVING THE APP
Most design apps stop at a download. Desygner also prints and delivers.
• Order business cards, flyers, posters and canvas prints, delivered to your door
• Put a design on a T-shirt, hoodie, mug or tote bag and order it
• See the price and delivery country before you confirm
• Prefer your own printer? Export a print-ready PDF and download a proof first
YOUR BRAND, KEPT CONSISTENT
• Brand kit: save your logo, colours and fonts once, then apply them to any design
• Asset library: keep approved images and files in one place for your team
• Share a workspace so everyone designs from the same templates
DIGITAL BUSINESS CARD
Build a digital business card and share it with a QR code.
ON EVERY DEVICE
Start a design on your iPhone and finish it on your iPad or computer. Projects sync automatically.
EXPORT AND SHARE
• Save as PNG or JPG for social media and messaging
• Save as PDF for email, documents and printing
• Download at high resolution for print
• Share a link so other people can view the design
IF SOMETHING GOES WRONG
If a design does not come out the way you expected, message us from inside the app. We reply within one business day and fix template, export and font problems first, keeping you posted until it is done.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE DESYGNER
• A full design editor, not a photo filter app
• One app for everything your business needs, from a social post to a printed menu
• Real PDF editing and print-ready export on a phone
• A brand kit that keeps every design on brand
• Print ordering and merch built in
• Every template is free to use
PLANS
Desygner is free to download and free to use, and every template is included at no cost. The Starter, Business and Scale plans raise your allowances and add more: monthly AI credits, extra storage and team seats. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends in your Apple Account settings.
Built in Australia. Your designs stay yours.
Download Desygner and make your first post, logo or promotion today.
Privacy Policy: https://desygner.com/privacy
Terms of Service: https://desygner.com/terms

Case Tracker – USCIS Case Status, Visa Bulletin & Civics Test
Track all your USCIS cases, monitor the Visa Bulletin, and prepare for your U.S. Citizenship interview—all in one place. Whether you’re checking the status of your Green Card, H1B, EAD, I-485, I-765, I-130, I-140, N-400, OPT, or any other immigration application, Case Tracker connects to the official USCIS public system to deliver real-time updates with speed and accuracy.
Key Features
• Real-Time USCIS Status Instant, reliable case updates pulled directly from the official USCIS case status portal.
• Full Case History Timeline View every status change with dates in a clean, easy-to-read timeline.
• Track Multiple Cases Add unlimited USCIS receipt numbers and manage all cases in one secure dashboard.
• Live Visa Bulletin Check the latest State Department Visa Bulletin to track Priority Dates and Final Action Dates across all Family-Sponsored and Employment-Based categories.
• U.S. Citizenship Civics Test Prepare for your naturalization interview with full practice exams and flashcards for both the 2008 and 2025 question banks. Fully bilingual (English/Spanish) with audio support.
• Smart, Fast Interface Modern UI optimized for quick daily checks and simple navigation.
• Privacy-Focused Your receipt numbers and test progress stay on your device only. No accounts. No data collection.
Ideal For Applicants tracking Green Card, H1B, EAD, I-485, I-765, I-130, I-140, students (OPT/CPT), families, and individuals preparing for the U.S. citizenship interview.
Disclaimer 
Case Tracker is an independent tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by USCIS, the Department of State, or any U.S. government agency. Data is retrieved from publicly available government resources. Always verify information through the official USCIS and Department of State websites.

“Learning games for kids” is an educational number game for preschoolers. This app will allow toddlers to learn numbers 1 to 20 while playing entertaining mini-games. This number learning game features over 100 educational activities for your child to enjoy. Also, app will help children to develop important basic skills such as creativity, motor skills, coordination, attention, and memory.
Each number in our math game for kids has its own story. This makes the playing process diverse and exciting for toddlers. The game includes essential learning activities such as number tracing, math and counting.

The game will teach your baby to identify numbers, count them, write them and pronounce them correctly. The learning process is extremely engaging. Designed with the help of children education experts, this safe app aims to make the learning experience for kids both fun and easy. Cute animal puzzles in the app ensure that your kid will enjoy the process.

- Number learning games for kids
- Tracing and counting from 1 to 20
- Math game for preschoolers

- Over 100 educational activities for both girls and boys
- Kids number games with cute animals
- Numbers 1, 2 and 3 are available for free

bluejetty:00017437:ios.description:
Tired of the gacha life? Enter the ancient wild darkness of druid and necromancer animal jam battlegrounds...
Become a grounded master beast tamer, and capture various critters to do your bidding!
Tame battle cats, monsters, and hybrid animals and take part in the league for pocket taming games!
As a Wild Tamer, you will be able to win over enemy monster beasts to become your minion. Summon your guardian alpha wolf and become a leader of a wolf pack, or simply amass a threatening army swarm of pocket ants at your command!
Or if you are daring, perhaps you may be able to become a mystical dragon tamer... Gather unique animals and mythical creatures to become your next neopet!
Battle wild animals, successfully tame the creature, and level up your animal super squad!
Help your primitive brother in arms survive in the land of octogeddon! Dont starve to death-- don't forget that wilderness can be a growtopia!
As a forager, collect creatures and materials for wildcraft levelling up, and strengthen your army with your new wild craft weapons and artifacts!
When the oceanhorn sounds in the badland, there may be special opportunities for aquatic monsters and hidden dino bash... 
◆ Enjoy quests and leaderboards
◆ Tons of unique tamable monsters and creatures, both lovable and threatening!
◆ Special artifacts suitable for various battle styles

Explore and rediscover classic factory locations. Help the group of frien
bluejetty:00028742:ios.description:
The long-awaited finale of the Ice Scream saga is here!
Help the group of friends escape once and for all from Rod's factory and put an end to this frosty nightmare.
Explore and rediscover classic factory locations. Help the group of friends solve puzzles and overcome terrifyingly fun mini-games to escape while running away from Rod and Evil Nun.
Discover an adventure full of puzzles, chases and mysteries perfect for both new players and veterans of the saga.
After rescuing Lis from the lab, all the friends are finally reunited in the control room. But the happiness doesn't last long, because Rod has discovered Charlie and has followed him to the control room, where they are locked in. Now they must find a way out of the control room and come up with a plan to escape from the factory once and for all.
Enjoy the new update and unlock the true ending of the game by exploring the mysterious extraction room where you will reveal the last secrets of the factory, discover the events the past that led Rod to become the evil ice cream man he is today and face him in a spectacular final battle.
- New customization store: Adapt your adventures with character and weapon skins and other decorative elements.
- Final boss showdown: Face Rod in a final fight to defeat the evil ice cream man once and for all.
- New checkpoint system: progress through the game by completing different objectives and save your progress to continue your adventure whenever you want.
- Multiple villains: besides Rod and his helpers, you will have to face other enemies such as Evil Nun, Franken-Boris or Mati.
- Fun puzzles: Solve clever puzzles to reunite with your friends.
- Mini-games: Complete the most fun puzzles included in this chapter in the form of mini-games.
- Own soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the Ice Scream universe with unique music to the rhythm of the saga and voices recorded exclusively for this game.
- Explore new and old locations: Revisit the different areas of the factory and discover the secrets that remained hidden.
- Hint and quest system: If you get stuck, you have at your disposal a complete step-by-step guide so you always know what to do next. 
- Speak with your friends: Discover the history of the characters through their conversations.
- Different difficulties: Play at your own pace and explore without risk in ghost mode, or take on Rod and his helpers in different difficulty levels that will test your skill.
- A terrifyingly fun game suitable for everyone!
If you want to enjoy an experience of fantasy, terror and fun, play "Ice Scream8: Final Chapter" now. Action and scares are guaranteed.
It is recommended to play with headphones for a better experience.
Let us know what you thought in the comments!

bluejetty:00158386:ios.description:
Bring instant fun to any moment with a meme soundboard full of viral sounds, meme sounds, instant buttons, funny sound effects, and prank clips made for quick reactions. Tap your favorite sound buttons, open the fart soundboard, explore the meme board, and enjoy funny sounds anytime. Start the fun now and keep the best reactions just one tap away!
The app loads fast, feels smooth, and brings meme sound buttons to life with clean categories, loud reactions, realistic fart effects, and nonstop funny noises. You can scroll through meme sounds, unlock viral hits, save your favorites, and hit every moment with the perfect reaction. Try the funniest soundboard meme experience today and enjoy instant entertainment every time you tap!
Viral Meme Sounds and Funny Reactions
You can browse a huge mix of meme sounds, classic soundboard meme moments, funny noises, fail reactions, joke sounds, prank clips, and viral memes that people enjoy every day. The library is simple to explore, so you can move from funny memes to cool effects, switch to buzzer hits, tap a punch effect, try poop effects, or press the bruh button when the moment calls for it.
Huge Library of Instant Buttons
Browse hundreds of instant buttons and button effects that deliver quick reactions anytime you need them. From meme sound buttons to loud viral hits and softer reactions, the app keeps every funny moment close. If you enjoy realistic effects, you can open fart sounds, explore fart noises that sound real, try prank fart sounds, or simply play classic funny soundboard hits that never get old.
Prank Sounds for Every Occasion
Enjoy a full mix of prank sounds and sound pranks made for friendly jokes and lighthearted moments. Many users love switching between fart soundboard options, funny prank sounds, goofy ahh moments, troll effects, whip effects, and weird effects. The airhorn button and OMG button deliver loud reactions, while smaller meme sound buttons help you create perfect timing during chats or streams.
Custom Soundboard and Personal Meme Board
Save your favorite meme sounds and build a custom soundboard that matches your style. Pin the funniest sound buttons, collect viral hits that stand out, organize your meme board, and keep your best funny sound effects in one place. The app makes it simple to move between categories, tap through effects, and enjoy new content without slowing down.
Meme Sounds That Stay Fresh
New meme sounds, funny noises, effects, and viral memes are added regularly. You can explore popular sections, discover trending sound buttons, or jump into classic funny soundboard areas that users love the most. If you enjoy the energy of MyInstants, you will feel right at home here, with a bigger library and cleaner navigation.
Perfect for Laughter Anytime
The meme soundboard fits naturally into chats, group calls, game sessions, or any moment when you want to drop a funny reaction or a small prank. Thanks to meme sound buttons, instant buttons, and the rest of the soundboard meme collection, it always feels easy to tap the right reaction at the right time.
Download our app and jump into a world of meme sounds, instant buttons, prank sounds, funny sound effects, viral hits, custom soundboard fun, and nonstop laughs. Tap your favorite reactions, enjoy quick moments of humor anytime, and make every day a little more fun!

bluejetty:00092002:ios.description:
My Leviton connects the Leviton Decora Smart with Wi-Fi Technology product family to your iOS device as well as Amazon Alexa for voice control, no hub required! Control your lights and loads from anywhere using the free My Leviton app for iPhone and iPad. Easily replace your existing single pole or multi-way devices with the new Leviton Dimmer or Switches to allow control from anywhere via your My Leviton app. As well, you can start automating and controlling your plug-in lamps or small appliances using the Decora Smart Wi-Fi Plug-in Outlet.
Use the free My Leviton iOS app to add/name your smart devices and to control them individually or as a room with a single button push. Create schedules, scenes, and customize your experience with adjustable fade rates, maximum/minimum illumination levels, and more if desired for a truly advanced lighting control system that’s easy to use manually or via the app.
Simplify control of your home - schedule lights and connected loads to turn on/off at specific times or based on sunrise/sunset, easily group your smart devices into rooms for quick control, and create scenes to activate multiple lights at once for movie time, party mode, or goodnight.
Works with Hey Google, Amazon Alexa, and Apple Siri (HomeKit). Add an optional Amazon Alexa device to use voice commands like, “Alexa, set dining room lights to 33%.” (Echo sold separately, but there is no intermediary hub/controller required). Leverage the Leviton Decora form factor with matching color change kits, multi-way devices for hallways and staircases, multiple options for wallplates and more, to match the décor throughout your home.
Get started today with My Leviton – a growing eco-system with more partners and announcements to come!

bluejetty:00123564:ios.description:
At Portland Pie, it’s all about people.
From the farmers who grow our ingredients, to the families who share our pizza and everyone who works hard within our four walls, we’re proud to play a part in building a sustainable community. Simply put, good food brings people together. We hope you enjoy this chance to sample some of the best food around. Cheers to better ingredients, tastier food, and a stronger community.
Our Rewards Program is a growing community of locals where loyalty adds up to some pretty sweet deals.
Here's how it works: For every dollar you spend at Portland Pie, you earn one point. Once you reach 100 points, you earn $10 in PPC rewards. Keep getting points, we keep giving you rewards.
It’s that easy. Just check in with your Portland Pie mobile app each time you visit and we’ll take care of the rest. To get you started, we'll add 25 points to your account just for signing up.
And you say it’s your birthday? Cheers to that, this one’s on us! Stop in during your birthday month and enjoy a free 10” pizza.
The App is also great for ordering online, checking out our menu and find the nearest Portland Pie Co. in your community.
Welcome to the company.
