bluejetty:00180732:ios.description:
"Privat24 for business" is a mobile application for legal entities and private entrepreneurs. 
Key features:
 • Account management: view statements, monitor income and spendings, analyze cash flow.
 • Payments: pay contractors, suppliers, and partners quickly and securely. Payment templates are available for optimization.
 • Electronic document management: create and send invoices, exchange documents with suppliers.
 • Currency exchange operations: buy, sell, and convert foreign currency at the current exchange rate without visiting a bank. Enable notifications for the start of the trading session to perform necessary operations timely.
 • Tax payments: automatically receive data from the State Tax Service, pay taxes, fees, and other mandatory payments. Activate payment deadline reminders to pay on time.
 • Reporting: sign and submit reports to the State Tax Service within the app, use the Reporting calendar and automatic data completion for tax calculation.
 • Salary projects: manage salary payments to employees on PrivatBank or other Ukrainian bank cards.
 • Loans and deposits: monitor the status of loan agreements, apply for new loans, and open / replenish / close deposits online.
 • Business cards: open corporate cards, track transactions, and set limits.
 • Notifications: receive instant notifications for all incoming and outgoing funds.
 • Security: the app has enhanced fraud protection, including the use of device data to prevent unauthorized actions.
 • Instant login via Face ID / Touch ID.
 • SmartID: your qualified electronic signature for securely signing payments and documents.
The app includes a special section for connecting with PrivatBank:
 • Online chat support.
 • Option to call the bank within the app or request a callback.
 • Review the history of inquiries to the bank.
 • Reporting fraud.
 • Connect via Telegram or Viber.
We also provide sign language consultations via video chat for clients with hearing impairments.
"Privat24 for business" is your reliable assistant for managing your business from anywhere in the world. 
We are constantly improving the functionality and interface. We appreciate your feedback at: p24b_mobile@privatbank.ua

Manchester Live – United fans is the ultimate independent application built by fans, for the passionate global community of Manchester United FC supporters. This is your essential hub for everything happening in the world of English football, the Premier League, and your beloved Reds.
Stay on top of every match, goal, score, and transfer rumour surrounding Manchester United FC, whether they're playing at Old Trafford or traveling across Europe.
NOTE: This is an UNOFFICIAL application and is not endorsed by or affiliated with Manchester United Football Club.
Key Features for Every Red Devil:
Breaking MUFC News & Gossip
Get all the latest and fastest news, team updates, exclusive player and coach interviews, confirmed transfers, and the hottest transfer rumours. We gather daily updates from trusted sources so you never miss a beat of life at the club.
Real-Time Match Coverage & Detailed Stats
Follow detailed text live streams for every Manchester United game across all major competitions: Premier League (EPL), FA Cup, Champions League, Europa League, and pre-season friendlies.
Access detailed match commentary, goal scorers, cards, and substitutions.
In-depth statistics: accurate lineups, player ratings, ball possession percentages, Expected Goals (xG) metrics, shots, corners, and fouls. Stats are updated in real-time during the match to give you better insight than a standard scorecard!
Full Fixtures & Table Standings
Check the comprehensive MUFC fixture calendar: upcoming opponents (Liverpool, Man City, Chelsea, etc.), match start times, TV broadcast info, and final results.
Receive timely push notifications before matches start and for key events during the game.
Track Manchester United FC's current standing in the EPL and European tournaments.
The Global Fan Community
This app is a space where the passion for United thrives! Rate players after matches, comment on team performance, participate in polls, and debate the latest transfers and managerial decisions with fellow supporters from around the world.
Why Choose Manchester Live:
* 100% MUFC Focused: Only Manchester United news and football content. Zero distractions.
* All Competitions in One Place: Seamless coverage across all tournaments.
* Fast, Reliable Notifications and a clean, user-friendly interface.
* Completely FREE to download and use.
Download Manchester Live – United fans now and always be close to the team you love—at the stadium, at home, or on the go. Glory Glory Man United!

bluejetty:00023261:ios.description:
Rezandovoy es una propuesta que invita a vivir en clave de fe. A la escucha orante del Evangelio diario. A la mirada creyente al mundo que nos rodea.
Ofrece cada día una oración en audio (entre 12 y 15 minutos), con lecturas, silencio y músicas. Porque rezar es algo de todas las épocas, de todas las culturas, que tiene que ver con las búsquedas más universales.
Un rato cada día para escuchar de camino al trabajo, en la tranquilidad de tu habitación, paseando, al comenzar la jornada o en medio del vértigo de cada día.
Un tiempo para parar. Para escuchar. Para agradecer. Para hacer silencio y dejar que el Evangelio dialogue con lo que estás viviendo.
Porque creemos que rezar cada día va transformando la vida. Poco a poco. A veces casi sin darnos cuenta. Nos ayuda a mirar de otra manera, a reconocer lo importante, a descubrir a Dios también en lo cotidiano.
Y no lo hacemos solos. Cada día, personas de muchos lugares se encuentran alrededor de una misma oración. Una gran comunidad que para, escucha y reza contigo.
Además de la oración diaria, en Rezandovoy encontrarás oraciones para diferentes momentos de la vida, propuestas para niños y familias, exámenes del día, itinerarios, oraciones para el Camino y otros contenidos inspirados en la espiritualidad ignaciana.
Y ahora Rezandovoy se renueva.
Lo hace para seguir haciendo lo mismo: ayudarte a rezar. Pero de una manera más sencilla, más cercana y más adaptada a tu vida.
**Todo Rezandovoy, en una sola app**
Rezandovoy, Rezandovoy Infantil y Rezandovoy Camino se encuentran ahora en un mismo lugar. Una única aplicación desde la que acceder a la oración diaria y a todas las propuestas para distintas edades, momentos y caminos.
**Más sencillo. Más centrado en la oración**
Hemos renovado la aplicación para que encontrar y comenzar una oración sea todavía más fácil. Menos pasos, menos distracciones y más espacio para lo importante.
**Una oración para lo que estás viviendo**
Hay veces en las que queremos rezar, pero no sabemos muy bien por dónde empezar.
Ahora puedes contarle a Rezandovoy cómo estás o sobre qué quieres rezar y te ayudará a encontrar oraciones que puedan acompañarte: una decisión, una pérdida, algo que agradecer, una preocupación, una búsqueda, una dificultad o simplemente el deseo de encontrarte con Dios.
Porque la oración comienza muchas veces poniendo nombre a lo que llevamos dentro.
**Una nueva manera de escuchar**
También hemos cuidado especialmente el reproductor.
Mientras escuchas una oración puedes seguir su texto en pantalla, acompasado con aquello que estás oyendo. O, si lo prefieres, quitar todo lo demás y quedarte únicamente con la oración, la música y el silencio.
Y para hacer una pausa ni siquiera tienes que buscar un botón: basta con tocar la pantalla.
Pequeñas cosas para no sacarte de ese momento.
**También en tu reloj y en el coche**
Rezandovoy puede acompañarte ahora desde tu reloj y también cuando vas en el coche.
Porque la oración no sucede al margen de la vida.
Sucede en ella.
Rezandovoy es una propuesta de la Compañía de Jesús, inspirada en la espiritualidad ignaciana.
Una oración cada día.
Una comunidad que reza contigo.
Una invitación a descubrir cómo la oración puede ir transformando tu vida.

bluejetty:00086905:ios.description:
אוהבים מקדונלד'ס? ברור! בגלל זה אתם ואנחנו פה :)
אז מה צריך לדעת לגבי האפליקציה המחודשת שלנו? קודם כל - עשינו לה מתיחת פנים עם ממשק חדש ועיצוב יותר ידידותי ונוח.
מה אפשר לעשות באפפ?
להזמין מקדונלד'ס במהירות ובקלות: משלוח עד הבית, טייק אווי, ישיבה במסעדה, מק דרייב, או אפילו הגשה עד לרכב שלכם. וזה לא הכל – צוברים McCoins ויכולים להשתמש בהם להזמנה הבאה!
רוכשים וצוברים McCoins
קניתם מק באפפ או באתר, ב-25 ₪ ומעלה? צברתם McCoins! וכדאי שתצברו כמה שיותר, כי כל McCoin שווה שקל! מתחשק לכם לנצל את ה-McCoins שצברתם? פשוט סמנו את הצ'ק בוקס בסיום ההזמנה, ותחסכו כסף! (טיפ קטן בינינו, אל תספרו – לפני שתזמינו תציצו בקטגוריית McCoins+ בתפריט. אתם עלולים למצוא מוצרים בהטבות מתחלפות תמורת ה-McCoins שלכם).
חבר מק זה חבר אמת
יש לכם חברים שעוד לא הורידו את האפליקציה? זה הזמן להכיר את McDonald's Friends! הזמינו את החברים ותוכלו להרוויח עד 120 McCoins! כל מה שתצטרכו לעשות זה לשלוח להם את הקוד האישי שלכם, ותקבלו 20 McCoins על כל אחת משתי ההזמנות הראשונות של עד 3 חברים. בחישוב מהיר – תוכלו לקבל עד 120 McCoins!
מזל טוב!
חוגגים יום הולדת? באנו לחגוג יחד איתכם! מלאו את תאריך הלידה באפליקציה, וביום המיוחד תקבלו מסרון עם מתנה טעימה! *כפוף לאישור תוכן שיווקי
אוהבים לצפות בסטוריז?
מצוין, כי גם סטוריז מחכים לכם באפפ של מק! בזמן שאתם מחכים להזמנה, העבירו את הזמן עם סטוריז שמתעדכנים כל הזמן – השתתפו בסקרים, גלו עדכונים חמים ואפילו רכשו גיפטקארדס של מקדונלד'ס, לכם או לחברים.
מזמינים בביטחון
אנשי כוחות הביטחון? הרווחתם! יש לכם הנחות מיוחדות באפפ – כי מגיע לכם!
איך בוחרים סניף?
למה להתאמץ, האפליקציה תמצא עבורכם סניפים לפי הצרכים שלכם – כשרות, מק דרייב, ישיבת חוץ, ועוד.
איך משלמים?
איך שנוח לכם! אשראי, אפל פיי, גוגל פיי, ביט, פיי פל, סיבוס, גיפטקארד, תווים נטענים, שוברים וקופונים!
יש לנו ערכים
ניתן לבדוק ערכים תזונתיים של כל המוצרים שלנו, כולל אלרגנים, בתפריט ובמחשבון תזונה.
נו, הורדתם? :)

bluejetty:00044046:ios.description:
uhomes.com: Trusted Global Student Housing Platform
Find your home away from home with the uhomes.com app! Book great student accommodation near top universities is safe and easy through the app.
About uhomes.com
uhomes.com is a global platform designed specifically for international students booking off-campus accommodation near their universities. We provide safe, verified, and transparent accommodation solutions to help students find and book ideal student apartments quickly and confidently. Founded in 2015, uhomes.com has supported over 3.1 million students worldwide, with more than 410,000 successful bookings and a cumulative transaction value of $4.68 billion.
Global Coverage
uhomes.com operates across 27 countries and regions, covering more than 1,000 popular study destinations and offering over 2.4 million verified listings near 4,000+ universities worldwide. Whether you are heading to the UK, US, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, Japan, or other major study destinations, you can easily find accommodation that suits your needs.
Live Near Top Universities
Find high-quality student housing options near top universities worldwide, including the UK G5 universities (Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial College London, UCL, LSE), Australia’s Group of Eight universities (University of Sydney, University of Melbourne, UNSW), and Ivy League or top US institutions (Harvard, MIT, Princeton, Columbia, UC Berkeley, UCLA). All listings at uhomes.com are carefully curated to ensure safe, convenient, and comfortable student living.
Simple Booking Process
Booking off-campus student accommodation with uhomes.com is fast and straightforward in 3 steps:
1.Search: Filter listings by city, university, budget, room type, and amenities to find suitable options.
2.Compare & Consult: Receive personalized recommendations from 1-on-1 professional consultants. Explore properties via VR tours and live virtual viewings.
3.Book: Complete contracts and payments safely with full support throughout the process.
Why Choose uhomes.com?
• 100% Verified Listings: All properties undergo strict verification, including onsite checks or video confirmation. VR tours and AI-powered recommendations help you choose with confidence.
• Zero Agency Fees: Book directly through our platform with transparent pricing and a price-match guarantee.
• Secure Deposit Protection: Customised deposit protection aligned with local regulatory standards to ensure safety and traceability.
• Flexible Rental Options: Short-term stays, long-term rentals, sublets, and roommate matching services available.
• Multiple Room Types: En-suite rooms, Studios, 1B/2B apartments, and Homestay options.
• Trusted Partnerships: Collaborations with leading global student accommodation providers help students access exclusive offers and reliable housing.
Global Advisory Team
Our multilingual advisory team provides 24/7 1-on-1 support to assist students worldwide. With extensive international student housing experience, our professional experts help simplify every step of the booking process, regardless of your location or time zone.
Whether you are studying abroad for the first time or looking for your next student home, uhomes.com helps you find and book accommodation faster, safer, and easier.
Download the uhomes.com app today and start your student housing journey with confidence.
Visit our official website: uhomes.com

bluejetty:00138476:ios.summary: Rev up your engines for a whole new adventure with "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" – the ultimate thrill ride that transforms the world of drag racing into an extraordinary exploration of power, agility, and raw speed across diverse terrains!
bluejetty:00138476:ios.description:
Rev up your engines for a whole new adventure with "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" – the ultimate thrill ride that transforms the world of drag racing into an extraordinary exploration of power, agility, and raw speed across diverse terrains! In this groundbreaking racing game, you're not just confined to asphalt; you'll tackle the rough and tumble of off-road trails, the slick and unpredictable paths of snow-covered landscapes, the high-speed thrill of cutting through water with hydroplanes, and even the quirky challenge of racing lawn mowers. It's a game where the adrenaline never stops pumping, and every race is a test of your skill, strategy, and determination to win.
Join the Community
LIKE US ON FACEBOOK for the latest news, updates, and community events:
https://www.facebook.com/OffroadOutlawsGame
Your Experience Matters
Launching "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" is just the beginning of our journey together. Your feedback is crucial to us; it helps pave the way for improvements and enhancements. If you stumble upon any hurdles on the track, amidst the snow, or over the waves, please let us know. Your input will help us refine the game, ensuring a smoother and more exhilarating racing experience for everyone.
FEATURES
UNLIMITED CUSTOMIZATION
Embark on a customization journey that breaks all boundaries. Whether you're gearing up a hydroplane for aquatic dominance, tuning a snowmobile for precision on snow, enhancing an off-road vehicle's resilience, or boosting a lawn mower's speed for sheer novelty, the sky's the limit. Personalize your machine to mirror your racing ethos and stand out in every challenge.
CAR SHOWS
Showcase your beautifully designed racer in our diverse vehicle exhibitions. Challenge enthusiasts from around the globe, demonstrating your vehicle's supremacy in handling dirt, snow, and water. Victories in these shows bring not just glory but also rewards that highlight your engineering and design skills.
COMPETE ONLINE
Dive into the competitive spirit of online multiplayer races. With "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing," every terrain becomes a battleground for supremacy. From navigating treacherous dirt paths, snow-laden tracks, to slicing through the waves, your adaptability and skill are your tickets to the leaderboard.
DEEP TUNING SYSTEM
Master your vehicle's performance with an in-depth tuning system. Adjust everything from the suspension for snowy terrains to gear ratios for quick sprints on dirt tracks. Utilize our comprehensive dyno testing to ensure your vehicle is tuned to perfection, ready to take on any challenge thrown its way.
CRITICAL MODIFICATIONS
Progress means pushing your vehicle beyond its limits. Strategic upgrades are key to maintaining a competitive edge across all terrains. Enhance your machine with the latest technology and modifications, ensuring it's always ready to face the diverse challenges of "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing."
FREE TO PLAY
"Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" is freely accessible and supported by ads. For those seeking an uninterrupted experience, any in-game purchase will disable ads, letting you focus solely on the race.
Privacy Matters
We take your privacy seriously. Visit our Privacy Policy for more details on how we protect your information:
http://www.battlecreekgames.com/dirtdragsprivacy.htm
Terms and Conditions visit: http://www.battlecreekgames.com/dirtdragsterms.htm
Prepare to embark on an unparalleled racing adventure with "Offroad Outlaws Drag Racing" – where every turn brings a new challenge and every race is a chance to become a legend. Are you ready to prove yourself across every terrain? The ultimate off-road racing experience awaits!

This application is intended exclus
bluejetty:00118912:ios.description:
Contractor Foreman is a construction management platform used by companies to manage projects, teams, and daily operations from a single place; on phone, tablet, or computer, with no software to install.
This application is intended exclusively for registered Contractor Foreman business customers. Access is restricted to authorized users whose accounts are created and managed by their organization through an external admin panel. Individual users cannot create accounts or access services without authorization from a registered organization.
Features include:

FaceCall lets you show a short video before someone picks up your call. Say hello, show your intention, share your vibe — before the call even starts. It's how calling should feel in 2026 and beyond.

Your face becomes your caller ID.
Your intention becomes clear.
Your missed calls get AI-answered automatically.
Calling feels human again.
• Key Features
- Video Caller ID
Record a short video that plays automatically when you call someone. Say why you’re calling. Make it personal. Make it memorable.
- Caller Intention
Choose Urgent, Quick Question, Good News, Business, Family, or create your own custom tag. No more mystery calls or guessing someone's purpose.
- AI Missed-Call Assistant
If someone misses your call, FaceCall instantly sends a personalized video or message in your voice and style. Clear, friendly, instant.
- Real-Time Voice Translation
Break language barriers during live calls. FaceCall translates your conversation as you speak — naturally and instantly.
- Auto Translation
Send and receive messages with instant translation across multiple languages. Communicate effortlessly across borders.
- High-Quality Video & Voice Calls
Crystal-clear video up to HD+, fast connection speeds, and smooth performance across devices.
- Fun & Friendly Call Effects
Add effects, backgrounds, and filters to personalize your calls. Make every conversation expressive, fun, and memorable.
- Group Calls
Connect with friends, family, or your team in high-quality group video calls. Bring everyone together anytime, anywhere.
- Real-Time Screen Sharing
Share your screen instantly during a call. Show documents, presentations, photos — anything you need, live.
- Call Recording
Save important conversations, document decisions, or keep memories. Your recordings are securely stored and always under your control.
- Works With Your Contacts
Use FaceCall with or without a phone number — your privacy, your choice. No usernames. No verification codes. Instant connection.
- Share Calls With Links
Call anyone — even if they don't have FaceCall yet. Your Video Caller ID plays instantly in their browser.
- Personal Profiles
Set your video intro, choose your mood, and express your identity visually. Every call begins with you.
- Global, Secure, and Private
Calls are encrypted, your videos stay yours, and your identity remains fully in your control.
• Why People Love FaceCall
- Makes every call feel warm, human, and expressive
- Saves time with clear Caller Intention
- Removes awkward “Who's calling and why?” moments
- Helps professionals stand out instantly
- Strengthens relationships and emotional connection
- Adds clarity, personality, and depth to communication
- Works even if others don't have the app
FaceCall transforms ordinary calls into meaningful experiences.
• Perfect For
- Friends and family
- Long-distance relationships
- Parents and kids
- Creators and influencers
- Coaches, consultants, and freelancers
- Business professionals
- Anyone who wants calls to feel personal again

FaceCall isn't messaging.
It's not just calling.
It's Video Caller Identity — a new visual layer on top of your phone number.
Once you try it, regular calls feel empty.

Bring emotion, clarity, meaning, and your real identity into every call.

We're here to support you.
For questions or feedback, email support@facecall.com.
Your input helps us make FaceCall better for our community.

Have you ever forgotten your phone and experienced the frustration of not being able to find it? Look no further, ClapRing: Find Phone By Clap can help you locate your lost phone. The ClapRing: Find Phone By Clap app is easy to use and allows you to choose from different alarm sounds and adjust the sensitivity of the clap detection feature.

MAIN FEATURES of ClapRing: Find Phone By Clap:
- Clap to Find My Phone
- Phone Finder by Whistle & Finger Snap
- Moving Alarm
- Charging Alarm
- Intruder Alarm
- Custom Security Mode

Charging Alarm: Sometimes we have to charge our phone in public and someone tries to remove the charger, it will detect and start ringing loudly.
Intruder Alarm: Find out who touched and tried to unlock your phone or just play tricks on you, the camera will capture the intruder and your secrets will be safe.
Custom Security Mode: With Security feature, you can lock this app and change the icon app.You can easily lock this app to prevent unauthorized access, ensuring your personal information stays private. The new icon can be chosen from the gallery and lots of personalized icon backs.
HOW TO USE ClapRing: Find Phone By Clap:
1. Download “ClapRing: Find Phone By Clap” on the App Store and open this app.
2. Tap the “Active” button.
3. Set up other features for your phone alarm: Vibrate, sound alert, flash, time, etc.
4. Clap your hand then this lost phone finder app will detect clap when you misplace your phone.
5. This app helps recognize clapping sounds, whistles or finger snap and your phone will ring or vibrate with the flashlight.

bluejetty:00120501:ios.description:
***** Let your toddler discover world full of fun educational games and learn first words in US English, UK English, Spanish, and French.
***** Developed by an award-winning education studios, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling apps for kids, in cooperation with educational specialists to best prepare your children for success in preschool and kindergarten curriculum. 
Facilitate your child’s cognitive development and enhance his or her vocabulary with this colorful, child-friendly application from a new series developed by educational experts at 22learn. 
Children learn and have fun sorting pictures, finding the other halves of pictures, and identifying objects based on their name. Wonderful way to learn first words in English and other languages (U.S. English, U.K. English, Spanish, and French)!
================================
* 12 educational learning categories (shapes, clothes, animals, and more!)
* 180 interactive first words flash cards
* 3 engaging educational games
* Learn first words in US and UK English, Spanish, and French
================================ 
The progression of the games in the app is designed to best support learning. Children learn the words in “Sorting”, reinforce them in “Matching”, and then practice their recognition in the challenging “Find it!” game.
CHILDREN LEARN AND PRACTICE:
* Vocabulary
* Fine motor skills
* Visual identification
* Categorization
* Concentration
***** 12 Great Educational Categories***** 
* Fruit and vegetables
* Shapes
* Foods
* Colors
* Clothes
* Animals
* Wild animals
* Toys
* At home
* Outside
* Weather
*****3 Engaging educational games*****
* Sorting
Children sort cards by dragging them onto the identical pictures on the board. The name of each object on the card is pronounced as the child drags it in order to facilitate vocabulary acquisition.
* Matching
Matching challenges children to find missing halves of pictures.
* Find it!
In Find it!, children practice their vocabulary skills by tapping on a picture of a word that was pronounced.
Baby Match features professional voice-over, beautiful design, funny animations, and educational content. Based on our two-decade old experience in development of educational software, we made this app developmentally appropriate and easy to use for young children. We hope your children enjoy playing Baby Match!

bluejetty:00060968:ios.name: Call Protect: Robocall Blocker
bluejetty:00060968:ios.summary: Call Protect is a free robocall blocker with Caller ID tool that safeguards you against known telemarketers, robo callers, scammers, spammers, and other unwanted callers. With Call Protect, you can have a peace of mind whilst it silently wo
bluejetty:00060968:ios.description:
Call Protect is a free robocall blocker with Caller ID tool that safeguards you against known telemarketers, robo callers, scammers, spammers, and other unwanted callers. With Call Protect, you can have a peace of mind whilst it silently works for you to reduce the number of unsolicited phone calls you receive.
Call Protect maintains the latest database of active spam and robo callers. This list is monitored and updated in real-time. When you activate the Call Protect extension, the list of suspicious phone numbers is periodically updated onto your device. The highly-risky phone numbers that have been identified as harmful with our sophisticated algorithms are automatically blocked; while the other numbers, which may potentially be harmful, but have not been identified as such with full confidence yet, are added onto your phone with their caller ID information containing a warning message. This will alert you when you receive a phone call from such suspicious callers. These features work alongside each other to protect you against ever-evolving spammers.
Beside Call Blocking and automatic Caller ID, this app also has a Caller ID lookup feature. You may use this feature to perform a reverse phone number lookup for free on any phone number from the US and Canada. This lookup service helps you get more information about the number that is calling you. After looking up a number, you have options to call, message, or block that number. You can also add it to your phone’s contacts list directly from within the app.
Some useful features:
- Automatic spam call filter
- Caller ID information on risky numbers
- Reverse phone lookup utility
- Range-of-numbers blocker
The use of Call Protect reduces the unwanted calls you receive. It will also alert you when a potentially harmful phone number calls your phone.
In-App purchase:
Call Protect offers a monthly subscription to PRO Protection that gives you access to the PRO features that are additional to the basic free features, for a small monthly fee. You can choose to cancel the subscription at any time by going to the account settings in the App Store.
The terms of service that cover the app usage and subscriptions are available on https://callprotect.org/docs/terms_and_privacy.html.
If you like this app, please share it with your friends and family. If you think there is any feature that would improve this app and make it more useful, please send us your suggestions. We hope you enjoy Call Protect!

bluejetty:00121675:ios.summary:
Match easily as drawing lines! Play Link Flash!

Save the Gin
bluejetty:00121675:ios.description:
Match easily as drawing lines! Play Link Flash!
Check out unique features that have never existed in traditional match puzzle games! Toggle and choose the special bomb you get, connect two different colors, and many more!
Save the Gingerbread friends trapped by evil Monsters! Calling your brainpower and willingness to take on challenges in this puzzle mission. All you need us to get your spirit ready! 
Link Flash is a new game from the casual puzzle game makers of Monster Busters. In this oddly beautiful and mysterious Asian temple towers and gardens, start your puzzle journey, link as long as you can, and beat the Monsters. The simple game play where you draw lines to link Monsters will lead you to fun relaxation.
* Practice advanced link and match play rules
Link 3 or more Monsters of a kind that are neighboring each other or diagonal. You’ll see beautiful glowing lines following your magic links! The longer you connect, the more special bombs you'll create and this will power up your hero. Try connecting them to make loops, and see the high impact bombs placed as a prize.
* Strategize for different missions
Variety of mission types will keep you entertained! Climb up the Monster tower, enter into the rooms to battle, and find magical new missions like tooth cages, ice cells, cursed monster jars. Exercise your brain to come up with the best play strategies to connect as long as you can!
* Challenge the Monsters as they reinforce
Monsters keep evolving and strengthening to keep the Gingerbread. They will throw stormy clouds, sticky spider nets, tangling chains on your way. Your brain will be teased as you’re introduced to new Monsters in different episodes and try to break the puzzles. 
* Enjoy beautiful and unique Asia-themed artwork
Monsters built their hive in a faraway Asian temple tower to trap Gingerbread friends. You’ll embark on an adventure to explore fully of exotic and charming Asian universe. Enter into the mysterious rooms decorated with paper lanterns and Asian totems. Draw your lines to see glowing effect and win. 
* Play with friends, compete and help
You’re not the only one in this challenging adventure! Find your friends that are already playing or invite your own friends to enjoy this magical journey. Connect with the amazing fans of Monster Busters on Facebook, and join the gang. You can exchange gifts and share hearts to continue your adventure.
Features:
- Unique match game play by drawing lines to link Monster tiles
- Receive coins from every stage you beat, and use them for special weapons and lives
- Items and coins purchases are available as you need
- Various missions and monster blockers offered and will be added to work out your brain
- Over 1500 stages of fun and excitement
- Pick your favorite avatar hero from the selection of adorable kids
- Achieve different goals, and receive worthwhile badges into your collection
* We are collecting advertising identifiers for marketing purposes.
If you don't want to collect, you can stop collecting in the way below.
- Device settings -> Privacy -> Tracking -> allow Apps to Request to Track

bluejetty:00132364:ios.name: Mastodon
bluejetty:00132364:ios.summary:
Mastodon is the best way to keep up with what’s happening. Follow anyone across the fediverse and see it all in chronological order. No algorithms, ads, or clickbait in sight.
This is the official iOS app for Mastodon. In our app, you can:
bluejetty:00132364:ios.description:
Mastodon is the best way to keep up with what’s happening. Follow anyone across the fediverse and see it all in chronological order. No algorithms, ads, or clickbait in sight.
This is the official iOS app for Mastodon. In our app, you can:
EXPLORE
■ Discover new writers, journalists, artists, photographers, scientists and more
■ See what’s happening in the world
READ
■ Keep up with people you care about in a chronological feed with no interruptions
■ Follow hashtags to keep up with specific topics in real time
CREATE
■ Post to your followers or the whole world, with polls, high quality images and videos
■ Participate in interesting conversations with other people
CURATE
■ Create lists of people to never miss a post
■ Filter words or phrases to control what you do and don’t want to see
AND MORE!
■ Login and switch between multiple accounts
■ No spoilers! You can put your posts behind content warnings
A POWERFUL PUBLISHING PLATFORM
You no longer have to try and appease an opaque algorithm that decides if your friends are going to see what you posted. If they follow you, they’ll see it.
If you publish it to the open web, it’s accessible on the open web. You can safely share links to Mastodon in the knowledge that anyone will be able to read them without logging in.
Between threads, polls, high quality images, videos, audio, and content warnings, Mastodon offers plenty of ways to express yourself in a way that suits you.
A POWERFUL READING PLATFORM
We don’t need to show you ads, so we don’t need to keep you in our app. Mastodon has the richest selection of 3rd party apps and integrations so you can choose the experience that fits you best. 
Thanks to the chronological home feed, it’s easy to tell when you’ve caught up on all updates and can move on to something else.
No need to worry that a misclick will ruin your recommendations forever. We don’t guess what you want to see, we let you control it.
PROTOCOLS, NOT PLATFORMS
Mastodon is not like a traditional social media platform, but is built on a decentralized protocol. You can sign up on our official server, or choose a 3rd party to host your data and moderate your experience.
Thanks to the common protocol, no matter what you choose, you can communicate seamlessly with people on other Mastodon servers. But there’s more: With just one account, you can communicate with people from other fediverse platforms.
Not happy with your choice? You can always switch to a different Mastodon server while taking your followers with you. For advanced users, you can even host your data on your own infrastructure, since Mastodon is open-source.
NON-PROFIT IN NATURE
Mastodon is a registered non-profit in the US and Germany. We are not motivated by extracting monetary value from the platform, but by what’s best for the platform.
AS FEATURED IN: TIME, Forbes, Wired, The Guardian, CNN, The Verge, TechCrunch, Financial Times, Gizmodo, PCMAG.com, and more.

bluejetty:00156584:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00156584:ios.description:
Parou, ativou a Zona Azul! Compre e ative seu cartão zona azul de forma 100% digital 32x mais barato do que uma multa. É tranquilidade e economia para você. 
Renove o seu tempo de onde estiver, pagando com o cartão de crédito ou débito. Além disso, veja o mapa de ocupação das ruas em tempo real para estacionar com toda a tranquilidade. É todo o conforto e segurança na palma da sua mão.
O melhor de tudo é ter esse conforto e segurança na palma da sua mão.
Desde novembro de 2020, a Estapar é a responsável exclusiva pelos serviços da Zona Azul na cidade de São Paulo. Baixe o nosso app para comprar o seu CAD (Cartão Azul Digital) e pague seu estacionamento com segurança, agilidade e praticidade!
Pelo app, você tem acesso a todas as funcionalidades para estacionar seu carro. Veja como é fácil utilizar o aplicativo:
- Baixe o app e cadastre seu nome, telefone, CPF, e-mail e uma senha;
- Confirme o setor onde irá estacionar o veículo ou digite o local desejado no campo de busca;
- Cadastre um novo veículo;
- Selecione o tempo desejado;
- Insira um cartão de crédito ou débito e pronto, estacione!
Conheça as vantagens de utilizar o app Estapar:
- Estacione com segurança
A Estapar é a nova e única responsável pela gestão e operação do serviço de Zona Azul Digital na capital paulista, e você conta com muitos benefícios. Com a chegada da Estapar, você tem a garantia de rotatividade das vagas de estacionamento CET, além de mais comodidade e facilidade na hora de estacionar seu veículo e comprar cartão azul digital.
- Mapa de Ocupação
Agora você encontra vagas para estacionar seu veículo pela cidade de São Paulo com mais comodidade e agilidade através do nosso mapa que mostra a ocupação de vagas em tempo real no estacionamento rotativo CET nas ruas.
- Carteira Virtual
Agora ficou mais fácil comprar créditos ou CADs pelo app. Você pode deixá-los em sua carteira virtual e utilizar quando quiser, seja para pagar estacionamento CET ou renovar o seu 
- CAD.
Ativação 100% Digital
Com o novo app da Estapar, você continua comprando Cartão Azul Digital (CAD) e o ativando diretamente pelo celular, de um jeito fácil e prático para utilizar o estacionamento rotativo CET em SP.
- Renovação a Distância
Quando o seu CAD estiver próximo de vencer, nós te avisaremos e você poderá renovar de onde você estiver, sem a necessidade de retornar ao veículo utilizando os créditos da sua carteira virtual ou cartão de crédito.
- Estacione com Zona Azul Digital Para Empresas
Também temos a solução ideal para a sua empresa. Acompanhe em tempo real os gastos da sua frota e defina por colaborador os limites de uso diários, semanais ou mensais de CADs no estacionamento CET. Além do app, você conta com um portal exclusivo para controle da Zona Azul digital de sua equipe para estacionar carro em São Paulo - SP.
O app oferece recursos para comprar e renovar tíquete de estacionamento CET sem precisar utilizar o comércio local. Baixe o app e tenha todas as facilidades para estacionar veículo, utilizar o estacionamento rotativo CET da cidade, comprar CAD e muito mais!
Aonde quer que você vá, Zona Azul e Estapar!
Saiba mais sobre o aplicativo e a portabilidade do Saldo de CADs em nosso site: www.estapar.com.br/novazonaazulsp

bluejetty:00120081:ios.description:
Về ứng dụng này
Edu.One là phần mềm do VIETTEL phát triển và sở hữu.
Đây là phần mềm chuyên dùng cho giáo dục, được phát triển vì mục tiêu giáo dục.
Edu.One được tạo ra để phục vụ việc xây dựng hệ thống Kênh thông tin chuyên dùng cho Ngành giáo dục, bao gồm: Kênh thông tin trực tiếp từ Sở GD&ĐT đến Học sinh và Phụ huynh toàn tỉnh, Kênh thông tin trực tiếp từ Phòng GD&ĐT đến Học sinh và Phụ huynh toàn huyện, Kênh thông tin trực tiếp từ Ban Giám hiệu nhà trường đến Học sinh và Phụ huynh toàn trường, Kênh thông tin trực tiếp từ Giáo viên đến Học sinh và Phụ huynh của lớp mình phụ trách giảng dạy hoặc chủ nhiệm.
Edu.One làm cho nhiều quy trình thực hiện công việc ở các nhà trường trở nên rất đơn giản, giải phóng hầu hết nhân công so với trước. Ví dụ như: Thủ tục xin nghỉ học, công bố Thời khóa biểu, công bố thông tin Báo bài,...
Edu.One còn giúp mỗi Học sinh được sở hữu kho thông tin đầy đủ nhất về kết quả học tập, về quá trình học tập của mình. Với “các con số biết nói”, các em Học sinh sẽ thấy ngay được thứ hạng của mình so với các bạn trong lớp, trong trường,… khi nhìn vào kết quả học tập trên Edu.One. Nó cũng giúp các bậc Phụ huynh có được những góc nhìn, phân tích, định hướng xác thực để giúp con mình khắc phục điểm yếu, phát huy điểm mạnh trong học tập và rèn luyện.

bluejetty:00079594:ios.description:
THE EASIEST WAY TO DEAL WITH MULTIPLE TIMEZONES + INTERACTIVE WIDGETS
Sick of screwing up meeting times and missing calls? This app cuts through time-zone confusion and hands you the perfect hour at a glance.
Forget guesswork — just click, connect, and impress.
KEY FEATURES
EVENT SCHEDULING MADE EASY
Found the perfect meeting time? Add events to your calendar with just a tap, and never miss an international webinar, call, or special moment again.
ATOMIC ACCURACY
No drift, no guesswork. Each second syncs with the atomic standard, so you can trust every moment. Extensive Time Zone Database: Tap into over 160,000 locations and time zones including GMT, UTC, and more.
UNIFIED CLOCK FACE
View all your essential time zones at a glance on one beautifully designed, customizable clock face. Whether you prefer digital or analog displays (or even military time), everything is exactly where you need it.
INTERACTIVE TIME CONVERSION
Convert times instantly by simply twisting or swiping across the clock face. Watch as your selected time zones update in real time—making planning international calls, meetings, or travel effortless.
DYNAMIC WIDGETS
Access global times without even opening the app. Our interactive home screen widget lets you drag a simple line to reveal and convert times, ensuring you’re always in sync no matter where you are.
LIST MODE
Get a clean, text-based view of all your cities in one column. See times and dates at a glance, and scroll to check future or past hours. It’s a no-fuss way to track the world’s clocks.
FEELS LIKE A LUXURY TIMEPIECE
We poured effort into details most people never notice — and we’re okay with that.
Our users aren’t “most people.”
Details include: 
— Real Moon Phases
— Real Moon Rotation
— Real Sunrise & Sunset
— Advanced City Lights
— Haptic Feedback
* * * 
World Clock Master offers a premium subscription:
Subscribe to get access to unlimited timezones, interactive widgets, customizations, and timely automatic updates of our timezone database of more than 160,000 locations and timezones.
– Length of subscription: 1 month or 1 year
– Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
– Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
– Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
– Terms & Conditions: https://timemaster.s3.amazonaws.com/Time-master-terms.pdf

bluejetty:00179077:ios.name: The Ultimate Buzzer Pro
bluejetty:00179077:ios.summary:
Every sound, every mode and not a single ad.
The Ultimate Buzzer Pro is the complete version of The Ultimate Buzzer: a big red button and more than 85 sound effects for game nights, classrooms, parties, pranks and the occasional perfectly
bluejetty:00179077:ios.description:
Every sound, every mode and not a single ad.
The Ultimate Buzzer Pro is the complete version of The Ultimate Buzzer: a big red button and more than 85 sound effects for game nights, classrooms, parties, pranks and the occasional perfectly timed rimshot. Tap a sound and it plays right away. Tap a few and they play together.
PICK HOW IT WORKS
• Multi Sound: a grid of sounds you can tap as fast as you like, even several at once.
• Big Button: pick a sound and it fills the screen as one giant button. Made for trivia, quizzes and anyone who likes to slam things.
• Dual Big Button: two giant buttons side by side on iPad, or on iPhone Duo when it's open, for head-to-head rounds.
HOST A GAME SHOW
Turn trivia night into a real game show for up to 8 players. Players open The Ultimate Buzzer or The Ultimate Buzzer Pro on their own iPhone or iPad and buzz in. You see who was first, down to a fraction of a second, mark the answer right or wrong and keep score, or turn on Play Too and buzz in yourself. Set the points, decide whether wrong answers cost points, and let players pick their own color and buzzer sound. When the game ends, everyone sees the final standings with confetti, plus a results card to share or save to Photos. Everyone connects over your local network, so nobody needs an account.
RECORD YOUR OWN
Turn a laugh, a catchphrase or the dog's bark into a button. Recordings can be up to 10 seconds, with a live waveform while you record. Silence is trimmed automatically, and your sounds sync to your other devices through iCloud. You can also import an audio file as a sound, and share your recordings with friends.
KIDS MODE
Big, bouncy buttons with animals, trains and other favorites, five themes (Rainbow, Ocean, Space, Jungle and Candy) and stars and trophies to earn. A grown-up has to solve a math problem to leave, and you can set the app to open straight into Kids Mode.
A SOUND FOR EVERYTHING
Buzzer, applause, drum roll, rimshot, wah-wah, epic fail, siren, alarm clock, countdown, crickets, cuckoo clock, rooster, cow, UFO and plenty more. They're sorted into Alarms, Animals, Vehicles, Funny, Action, Effects, Around the House and Nature, and you can search or keep your favorites at the top.
THE LITTLE EXTRAS
• SharePlay: on a FaceTime call, tap a sound and everyone hears it.
• Siri, Shortcuts and Control Center: play a sound without opening the app.
• A flashlight button for when the lights go out.
• Pick any accent color and the whole app follows.
All sounds are in the public domain.

bluejetty:00166271:ios.description:
Cross Number is the BEST FREE Cross Math Puzzle Game for you! Train your logic and concentration skills, and try to beat your high score in the cross math game!
Our math logic game offers thousands of challenging number puzzles that tests your problem-solving skills. Try this mobile version of the pen and paper game from your childhood and immerse yourself in the world of math number games!
Cross Number is a puzzle game that combines elements of crossword puzzles and mathematics. Your goal is to fill in the grid with numbers that satisfy both the mathematical equations and the constraints of the grid. Read the rules, identify constraints, begin with unique clues, use combination of logical deduction and trial and error to solve the puzzle now!
Cross Number Features:
- Various Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert to fit your needs
- Use addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to complete the math puzzle
- Large Numbers: Worried about small numbers? No problem! Enable the Large Fonts to ensure an eye-friendly interface
- Daily Challenges: Play every day, complete daily challenges for a given month, and win unique trophies
- Seasonal Events: Take part in game events and open exclusive postcards
- No time limit, so no rush, just relax playing math number games
- Useful hints to help you when you’re stuck solving these free math games
- Enjoy your number game experience with the minimalistic and simple design
- Offline Mode: Enjoy the puzzle game without Wi-Fi or internet connectivity

bluejetty:00062683:ios.description:
Practice Chinese writing with Skritter, whether you have a strong grasp of written Chinese and want to remember the characters better or are a beginner who doesn’t know where to start.
Skritter has existed for more than 10 years, and for a good reason: our learners are amazing! They help us with feedback which allows us to create what we think is the best Chinese writing app out there!
If you have seen Chinese writing before, you probably noticed that it requires us to learn characters rather than the roman alphabet we know from English. You can learn it through our “decks” (similar to a card deck) based on topics and difficulty.
Popular Decks:
- Ordering or making coffee or tea (so you can get your morning caffeine fix)
- Chinese Stroke Order
- HSK 1-6 & New HSK3.0 1-9 study decks
- More advanced topics like Yoga and talking about your Emotions
- The 16-episode Ultimate Chinese Character course
First, you learn a character’s meaning, reading, and tone; then practice writing it! Before you know it, you’ll want to learn thousands of characters, and words like these two happy users:
“If I could only keep one app on my iPod, this would be it without a doubt. Skritter will change your life!”
― Wendy Werneth, UN Translator
“Learning to write characters has never been so fun. From writing zero to 2000+ characters in six months!”
― Brian Jackson, Economist
Try our app and see for yourself why thousands of people use it every day.
Have questions, problems, or feedback? We would love to hear from you. Reach out to us at team@skritter.com

bluejetty:00133671:ios.summary:
Think of Trinity Metro On-Demand as a whole new way to get around Fort Worth — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other
bluejetty:00133671:ios.description:
Think of Trinity Metro On-Demand as a whole new way to get around Fort Worth — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, affordable, and green.
With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save cash and reduce carbon emissions.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said. Eligible users can also pay using pre-tax transit dollars through approved commuter benefit debit cards.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at trinitymetro-support@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00078726:ios.name: Spark - Ren'Py Novels
bluejetty:00078726:ios.summary:
Spark: The Essential Tool for Managing Ren'Py Visual Novels
Spark is an independent utility for organizing and launching Ren'Py visual novels. It is not affiliated with or supported by the official Ren'Py project. For any issues with this
bluejetty:00078726:ios.description:
Spark: The Essential Tool for Managing Ren'Py Visual Novels
Spark is an independent utility for organizing and launching Ren'Py visual novels. It is not affiliated with or supported by the official Ren'Py project. For any issues with this app, please contact Spark support, not the Ren'Py team.
Launch and Play Your Novels with Ease
Import and start your favorite Ren'Py visual novels directly in Spark. Once added, your titles are ready to launch with a tap, so you can focus on reading and playing instead of manual setup.
Tailored Compatibility for Each Novel
Choose from multiple Ren'Py engine versions to match your novel and improve stability:
8.x: 8.5.4, 8.5.2, 8.5.0, 8.4.1, 8.3.7, 8.3.4, 8.2.3, 8.1.3, 8.0.3 
7.x: 7.8.8, 7.8.4, 7.7.3, 7.6.3, 7.5.3, 7.4.11 
Per-novel configuration lets you:
- Select the best Ren'Py version for each title
- Fine-tune settings to improve quality of life.
- Improve performance on complex or older games
Note: Performance and compatibility vary by novel. Older titles or very large games may contain bugs or fail to run. Smaller devices can experience rendering issues. Some novels may not work at all, though we strive to support as many as possible.
Powerful Save Management
Take full control of your progress across all novels:
- View all saves in one place instead of hunting through folders
- Backup saves before big choices or endings so you can revisit them anytime
- Restore old saves if something breaks or you want to replay a specific branch
- Import saves from other devices and delete unwanted saves to keep things tidy
Organize Your Entire Library
Keep your Ren'Py collection clean and easy to navigate:
- See all installed novels at a glance
- Rename titles to match your personal library style
- Manage multiple versions of the same novel, such as different language patches or updated builds
Flexible Novel Import
Add new novels from a variety of common formats:
- Import from zip, apk, 7z, tar, or rar files
- Quickly bring in titles from backups, downloads, or other devices
Once imported, novels become part of your Spark library with version and save management ready to use.
Ren'Py-Specific Tools and Enhancements
Dig deeper into your visual novels with advanced utilities:
Gallery Viewer
- Browse novel assets directly inside Spark
- View\Play images, videos, and music used by the game
Variable Editor
- View and edit game variables while playing
- Skip grinding, fix bugged flags, or jump to specific routes by adjusting in-game values
On-Device Translation
- Translate novels using Apple’s on-device translation system
- Make foreign-language titles more approachable without leaving the app
- Keep translations private and fast by staying on your device
Your Gateway to the Ren'Py Visual Novel Universe
While Spark is not affiliated with Ren'Py, it is designed as a powerful companion for players who want full control over how they install, launch, customize, and maintain their Ren'Py visual novels in one place.
Additional Licensing Information
Ren'Py includes free software licensed under various terms, including the GNU Lesser General Public License. For a complete list of included software and license details, please visit the official Ren'Py website.
Terms of Use
https://spark.devl.ai/reference/terms/

bluejetty:00179698:ios.summary:
ShockWave is a monophonic Synthesizer designed to bring modular style workflow to the world of iOS & AUv3 plugins. 
Built around the concept of Phase Distortion (PD) Synthesis, Shockwave includes a pair of PD Oscillators each capable of cr
bluejetty:00179698:ios.description:
ShockWave is a monophonic Synthesizer designed to bring modular style workflow to the world of iOS & AUv3 plugins. 
Built around the concept of Phase Distortion (PD) Synthesis, Shockwave includes a pair of PD Oscillators each capable of creating everything from pure Sine Waves over smooth Sawtooth and Square Waves to Resonance & Sync sweeps, filtered Noise and more. 
In addition to the Synth Voice, ShockWave includes a dedicated control section housing a pair of 8 step sequencers, a sample & hold module as well modules for trigger divisions, logic comparisons and controlled randomness. 
A pair of Low Frequency Oscillators and 2 Attack/Sustain/Release (ASR) Envelopes serve as main modulation sources and can be used in a number of ways. Envelopes can be triggered from a number of internal sources including other modules such as trigger divider, logic or chance module but can also be connected to each other allowing for a wide range of patches usually only possible in large modular systems. LFOs are individually tempo sync-able and capable of producing total of 5 different waveforms each.
The two sequencers can run independently or combine to one 16 step sequence where rate and length can be controlled independently for each of the two. 
In true modular nature almost any control within ShockWave can be modulated with up to 11 sources - simultaneously. Modulations are setup simply by holding a control and dialling in the desired amount in a list of all available sources. A special X-Ray mode adds a realtime display of all currently active modulations right at their corresponding control making it easy to understand what's happening inside the synthesizer at any given time. 
Synth Voice and Control Section are accompanied by built-in Delay and Reverb sections placed on send busses with all of their controls including the send levels being available as mod destinations. 
Last but not least, ShockWave features a solid MIDI implementation including support for, aftertouch, velocity, wheels, custom CC mappings and up to 4 dimensions of expression when using MPE compatible controllers, such as the Roli Seaboard, Linnstrument, Geoshred, KB-1 and others. 
MIDI Output is supported as well and includes Note and Control Change output generated from various internal sources including Sequencers, Envelopes and LFOs making it possible to control external MIDI gear or chain multiple plugin instances for advanced, self driving patches. 
Overview:
- Semi Modular Monophonic Synth Voice
- Phase Distortion Synthesis (PD)
- Dual PD Oscillators with 5 Waveforms + Noise 
- Dual ASR Envelopes with variable trigger source 
- Dual LFO with Tempo Sync
- Cross Modulation with Linear/Exp. FM, PM, AM & RM
- Mixer section with individual pan and level controls per oscillator
- Output VCA with variable control source 
- Pattern Generator for generating sequences from various internal sources
- Quantizer to force note input into a specific scale (19 Scales + User Scales)
- Step Sequencer with 2x8 or 1x16 steps, individual rate and number of steps per row 
- Trigger Divider for dividing internal trigger sources 
- Probability Gate for adding controlled randomness 
- Sample & Hold for additional randomness 
- Logic Module to create triggers from various internal sources 
- Built-in Delay & Reverb Effects 
- MIDI Note and CC output for controlling external gear or chaining multiple instances 
- Semi Modular Architecture 
- 11 Modulation Sources 
- 40 Modulation Destinations 
- 2 Color Themes 
MIDI Input:
- 4D Expression (Glide, Slide, Pressure & Velocity)
- Mod & Pitch-Wheel 
- Tempo Sync
- Custom CC Control
MIDI Output:
- Note
- Control Change 
Connectivity:
- Standalone
- AUv3
- AudioBus
- IAA

bluejetty:00024062:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Enter the fantasy realm of SKIDOS Fantasy World - a magical land with mystical creatures on every path! Explore your kingdom & meet 60+ characters & help them with fun activities along the way! 
Among the countless experiences offered, you will be able to:
-Visit a dragon island & create your dragons
- Mix & match to create new creatures in the polymorph lab
- Find hidden keys & jewels
- Cook royal banquets for your kingdom
- Enjoy soccer high above the clouds
- Design dresses for a princess
- Meet fairy creatures, like trolls, gnomes, witches, dragons, and much more!
Fantasy World will help your kids unleash their creativity while strengthening their math skills through learning tasks designed by teachers, like in all the other 40+ SKIDOS games.
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment for premium users, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00179046:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00179046:ios.description:
Map My Walk – Your All-in-One Walking Tracker & Fitness App
Whether you're just starting your fitness journey or aiming for your daily 10,000 steps, Map My Walk is the complete Walking Tracker to help you build healthy habits and stay motivated. From indoor walking to outdoor hikes, this app tracks every step, pace, calorie, and distance to keep your goals on track.
Map My Walk offers powerful GPS tracking, progress insights, and a vibrant community of millions. It’s the perfect walk tracker whether you’re walking for fun, weight loss, or marathon prep.
Now with personalized Form Coaching tips for Garmin users to help you walk smarter and improve your stride.
TRACK AND MAP YOUR WALK & EVERY STEP YOU TAKE
- Use the built-in Walking Tracker to follow your walk with real-time GPS and a full walking map of your route
- Get audio updates on pace, distance, duration, and calories
- Track over 600+ activities including walking, treadmill walking, indoor workouts, and more
- Use the Routes feature to discover new paths or save your favorite walks
- Works perfectly for outdoor walking or walk at home routines
- Sync with your step counter, Apple Watch and other smartwatches, and select health apps for complete tracking
Whether you're using a mile tracker for distance goals or a pedometer to count your daily steps, this Walking Tracker has it all.
ANALYZE YOUR WALKING PERFORMANCE ON EVERY MILE
- View detailed stats like pace, elevation, heart rate, and calories
- Set personal goals and see your progress with the steps tracker
- Use the step tracker to stay motivated and consistent
- Track your progress toward your walking for weight loss goals
- See your total daily steps and how close you are to 10,000!
From casual walks to structured routines, Map My Walk is the best free walking tracker for tracking improvement.
CONNECT WITH DEVICES AND WEARBALES
- Sync your walks with Garmin, Apple Watch, and other wearables
- Connect to Apple Health for accurate heart rate, activity ring updates, and calories burned
- Use Bluetooth to enhance tracking and performance feedback
- Works great for indoor or treadmill walking routines
Whether you're walking outdoors or inside, the Walking Tracker app keeps your data consistent and complete.
JOIN FUN WALKING CHALLENGES
- Participate in regular walking challenges to stay motivated
- Compete with friends, set records, and earn badges
- Share your workouts and achievements on social media
- Get inspired by a supportive global community of walkers and fitness fans
Push your limits or enjoy a daily stroll — Map My Walk supports every kind of walk tracker goal.
TAKE YOUR WALKS FURTHER WITH MVP PREMIUM FEATURES
Upgrade your Map My Walk: Walking Tracker to MVP and unlock the best tools to turn your goals into achievable plans:
- Create a personalized walking for weight loss or fitness plan
- Use Live Tracking to share your real-time walk with friends and family so you can stay safe and connected—perfect for hikes and long walks.
- Analyze heart rate zones to adjust intensity based on your goals
- Create custom splits to measure specific distances with precision
- Unlock deeper insights and premium performance tools
Note: Continued use of GPS in the background can reduce battery life.
READY TO WALK?
Download Map My Walk today, the walking app free designed to help you take control of your fitness with every step. Whether you're using a step counter, walking for heart health, or simply looking for a reliable Walking Tracker, this app keeps you moving in the right direction.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00063455:ios.summary:
Governor of Poker brings Texas Holdem to the Wild West in a free-to-play poker experience full of competition, progression, and variety.
Take your seat at the table, play with friends, join tournaments, and explore a poker world that goes
bluejetty:00063455:ios.description:
Governor of Poker brings Texas Holdem to the Wild West in a free-to-play poker experience full of competition, progression, and variety.
Take your seat at the table, play with friends, join tournaments, and explore a poker world that goes beyond standard Texas Holdem. Whether you’re here for casual poker, competitive events, or extra modes like Blackjack 21, slots, and dice games, Governor of Poker gives you plenty of ways to play.
Start with a Big Welcome Package
Begin your adventure with free poker chips, gold, and an avatar hat, then keep going with daily rewards and regular bonuses. Collect free chips every few hours, spin the bonus slot machine, and unlock more as you play.
Explore the Wild West
Travel through Texas, take on stronger opponents, and play for higher stakes as you progress. From cash games to tournaments, every stop brings new challenges, greater rewards, and more poker action.
More Than Just Poker
Governor of Poker includes a variety of game modes alongside Texas Holdem:
 * Cash games
 * Sit & Go tournaments
 * Spin & Play
 * Heads Up Challenge
 * Push or Fold with Royal Poker
 * No-limit and Pot Limit
 * Blackjack 21
 * Dice games
 * Slots
 * Other poker and card games
Play Socially
Join a community of poker players, team up with friends, and take part in missions, challenges, and PvP poker tournaments. You can join casual or competitive teams, meet new players, and enjoy a more social side of the game as you play.
Special Features and Events
Take on Foxy in Ultimate Poker, our take on Ultimate Hold’em. Outsmart the house, show off your poker face, and prove you’re the Ultimate Governor in the Wild West.
Try Chuck A Luck to roll the dice across the Wild West and unlock rewards.
Complete weekly and monthly missions and take part in live events with fresh challenges and rewards.
Collect and Show Your Progress
Earn rings, hats, and pins to show off your poker skills and social status at the table. As you climb the leaderboard, you can use them to show off your progress and standing.
Play Anytime, Anywhere
Enjoy Governor of Poker on mobile, tablet, or desktop. You can keep playing wherever you are, with a seamless multi-platform experience in your own language.
Fair Play
Governor of Poker uses industry-standard RNG methods to support fair gameplay.
Governor of Poker is intended for those 21 and older for amusement purposes only and does not offer real money gambling, or an opportunity to win real money or real prizes based on gameplay. Playing or success in this game does not imply future success at real money gambling.
Governor of Poker does not require payment to download and play, but it also allows you to purchase virtual items with real money inside the game. You can disable in-app purchases in your device’s settings. Governor of Poker may also contain advertising. You may require an internet connection to play Governor of Poker and access its social features. You can also find more information about the functionality, compatibility, and interoperability of Governor of Poker in the above description and additional App Store information.
By downloading this game, you agree to future game updates as released on your app store or social network. You may choose to update this game, but if you do not update, your game experience and functionalities may be reduced.
Terms of Service: https://www.playtika.com/terms-service 
Privacy Notice: https://www.playtika.com/privacy-notice

bluejetty:00100678:ios.description:
More than 1 million people read, listen, and learn the key concepts of the best books, audiobooks and podcasts every day on 4books in more than 15 different categories (business, psychology, investments, leadership, history ...).
Start expanding your knowledge in just 15 minutes with the best books, audiobooks, and podcasts in Italian.
Choose the content you want to read, or listen to in audiobook format.
4books is the mobile app that enables you to listen to exclusive audiobooks, news, and podcasts and learn effortlessly, while doing other activities. On 4books you will also find news, current events, and tools that will help you stay up to date with what’s going on in the world.
BECOME MORE KNOWLEDGEABLE AND LEARN THE KEY CONCEPTS OF A SELECTION OF THE BEST BOOKS IN THE WORLD
- Listen to the best bits from our titles selected from the world international bestseller charts. Choose from more than 15 categories of audiobooks.
- Choose whether to enhance your knowledge on business, marketing, finance or even psychology, mindfulness, startups and much more, with our collection of books, podcasts, and audiobooks.
- Decide whether to read one of the many books in our library, or listen to the audiobook version.
- Explore our archive, made up of hundreds of books hand-selected by our team put together by our founder, Marco Montemagno.
- Read content directly on all your devices. Need to put your reading on pause? No problem, on 4books you can pick up directly from where you left off, at any time.
DISCOVER EXCLUSIVE PODCASTS READ DIRECTLY BY OUR PROFESSIONAL ACTORS
- You can find exclusive podcasts on hot topics or concepts to learn while having fun.
- Our selection is constantly updated, and includes in-depth studies on philosophy, geopolitics, neuroscience, and many more.
STAY UP TO DATE ON KEY STORIES FROM THE DAILY NEWS
- In 4books you can listen to the key stories from the daily news wherever you are.
- We offer a roundup of world news in our international press review, also available in Italian.
- Choose to receive the daily newsletter or to read your updates on the 4books app.
DON’T HOLD YOURSELF BACK
- Learning has no limits with 4books. Learn where and when you want with our audiobooks, podcasts, and written books analyses. Use 4books from a mobile or from the web and access content in audio or text format. 
- Take the 4books app to the gym, on vacation, while you're in the car or out walking the dog. Learn quickly, wherever you are, thanks to our audio books available in short summaries.
- As soon as you find the book that's right for you, you can download it offline, so you can use it even when you don't have a data connection. You can also take notes and create your own library of favourites.
Terms and Conditions of Use
https://www.4books.com/en/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy
https://4books.com/en/privacy

bluejetty:00146059:ios.developer: TERRA SOFTWARE SERVICES SOLUTION PTE. LTD.
bluejetty:00146059:ios.summary:
THE INTERPLANETARY WAR OF 2100: BECOME EARTH'S LAST HOPE!

bluejetty:00146059:ios.description:
THE INTERPLANETARY WAR OF 2100: BECOME EARTH'S LAST HOPE!
A rogue planetoid is tearing through space on a collision course with our world. Standard tech has failed. Humanity's ultimate countermeasure? Deploying an elite vanguard of legendary heroes equipped with unstable mystery powers to establish a network of Star-Bases right on the cosmic threat!
As the Supreme Commander, your mission is absolute: Survive the alien onslaught, evolve your mutant abilities, fortify your interplanetary base, and defend the planet from total extinction!
Are you ready to fight and become the ultimate cosmic savior?
HEROIC SURVIVAL FEATURES:
1. Move & Dodge
Use simple screen joystick controls to navigate through thousands of alien invaders surrounding you. Focus on positioning to dodge deadly cosmic waves while your powers auto-attack.
2. Awaken Mystic Inner Forces
No tech, no guns—only raw, supernatural energy! Evolve your mutant abilities and choose the best roguelike upgrade paths during chaotic battles to unleash ultimate AoE combos.
3. Create Your Build
Pick from a variety of tactical skills and elemental traits to survive longer. Evolve your character stats permanently in the main menu to come back stronger after every defeat.
4. Unleash Unique Champions
Unlock a powerful roster of heroes to trigger ultimate combos. Evolve their inner forces to deal massive damage and wipe out entire screens of space monsters.
5. Master the Elements
Upgrade your hero elements to exploit enemy weaknesses. Deal bonus magic damage to countered alien species and mitigate incoming damage from elite cosmic bosses.
6. Build Your Asteroid Base
Establish and fortify your Star-Base right on the hostile planetoid surface. Gather rare loots from fallen foes to upgrade your facilities and secure long-term survival.
7. Critical Orders from HQ
Complete high-stakes mission quests issued by Command Headquarters to earn massive rewards, unlock legendary upgrades, and defend your home planet at all costs!
The countdown to oblivion has begun. Download Hero Survivor: Base Defense now, awaken your inner power, and save our world!"

bluejetty:00178563:ios.summary: "This application is provided by Information & eGovernment Authority in corporation with the Ministry of Health and the National Health Regulatory Authority and king Hamad University Hospital. The app consists of a number of health services
bluejetty:00178563:ios.description:
"This application is provided by Information & eGovernment Authority in corporation with the Ministry of Health and the National Health Regulatory Authority and king Hamad University Hospital. The app consists of a number of health services to serve the public: 
- Find a Doctor: Display all authorized physicians in the Kingdom of Bahrain with their specialties and the working place.
- Medicines: Information about the authorized medicines in Bahrain pharmacies, with related details (price and supplier name).
- Ask a Doctor: Ask a medical question and get the reply from the concerned physician.
- Appointments: Book an appointment, reschedule, or cancel upcoming appointments under the General and Dental Clinic specialties at your Health Center, request a medical prescription delivery from Salmaniya Medical Complex, view appointments at King Hamad University Hospital, and submit a request to reschedule or cancel appointments at Government Hospitals.
- Pharmacies and Shops: Information about the authorized pharmacies and health product retailers in Bahrain.
- Health Care Facilities: Information about the Health care facilities in Bahrain (hospitals, clinics, health centers).
- Medical Results: Check the readiness status of your Medical results (Lab and X-ray) in Salmaniya Medical Complex and King Hamad University Hospital. 
- Birth Certificate Services: Request for birth certificate for the new births and request a replacement of the existing birth certificate.
- Athlete Fitness Certificate: View and download athletes' fitness certificate.
- Blood Donation Services: Register in the blood donation bank, request for blood donation, and view the medical instructions.
- Vaccination Record: View and download vaccination record, and report missing vaccination records.
- Medical Reports & Certificates: View and download your medical reports and certificates from Primary Health Care and Government Hospitals, and submit a request to issue medical reports from Government Hospitals."

Become the loyal Pharaoh’s adviser and help him to restore peace and prosperity in the golden cities of Egypt. Construct houses re-establish production, collect taxes and gather materials, set up production and trade, and fight crocodiles and wicked cobras. Can you return Egypt to its days of glory?

• Dozens of levels packed with strategy and fun
• Build, upgrade, and defend your cities
• Intriguing narrative — a dramatic plot with twists and memorable characters.
• Atmospheric visuals & soundtrack — exciting journey begins!
• Unlock achievements
• Difficulty levels — from relaxed exploration to true challenge.

• Fully optimized for iPad and iPad Pro — play on a big screen with HD graphics and detail!

Construct frontier settlements, upgrade buildings, restore roads and expand your territory across the land.
• TIME MANAGEMENT & STRATEGY GAMEPLAY
Plan actions carefully, optimize workers, manage resources and complete missions before time runs out.
• EXPLORE THE FRONTIER
Travel through new lands, discover hidden locations, unlock rewards and help townsfolk throughout dozens of handcrafted levels.

Gather wood, food and materials, trade supplies and keep your settlements growing.
• COLLECTOR’S EDITION CONTENT
Enjoy bonus missions, achievements, collectibles and additional challenges.
• MULTIPLE GAME MODES

• Relaxed Mode (no timers) • Timed Mode • Extreme Mode
• COMPLETE MISSIONS & EARN REWARDS
Unlock medals, achievements and bonus content while mastering every challenge.
• Free to try
Love city builder games, resource management games, time management games or tycoon simulators?
Try for free, then unlock the full game for the entire adventure — no distractions - just adventure.
FETURES
• HELP the people of ancient Egypt to restore the kingdom
• EXPLORE the magnificent era of our history
• 44 EXCITING levels to master and hundreds of quests
• FIGHT dangerous cobras, scorpions, crocodiles and more!
• EARN achievements along the way
• MEET friends from outer space
• 2 difficulty modes: relaxed and adventure
• Step-by-step tutorials for beginners

bluejetty:00185430:ios.description:
Bring back the haunted castle of Frankenstein and his Witch bride in this solitaire treat. This is the spooky version of our very popular tri-peaks card game, Magic Towers Solitaire, which has been played over 100 million times. This is the card game with a bit more thrill!
In this version of our classic solitaire game we've been inspired by all things spooky. So we've kept what made our previous game so highly rated. That includes the smooth play with responsive controls, the easy to understand rules of the game and the neverending fun of trying to beat your previous high scores. What we've added is a frightfully fun theme composed of scarily satisfying sound and ghoulishly good graphics.
FEATURES:
- Addictive gameplay from our most popular solitaire game.
- Unique, eerily beautiful visual effects and theme.
- Fast, responsive and easy to use controls.
- Local and global leader boards so you can compare scores with friends and family.
- Ghoulishly good sound effects.
- Don't worry about interruptions, your game will automatically save its place.
So if you've been playing plain old windows solitaire or spider solitaire and want a fun card game with a bit of atmosphere then we’re sure you’ll love Halloween Tripeaks Solitaire.
