Nossa Missão: Liderança na prestação de serviços, conquistada pelo profissionalismo, competência e fiel cumprimento da nossa política da qualidade, na implantação de nossas operações, focando todas as atenções e esforços no atendimento das necessidades de nossos clientes.
Nossa Visão: Aprimorar-se de forma contínua como empresa prestadora de serviços, na busca da excelência dos serviços, baseada em processos administrativos atualizados e na aplicação de tecnologias. 
Tanto através do site da ÍCONE, como no nosso aplicativo, moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviços condominiais podem gerenciar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida e eficaz, de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora. Nossos recursos abrangem desde a gestão de boletos em aberto até a abertura de portas do prédio através de integrações disponíveis no aplicativo. Tudo isso com o mesmo login e senha, recebendo notificações para assuntos críticos, com acesso online e em tempo real.
Com a ÍCONE, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. 
Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.

[Last Shelter: Survival] is a Massive Multi-Player, Real-Time strategy war game. The player will take upon the role of a leader of a small settlement in a world devastated by a zombie apocalypse. Build your own wasteland empire, train your troops, recruit legendary heroes and join your allies in the non-ending war even in the end of humanity. To befriend or to plunder, the choice is yours!
Unique Features
-World Wide War
Real-time combat against players across the world, lead your country to greatness
-Realistic Graphics
The Map, The World, Your City, The Units, The Heroes, Everything just seems, REAL
-Build Your Wasteland Empire
Absolute Freedom City Building, upgrade your facilities, research your technologies, train your troops and recruit powerful heroes to strengthen your empire!
-Hero System
Whether you like to engage your enemies at a distance, take them on at close quarters, or you enjoy developing your base at home, there are TONS of heroes that can help you with just that!
-Strategic Gameplay
One set of units just simply cannot dominate, Fighters, Shooters and Vehicles, You have to know your enemy and yourself to walk the battlefield of this world.
-Alliance Warfare
Whether it’s going against different servers, or fighting for the title of the president at home, your alliance will always be backing you up, as long as you find the right people of course.
[Real Reviews]
“The game is really just a platform to meet friends from all over the world.”

bluejetty:00169606:ios.description:
Looking for a private and convenient way to call and text without sharing your personal number? 2nd Line - Second Phone Number gives you a real secondary phone number for personal conversations, calling, and messaging directly from your iPhone.
Stay connected with friends, family, and personal contacts while keeping your primary number private. No extra SIM card or additional device required.
Whether you want a separate number for travel, online accounts, shopping signups, dating apps, classifieds, or everyday privacy, Second Phone Number makes communication simple and secure.
With Second Phone Number you can:
◉ Send and receive SMS messages
◉ Make domestic and international calls
◉ Keep personal conversations private
◉ Use multiple phone numbers on one device
◉ Manage calls and messages easily
◉ Access voicemail, call forwarding, and more
Why users love Second Phone Number:
▶ Multiple Phone Numbers
Manage multiple virtual phone numbers directly from your iPhone without changing SIM cards or carrying extra devices.
▶ Privacy Protection
Keep your personal number private while communicating with people online, during travel, or in everyday situations.
▶ Personal Communication
Chat and stay connected with friends, family, and personal contacts using a separate number for everyday conversations.
▶ International Calling
Make affordable international calls and send messages while staying connected worldwide.
▶ Easy Number Management
Switch between numbers effortlessly and manage your communication in one convenient app.
▶ Flexible Usage
Use your second number for:
• Travel
• Online signups
• Shopping rewards programs
• Dating apps
• Classified listings
• Personal privacy
• Everyday communication
Additional Features:
◈ Voicemail
◈ Call Forwarding
◈ Call Blocking
◈ Custom Ringtones
◈ Automatic Call Recording
◈ SMS & MMS Support
Second Phone Number is designed for individual personal use and private communication. Spam, automated messaging, bulk messaging, and marketing-related usage are strictly prohibited.
Download Second Phone Number today and enjoy private calling and texting with the convenience of multiple phone numbers on a single device.
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited upon subscription purchase.

bluejetty:00127924:ios.name: LEGO® Super Mario™
bluejetty:00127924:ios.summary: The LEGO® Super Mario™ app is the official companion app for the ever-expanding range of LEGO® Super Mario™ building sets. The app enhances the creative experience for builders with digital instructions, tips for different ways to rebuild l
bluejetty:00127924:ios.description:
The LEGO® Super Mario™ app is the official companion app for the ever-expanding range of LEGO® Super Mario™ building sets. The app enhances the creative experience for builders with digital instructions, tips for different ways to rebuild levels and play, and other inspiring features. 
With the LEGO® Super Mario™ app you can: 
• Establish a Bluetooth® connection between the app and brick-built LEGO® Mario™, LEGO® Luigi™ and/or LEGO® Peach™ figures. 
• Build your sets, easily add them to your digital collection and expand your personalized LEGO® Super Mario™ universe (combining Expansion Sets with a Starter Course for interactive play). 
• Get easy-to-follow 3D building instructions for all of your LEGO® Super Mario™ building sets. 
• Check out instructional Play Videos packed with tips and tricks to take your skills to the next level. 
• Keep track of your digital coins after completing a level in real life with at-a-glance results for collected coins, defeated enemies and completed obstacles. 
• Put your skills to the test with an inspiring collection of fun Play Challenges. 
• Save your favorite LEGO® Super Mario™ moments to your gallery and share your creations. 
• Create or sign in to your LEGO® Account to synchronize your progress across all your devices. 
• Pin your favorite creations that others have shared so you can easily find them again. 
We don’t do third-party advertising. We only share our own marketing content and communication (such as news about LEGO sets and other LEGO games) with the aim of inspiring children’s creative play.
Is your device compatible? Check it at LEGO.com/devicecheck. Ask for your parents’ permission before going online.
The LEGO® Super Mario™ sets are sold separately.
Need help with the app? Contact our Consumer Service.
For contact details, hop over to http://service.LEGO.com/contactus
You accept our privacy policy and terms of use for apps if you download this app.
Read more on https://www.lego.com/legal/notices-and-policies/privacy-policy and https://www.lego.com/legal/notices-and-policies/terms-of-use-for-lego-apps
LEGO, the LEGO logo and the Brick and Knob configurations are trademarks and/or copyrights of the LEGO Group. ©2024 The LEGO Group

bluejetty:00021408:ios.summary:

By connecting to a camera with Wi-Fi (direct connection or via wireless router), this application provides the following f
bluejetty:00021408:ios.description:
Canon Camera Connect is an application to transfer images shot with compatible Canon cameras to smartphone/tablet. 
By connecting to a camera with Wi-Fi (direct connection or via wireless router), this application provides the following features:
・Transfer and save camera images to a smartphone.
・Remote shoot with live view imaging of the camera from a smartphone.
・Connect with Canon's various services.
This application also provides the following features for compatible cameras.
・Acquire location information from a smartphone and add it to the images on the camera.
・Switch to a Wi-Fi connection from pairing status with a Bluetooth enabled camera.
・Remote release of the camera shutter with a Bluetooth connection.
・Transfer the latest firmware.
*For compatible models and features, please refer to the following website.
 https://ssw.imaging-saas.canon/app/app.html?app=cc
-Operating System 
iOS 18/26
iPadOS 18/26
-Bluetooth System Requirement
For Bluetooth connection, the camera needs to have a Bluetooth function, and your device needs to have Bluetooth 4.0 or later (supports Bluetooth Low energy technology).
-Compatible File Types
JPEG, MP4, MOV, CR3, CR2, HEIF
・RAW (CR3/CR2) images can be imported as RAW format by selecting [Prioritize Saving in RAW Format] > [Yes] from the [Images on camera] setting while connected to compatible model (iOS 12.1 or later for CR3).
・ Importing RAW (.CR2) format is possible with wireless compatible EOS models and some PowerShot models (G1 X Mark III / G9 X Mark II / G7 X Mark II).
・RAW (CR2/CR3) images are resized and imported into JPEG by selecting [Prioritize Saving in RAW Format] > [No].
・RAW burst files cannot be imported to smart devices. Extract the CR3 images from the RAW burst file in advance on the camera side, and then import them to the smart device.
・MOV files and 8K movie files shot with EOS cameras cannot be saved.
・RAW movie files shot with compatible cameras cannot be saved.
・AVCHD files shot with Camcorder cannot be saved.
-Important Notes
・If application does not operate properly, try again after shutting down the application.
・Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. 
・In the case of using Power Zoom Adapter, please set the Live View function to ON.
・The images may include your personal information such as GPS data. Be careful when posting images online where many others can view them.
・Visit your local Canon Web pages for more details.

1. Select an Image
Start
bluejetty:00153528:ios.description:
Bring Your Imagination to Life with Drawsy: AR Draw for Sketching!
Our art AR Drawing app turns your iPhone into a virtual projector that helps you simply draw with precision. Here’s exactly how the process works:
1. Select an Image
Start by choosing an sketch from the app’s built-in gallery — like a cartoon character, animal, flower. 
2. Position Your Paper
Place a blank sheet of paper on a flat surface (like a desk or table) in a well-lit environment. Make sure your phone can see the entire sheet.
3. Activate AR Mode
Open the image in AR mode. Your phone will use its camera to detect the paper and overlay the image directly on top of it through the screen.
4. Adjust the View
Move your phone until the image is perfectly aligned with the paper. You can resize or rotate the image using your fingers to make sure it fits exactly the way you want.
5. Start Tracing the sketch
Now, simply look at your phone screen while keeping your pencil on the paper. The image appears “on the paper” in your screen view, allowing you to trace the lines precisely. It feels like you’re copying a transparent image that’s floating above your paper — but with total control!
6. Finish & Save
Once your outline is done, you can finish the drawing with your own style — add colors, shading, or extra details. If you want, you can record a video of your drawing process, as well as take a photo of your finished work and save or share it directly from the app.
Why It’s So Effective
Traditional tracing requires light tables or printed guides. With AR Drawing, you trace using your eyes and hands guided by real-time AR projection — no special tools, no printing, no setup. Just your iphone, a pencil, and paper.
Discover a fun new way to sketch and paint using Augmented Reality. Whether you’re a beginner or a pro, simply AR Draw App helps you trace anything with precision and ease.
Our app also lets you record your drawing process. Share the video with friends and show off your skills!

- Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Renewal charges will apply within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, indicating the cost of the renewal.
- Manage or cancel subscriptions in your account settings after purchase.
- Free trial periods will be canceled when your subscription is activated.
- If your subscription is not canceled before the end of the free trial period, your subscription will be activated for the selected period and your account will be charged automatically.

bluejetty:00068846:ios.summary:
Our original product, Timewerks, has been an App Store favorite for 11 years and has become the beloved time-tracking and billing solution of freelancers, consultants, contractors, lawyers, and salespeople all over the world.
Timewerks Pro
bluejetty:00068846:ios.description:
Our original product, Timewerks, has been an App Store favorite for 11 years and has become the beloved time-tracking and billing solution of freelancers, consultants, contractors, lawyers, and salespeople all over the world.
Timewerks Pro makes it easier than ever to bill your customers: send beautiful PDF invoices or estimates with your company logo, all from your iPad, iPhone, or iPod touch.
Timewerks Pro includes the following modules:
* PDF Invoices and Estimates
* Custom Invoice Logo
* Built-in data backup and restore
You can further enhance Timewerks Pro by purchasing our optional data sync module (via In App Purchase):
Sync your data across multiple iOS devices and view reports and enter data on our companion website, mytimewerks.
Existing Timewerks user? No problem, you can transfer your data to Timewerks Pro either using Backup and Restore, or Data Sync.
See our website for screenshots, video tutorials and our online user manual.
Features: 
* Track multiple projects and clients.
* Create, email and print HTML or PDF invoices and work estimates without a computer, complete with your company logo.
* Quickly and easily add timesheet hours and capture notes for each project task. 
* Track and invoice billable items, materials and expenses.
* Built-in data backup and restore: back up and restore your data with one tap (without connecting to iTunes).
* Sync data with our web-based companion (requires an optional timewerks sync subscription module.)
* Accept credit card payments via integration with Credit Card Terminal (sold separately by Inner Fence LLC) 
* Time your work for each project via a built-in stopwatch (Task Timer).
* Customize different rates for different types of tasks or items. 
* Calculate sales taxes, discounts and support multiple currencies. 
* Export your data to comma-delimited (CSV) or tab-delimited (TSV) text files via a Wi-Fi connection and a standard web browser. 
* Enter and view data without a network connection— all records are stored on the device.

bluejetty:00089297:ios.description:
STLtaxi is the booking application for both Laclede Cab taxi and County Cab services in Saint Louis, Missouri. 
We are pleased to offer even more convenient access to St.Louis city’s largest, cleanest and lowest priced fleet with our free STLtaxi app.
Key Features of the STLtaxi app include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call STLtaxi with the push of a button
To begin using the STLtaxi app today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip 
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The STLtaxi app retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed up the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the STLtaxi app or calling us at +1 (314)535-1162
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the STLtaxi app in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00079005:ios.summary:
Feeling overwhelmed by your health? Take control of your symptoms, flare-ups, and overall well-being.
CareClinic turns your symptoms, medications, and habits into personalized insights and daily actions. Built on proven clinical frameworks
bluejetty:00079005:ios.description:
Feeling overwhelmed by your health? Take control of your symptoms, flare-ups, and overall well-being.
CareClinic turns your symptoms, medications, and habits into personalized insights and daily actions. Built on proven clinical frameworks to help you make measurable progress every day.
Join over 500,000 people managing their Chronic Illnesses, Migraine, Pain, Headaches, Fatigue, IBS, POTS, PCOS, EDS, Period, Mood, Mental Health, and more!
Build healthy habits, stay accountable, and act on insights
- Import or add your personal health records
- Enable trackers for meds, symptoms, measurements, activity, nutrition, and more
- Add medication reminders, symptom check-up reminders, and appointment reminders
- Invite your caregivers and dependents, such as kids or parents
- Connect your wearables data and your add health goals
CareClinic becomes your companion as you put it all into action. Within days, you will start uncovering triggers, spotting correlations, and seeing how your Pain, Headaches, Migraines, Periods, IBS, PCOS, and Mood are affected, helping you take back control of your health and share the right information with your doctor for more personalized treatments.
Trackers included: 
- Medication Tracker for prescriptions, birth control, vitamins, supplements
- Symptoms Tracker acts as your symptoms diary with visual body mapping for keeping things like a pain log, flare-ups, and more
- Measurements tracker to track vitals such as blood pressure, heart rate, weight, and more
- Mood Tracker
- Cycle Tracker
- Sleep Tracker
- Journal for jotting down notes or to be used as a diary
- Factors to log environmental factors
- Nutrition Tracker with a built-in database
- Activity Tracker to log exercise, steps, more
- Stool Tracker with Bristol Scale plus urine (void) tracking
- Assessments such as PHQ-9, GAD-7, and other standardized medical questionnaires
- Fluids tracker for water and more
- Therapy tracker
- Weather Tracker
Personal Health Records:
- Allergies
- Appointments
- Care Teams
- Care Plans
- Conditions
- Genetics
- Health Events
- Immunizations
- Labs & Imaging
Also included:
- Documents & Exports
- Reminders
- Health Goals
- Exercise Library
- Medication Library
MORE REASONS FOR YOU TO TRY US
1. CUSTOMIZABLE REMINDERS
- Schedule medication (pill reminders, refill reminders, vitamins, or supplement reminders) with tapering doses
2. HEALTH & SYMPTOM DIARY & CHECK-INS
- Database of medications, symptoms, supplements, measurements
3. MONITOR PROGRESS IN CHARTS, TIMELINES & TRENDS
4. INTEGRATIONS
- Apple Health, Siri, Fitbit, Apple Watch, Calendar
5. CARE TEAMS
- Share and monitor your family, kids, and seniors remotely
- Store information centrally for reference
6. CARE PLANS
- Add medication with photos! No typing needed
- Drug & supplement interactions, synergistic effects, dose warnings
7. CUSTOMIZABLE
- Simplify by toggling anything on or off
- Localized measurement units, dates, time zones, languages
8. PRIVATE & SECURE
- Biometric security for access
- Data encryption on your device and server
- Full control to export or delete it
- We do not sell your data
---
It's more than a symptom tracker or pill organizer! CareClinic works as a complete health planner for self-care.
Essential for chronic illness or health symptoms, the app helps manage Bipolar, BPD, Cancer, Chronic Pain, COPD, Crohn's, Depression, Diabetes, Endometriosis, Epilepsy, Fibromyalgia, Flu, IBD, IBS (Bowel Movements), IPF, ME/CFS, Multiple Sclerosis (MS), PMDD, POTS & EDS, Psoriasis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, & other disorders. We also support Mental Health tracking, including ADHD, Anxiety, and Depression.
Also manage daily health and wellness, such as Food allergies, GI Symptoms, Gut health, Headaches, Mood, Pain with the pain tracker, pregnancy & baby symptoms, and PMS.
Information provided by CareClinic does not constitute medical advice. Always consult your doctor before making any medical decisions.

bluejetty:00127852:ios.summary:
The RealVNC® Server mobile app from RealVNC® lets you securely share your mobile device’s screen with your IT technician or system administrator in just a few taps.
================================
Protecting yourself from scams and fraud
bluejetty:00127852:ios.description:
The RealVNC® Server mobile app from RealVNC® lets you securely share your mobile device’s screen with your IT technician or system administrator in just a few taps.
================================
Protecting yourself from scams and fraud
Remote access can be used for scamming and fraudulent activities. Always be careful when asked to share access to your devices, especially if you weren't expecting a connection request. Ensure you never share sensitive information or grant access to someone if you are not completely certain they are who they claim to be.
If you are unsure, contact the organization offering support to confirm the request is genuine.
================================
RealVNC Server requires the user initiating the connection to have a RealVNC Connect account and to be using RealVNC Viewer on a desktop or mobile device.
There are two ways to start a remote session:
• ON-DEMAND ASSIST lets you set up a session in a flash using a secure one-time code that’s unique to your session. This option is available on RealVNC Connect  Professional and Enterprise Instant Support plans.
• DEVICE ACCESS lets IT teams pre-license a managed mobile device against their RealVNC Connect account. A session can be started without a session code, but the device holder still needs to authenticate the session. This option is available only on RealVNC Connect Enterprise Device Access plans.
Key Features
• Privacy with end-to-end encryption on all remote sessions.
• Fast, effortless connections using RealVNC’s secure cloud service.
• Protection from unwanted access with end-user connection approval.
• Free, paid and trial RealVNC Connect subscriptions available.
Need support?
Email us from the app or get in touch at help.realvnc.com.
Follow us on:
Twitter (@RealVNC)
Facebook (facebook.com/realvnc)

bluejetty:00016316:ios.description:
Dragon City is the ultimate mobile game where players build a magical floating city, collect and breed over 2,000 unique dragons, and battle other Dragon Masters in action-packed, real-time PvP combat!
It is one of the most popular fantasy dragon games on mobile, seamlessly combining city-building, creature collection, deep strategic combat, and engaging social alliance gameplay. With over 80 million Dragon Masters worldwide and massive new content updates every week, your ultimate dragon collecting and battling adventure awaits.
▶ BUILD A CITY IN THE DRAGONVERSE
Design, expand, and rule your own floating Dragon City across magical islands:
• Build farms, habitats, and training buildings to house your ever-growing dragon collection.
• Unlock special structures like the Tree of Life and Guardian Dragon Towers to boost your powers.
• Explore the Ancient World and uncover the deepest Dragonverse legends.
• Expand across new islands, each with unique environments, challenges, and rich rewards.
• Decorate your city with exclusive skins and items from seasonal events and exciting mini-games.
• Manage resources strategically—the bigger your city, the more powerful your dragons become!
▶ COLLECT 2,000+ DRAGONS
Dragon City features one of the largest and most diverse monster rosters in any mobile game:
• Collect dragons across dozens of elements including Flame, Nature, Legend, Sea, Electric, Ice, and many more.
• Breed dragons to discover unique hybrid species with combined elemental powers.
• Discover over 2,000 spectacular dragons, from common breeds to rare Mythicals and Legendaries.
• Welcome new legendary dragons every week through live events, battle passes, and special adventure islands.
• Feed and evolve your dragons, transforming them from cute baby hatchlings into legendary beasts.
• Unlock exclusive dragon Skins from seasonal events.
• Complete the Book of Dragons, the ultimate creature collector's challenge!
▶ STRATEGIZE & CONQUER: REAL-TIME PVP COMBAT
Dragon City is built for competitive players who love deeply strategic monster battle gameplay:
• Fight other Dragon Masters in real-time PvP Arenas with customized teams.
• Master elemental strengths and weaknesses to build the most effective battle lineup.
• Collect Orbs to empower your dragons and grow their combat strength with every upgrade.
• Climb the global leaderboards and claim Warrior's Chests packed with rare dragons and rewards.
• Complete Quests and adventure through special islands to unlock one-of-a-kind champion dragons.
• Compete in seasonal PvP tournaments and limited-time events against millions of players worldwide.
▶ ALLIANCE & SOCIAL FEATURES
Dragon City is more than a solo adventure; it's a thriving global community:
• Build or join Alliances to fight rival Dragon Masters as a unified team.
• Chat with allies, coordinate battle strategies, and share Alliance Gifts.
• Open Alliance Chests to unlock exclusive dragons only available through dedicated teamwork.
• Trade dragon Orbs with other players in the Trading Hub to strengthen your collection.
Need help with your dragon collection or want to join the conversation?
• FAQ & Support: Visit our Help Center at https://socialpoint.helpshift.com/a/dragon-city/ or access support directly in-game via the Settings menu.
• Community: 
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/dragoncity
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dragoncity
Twitter: @DragonCityGame
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/DragonCity
Youtube channel: https://www.youtube.com/user/DragonCityChannel
Dragon City is free to download and includes optional in-game purchases (including random items). Information about drop rates for random item purchases can be found in-game. If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.
Do Not Sell My Personal Information: https://www.take2games.com/ccpa/
Our Terms of Service are changing. See https://zynga.support/T2TOSUpdate for more info.

bluejetty:00190216:android.description:
Oil Truck Simulator Game
Get ready for the truck driving adventure in Oil Tanker Truck Simulator – the most realistic fuel transport and heavy cargo driving game. Take control of powerful oil tanker trucks, complete challenging fuel delivery missions oil tanker truck game, and explore stunning environments filled with highways, mountains, cities, and offroad tracks. This oil tanker truck game is designed for players who love real truck driving, smooth controls, and intense oil transport truck challenges.
City Oil Tanker Truck Driver
In this oil tanker truck simulator, you will experience the life of a professional oil tanker truck driver. Your duty is to load oil from the refinery and transport it safely to fuel stations across the city and offroad regions with fuel transport simulator. Every mission tests your skills, focus, and truck driving control. One wrong move or sharp turn can damage your tanker, so drive carefully and keep the fuel stable. This cargo oil truck game offers realistic truck physics and responsive steering to give you a truck simulator feel.
Fuel Tanker Truck Simulator
Start your truck driving journey in city mode, where you transport oil through traffic on rush roads, signal intersections, bridges, and busy highways. Avoid traffic violations and reach the fuel station on time. City missions are designed to give you a smooth, professional fuel tanker truck driving experiences.
Oil Tanker Truck Drive Game
If you love challenges of fuel tanker driving game, switch to offroad mode. Drive your heavy fuel tanker through rough mountain roads, steep hills, muddy tracks, and narrow cliffs. Offroad mode offers the toughest truck driving simulator scenarios, where one small mistake can flip your oil tanker. Only a skilled truck driver can complete these missions without spilling fuel.
Oil Transport Truck Games 2025
The tanker transport simulator game includes multiple **oil tankers, fuel trucks, and heavy-duty vehicles**, each with different power, speed, and handling. Upgrade your truck or unlock new fuel tankers to make your oil transport missions easier. The realistic sound effects, engine noise, and suspension movements make every ride exciting. This fuel tanker truck driving game** also features interactive checkpoints, arrow navigation, a realistic traffic system, and smooth control options like tilt, steering, and buttons.
Whether you are a fan of **cargo transport oil tanker games, truck simulator, fuel transport games, or offroad driving**, this oil tanker truck game gives you everything in one place. Drive, deliver, and become the best **fuel tanker truck driver**.
Key Features of Oil Tanker: Truck Simulator 3d:
* Realistic oil tanker truck driving experience
* City and offroad fuel transport missions
* Smooth steering, braking, and engine controls
* Real truck simulator physics with fuel stability mechanics.
* Multiple tankers, cargo trucks, and heavy vehicles.
* High-quality graphics.
* Engaging missions and realistic sound effects.
If you love real truck driving challenges, then **Oil Tanker Truck Simulator** is the perfect game for you. Load fuel, drive safely, and complete every delivery mission like a true professional fuel truck driver.

bluejetty:00024467:ios.description:
Manage priorities, not emails.
Spark brings every account into one inbox and automatically surfaces what matters most — so nothing slips through the cracks. Loved by millions and named "Best of the App Store" by Apple.
"It's a combination of polish, simplicity, and depth." — FastCompany
"You can create an email experience that works for you." — TechCrunch
EVERY ACCOUNT, EVERY EMAIL, IN ONE PLACE
Connect Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, AOL, Hotmail, GMX, and any IMAP account in a single unified inbox.
STAY ORGANIZED WITH SMART INBOX
Important emails from real people rise to the top. Newsletters and notifications stay neatly grouped below, out of your way.
GET MORE DONE WITH EMAIL ESSENTIALS
Mark emails as done or set them aside for later
Mute threads you're no longer following
Schedule emails to send later — even if your device is off
Find anything fast with Smart Search and Smart Folders
PROTECT YOUR INBOX WITH GATEKEEPER
Pre-screen new senders and block unwanted contacts instantly.
PRIORITIZE WHAT MATTERS
Mark important senders so their emails always stay on top. Group emails by sender or domain to keep your inbox clean.
WRITE FASTER WITH SPARK +AI
Summarize long threads, draft replies, rephrase messages, and adjust tone. Your AI Assistant helps you clear your inbox, translate emails, and keep projects moving.
MANAGE YOUR CALENDAR AND MEETINGS
Connect your calendars to stay on top of your day in one app.
CONNECT YOUR FAVORITE TOOLS
Link Spark to Notion, Asana, Things, and 10+ integrations to act on everything in your inbox.
COLLABORATE WITH YOUR TEAM
Co-author emails and discuss in private comments
Assign messages so everyone knows who owns what
Share secure links to specific emails
Track read receipts to keep work moving
SECURE AND PRIVATE
Spark encrypts your data, runs on Google Cloud's secure infrastructure, and is fully GDPR compliant.
TRY IT FREE
Stick with our powerful free plan, or try Spark Plus or Spark Pro free for 7 days.
Download Spark and reclaim your day.
FAQ
Is Spark the best email app for managing multiple accounts?
Spark brings Gmail, Outlook, iCloud, Yahoo, and any IMAP account into one unified inbox, so you can manage every email in one place instead of switching between apps.
How is Spark different from Apple Mail and Gmail?
Spark helps you focus on what matters, not just read email. It automatically prioritizes messages from real people, keeps newsletters out of the way, and can summarize, draft, and follow up so less falls through the cracks.
How does Spark help with email overload?
Spark surfaces important messages first, lets you snooze emails until you're ready, and helps you reach Inbox Zero without the grind. Higher plans flag what needs attention so nothing gets missed.
Does Spark have AI features?
Yes. Spark uses AI to write faster, reply clearly, and summarize threads. On Plus, AI helps you make better inbox decisions. On Pro, it acts on your behalf — drafting, organizing, and following up.
Is Spark good for team collaboration?
Yes. Teams can share drafts, comment privately, assign messages, and manage shared inboxes — no forwarding chains. Collaboration is available on Pro.
Can I schedule emails to send later?
Yes. Schedule any email to send at the right time, or snooze incoming messages to return when you're ready.
Is Spark free?
Yes. Spark is free to download and use. Spark Plus is for professionals who want a more focused inbox; Spark Pro is for those who need Spark to handle follow-through so nothing gets missed.
Is Spark available on Mac, iPhone, and iPad?
Yes. Spark works on iOS, iPadOS and macOS, and stays in sync across all your devices.
Spark is made by Readdle.

Train with a real strength & conditioning plan built for your sport, your goals, and your life. Built by CSCS-certified coaches. Personalized by AI. Trusted by 2M+ athletes.

Volt gives you more than workouts. You get a complete training plan designed around where you want to go — and intelligent guidance that adapts as you get stronger.

Choose your sport or fitness goal, then tell Volt about your schedule, experience, equipment, training preferences, and timeline. Volt builds your plan. Cortex® AI personalizes your weights and adapts your training as you progress.

REAL STRENGTH & CONDITIONING — Built by certified coaches, not generated one workout at a time.
BUILT FOR YOUR SPORT & GOALS — Train for Sport Performance, Fitness & Strength, or Tactical Readiness. 
PERSONALIZED TO YOU — Customized to your training experience, strength, schedule, available equipment, session length, training preferences, and timeline.
AI THAT ADAPTS TO YOUR STRENGTH — No guessing what to lift. Cortex® AI learns your strength to personalize your exercises, sets, reps, and weights — and evolves your plan as you get stronger.
SCIENCE-BACKED PROGRESSION — Volt applies proven strength & conditioning principles to progress your training over time.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO TRAIN:
• Personalized sets, reps, weights, and exercises
• Flexible training schedules and session lengths
• Equipment-based customization
• Smart exercise substitutions
• HD exercise demonstrations and coaching instructions
• 1,500+ movements
• Workout history and strength tracking
• Estimated 1RMs and progress insights
• Milestones and achievements
• Apple Health integration

TRAINING PROGRAMS:

• P.E.
• Rugby
• Soccer

bluejetty:00073675:ios.name: Monarch: Budget & Track Money
bluejetty:00073675:ios.summary: Consider Monarch your home base for money clarity. Simplify your finances by bringing all your accounts into one easy view, have confidence in always knowing where your money is and where it's going, and collaborate with your partner or fin
bluejetty:00073675:ios.description:
Consider Monarch your home base for money clarity. Simplify your finances by bringing all your accounts into one easy view, have confidence in always knowing where your money is and where it's going, and collaborate with your partner or financial professional to track, budget, and reach goals together.
Monarch has been recognized by the Wall Street Journal as the “Best Budgeting App,” by Forbes as the “Best Mint Replacement” and by Motley Fool as the “Best Budgeting App for Couples and Families.”
Getting started is simple. Connect your accounts and Monarch will auto-categorize your finances, giving you actionable insights in minutes. Customize your dashboard to give you the information you need at a glance, including your net worth, recent transactions, how you’re tracking toward your budget, investment performance, and upcoming expenses. 
Monarch makes it easy to take steps today to build toward your long term plans, all in one simple and collaborative financial tool.
Track
- Connect your accounts and see everything in one place so you can get a clear view of how your money is moving and track progress on your net worth.
- Always know what’s around the corner with subscriptions and bills tracked in one easy calendar or list view and notifications so you don’t miss a payment.
- Keep an eye on subscriptions so you can cancel what you no longer need.
- Sync with your credit cards and loans and Monarch will provide statement balances and minimum payment due.
- Search for any transaction, across all of your accounts - no shuffling between apps to find charges or refunds.
- View and customize reports for quick insights on your spending across groups and categories and trends over time.
Budget
- Monarch offers two ways to budget - Flex Budgeting or Category Budgeting - so you can choose to have the structure or flexibility you need and make budgeting feel easy.
- Get a quick view of your budget progress with visual progress bars and a dashboard widget.
- Customize your groups and categories, emojis, and your notifications to keep you on track.
Collaborate
- Add your partner or other household members and team up on your finances, whether you choose to have joint bank accounts or not. All at no extra cost.
- Invite your advisor, financial coach, tax professional or estate planning attorney so they can give you accurate advice with little effort required of you.
Plan
- Create and track progress toward your medium and long term goals.
- Set up contributions toward your goals within your monthly budget, and watch your savings compound over time.
A Membership With You in Mind
Our focus is on building a product that can transform your relationship to money, bringing clarity and confidence to your financial life. As a Monarch member, you’ll get access to all the new features we build and have the opportunity to vote on and provide feedback for new features on our roadmap. We build with the feedback from our community in mind. 
No Ads
Monarch is not supported by advertisers and is designed with the sole purpose of making it easy and intuitive for you to manage your finances. That means we will never interrupt your experience with ads or try to sell you another financial product you don’t need.
Private and Secure
Monarch uses bank-level security, and we never store any of your financial credentials. Our platform is read-only, so there is no risk of your money moving. We take your privacy seriously and will never sell your personal or financial information to third parties.
MEMBERSHIP DETAILS
Monarch is free to try for 7 days. After your trial period, a membership fee will be billed either monthly or annually, depending on which plan you select.
Privacy Policy: https://www.monarchmoney.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.monarchmoney.com/terms

bluejetty:00082310:ios.description:
Transform your body and boost your confidence with SheFit's 28-day lazy home workout challenge!
Over the course of 28 days, you'll see real results as you shed fat, build strength, and improve your overall fitness—all from the comfort of your home. Stay committed, follow the plan, and watch as your body transforms into a stronger version of yourself!
SheFit is the ultimate easy at home workout app for women who want to work out with minimal effort and maximum convenience, targeting weight loss and helping you tone your belly and stomach with ease.
Workout Anywhere: Bed, Chair, or Mat!
With SheFit, you can perform your easy home workouts almost anywhere. Whether you’re lounging in bed, sitting on a chair, or using a yoga mat, these quick and effective exercises fit seamlessly into your routine.
Bed: Perfect for gentle stretching and toning your stomach muscles before you even get up. A great way to ease into your day while targeting belly fat.
Chair: Ideal for seated exercises that work your core, tummy, and upper body, helping you shed fat and tone up without leaving your chair.
Mat: Engage in floor-based exercises that focus on strengthening and toning your entire body, with particular emphasis on belly and stomach fat reduction.
These accessible home workouts allow you to stay active and committed, no matter where you are, ensuring your fitness goals are always within reach.
Boost Your Strength with Wall Pilates
Experience the benefits of Wall Pilates, a gentle yet powerful way to improve your daily strength and flexibility. By incorporating simple movements using a wall for support, SheFit's Wall Pilates helps you target key muscle groups, including your core, arms, and legs. These exercises are perfect for building overall strength and balance while burning belly fat and toning your tummy.
Whether you're just starting out or adding this to your routine, Wall Pilates is an effective, low-impact way to improve your fitness while keeping your body strong and agile.
Our quick, targeted easy home workouts focus on toning and strengthening key areas, helping you stay in shape and lose weight without the stress of high-intensity routines. With customizable plans tailored to your fitness level and goals, SheFit ensures that you're always progressing at a pace that suits you. Whether you aim to lose weight, tone your body, or simply maintain an active lifestyle, SheFit has the perfect easy home workout for you. You'll find exercises for toning, core strength, flexibility, Kegel exercises, and even mindfulness, all designed to boost energy, improve mood, and promote overall wellness from the comfort of your home. Burn belly fat and trim your stomach in just minutes a day with these effective home workouts.
Stay consistent, feel stronger, and prioritize self-care with SheFit—the app that proves fitness doesn’t have to be hard to be effective. Start your journey towards a more active you, without the pressure of intense workouts, and achieve your fitness goals to lose weight right from the comfort of your home. SheFit is here to make fitness as lazy and easy as possible, helping you lose weight and stay fit effortlessly by focusing on toning your belly, reducing fat, and achieving a leaner stomach with regular home workouts.

bluejetty:00028747:ios.description:
Clear Wave plays sound waves that shake water out of your iPhone's speaker, so the sound comes back clear. It also has a tone generator, a dB meter, and speaker and microphone tests.
Key Features:
Speaker Cleaner – A 165 Hz water-eject program pushes trapped water out of the speaker. Choose 15, 30 or 60 seconds; Clear Wave reminds you to turn the volume up for the best clean.
Tone Generator – Play any frequency from 10 Hz to 20,000 Hz with sine, triangle, square or sawtooth waves, and see the matching musical note. Useful for sound checks, tuning and testing audio equipment.
dB Meter – Measure the sound level around you, with average, minimum and maximum, the current frequency, and how loud it really is, from "like a library" to "like a rock concert".
Measurement Photos – Take a photo with the sound level and the date on it, and save it to your photo library.
Speaker Test – Play sound through the top and bottom speakers separately, plus a deep bass pulse, to check that both work.
Microphone Check – Clap or speak and find out whether your microphone hears you clearly.
Clean Reminder – Get a daily or weekly reminder to clean your speakers.
Siri – Start cleaning hands-free with Siri.

Come and download Lonely Survivor, and adventure with the brave mage!

bluejetty:00149829:ios.description:
SipSkip is an all-in-one nightlife platform made to streamline your entire night! Discover nearby venues or even swipe through them like a dating app until you find the perfect spot. See where the crowd is headed with real-time updates from nearby users. Love a venue? Give it a "Sip" to boost their score, or "Skip" it and share private feedback to help them improve. When you've found your destination, get there instantly with one-tap Uber integration that automatically loads the venue’s location. Say goodbye to long drink wait times, grab a SipSkip Pass to get served instantly every time!
Swipe The Cards - Finding your perfect venue is now as easy as swiping! Browse nearby hotspots Tinder-style until you find the one that’s perfect for you.
Sip or Skip Rating System - Love a venue? Give it a "Sip" and boost their score! Not feeling it? "Skip" it and optionally share private feedback to help them improve.
"I'm Going" Check-ins - Let venues know you're coming and help your friends find the party! One tap tells everyone where the night is headed.
Instant Uber Integration - Found your spot? Get there instantly! Tap the Uber button and you're one click away from the action.
SipSkip Pass - Skip the wait! Purchase a SipSkip Pass to enjoy instant service at the busiest spots in town.
Join thousands of users who've already discovered the future of nightlife!
Available at participating venues. Pass terms vary by location. Must be 21+ for alcohol-related venues.

As an aspiring chef, Cooking Empire: Chef Game offers you the opportunity to transform into a passionate culinary expert and embark on an epic cooking adventure. From sizzling shrimp to crispy bacon, you'll be cooking up a storm in no time! Your dream of becoming a cooking star chef is within reach, but first, you'll have to accept the challenges that come with Cooking Empire. So roll up your sleeves, put on your chef's hat, and get ready to show off your crazy-cooking skills, time management, and food serving skills. Your success will depend on how well you can keep up with the increasing demand for delicious dishes and satisfy the taste buds of your hungry customers.
Features:
- Open restaurants: Japan Cuisines, United States, France, Singapore, China and coming soon
- Variety of cultures from North America to South America, from Europe to Asia
- Challenge 500+ frenzy levels and learn unique recipes to cook tons of delicious dishes
- Kick off the magic kitchen by using powerful boosts
- Test your skills with different cooking modes, including timed and endless modes
- Upgrade your cooking skills and unlock more challenging levels
- Unlock special rewards by completing daily missions and achievements
- Enjoy addictive gameplay and endless cooking seaside and baking fun!

- Unlock restaurants all around the world
- Cook & serve 300+ yummy food meals in cooking city
- Upgrade kitchen ingredients and cooking kitchenwares
- Create numerous combos to increase your income from consumers.
- Use booster items to power up your cooking skills.
- Do not burn or waste appetizers, main courses, desserts, tea, coffee, wine, fast food, sweets, any food.
If possible, utilize Double the bonus to get more money rapidly to upgrade goods and enhance the restaurant.
With this cooking game, you'll be able to hone your culinary talents and become a master chef in no time. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced cook, there's something for everyone to enjoy. So what are you waiting for? 
Download Cooking Empire: Chef Game now and start your cooking journey!

bluejetty:00145696:ios.description:
"Play this friendly game with your family, Facebook friends and millions of other players around the world. Attack, spin, and steal your way from island to island, to travel through tons of unique villages to earn coins and help Luna and her friend find her missing father. 
Do you have the courage to defeat pirate attacks, to master island challenges, or to steal coins from the greatest cash kings? Play any role you like as Island King. Become a master of coin who holds trillions of coins and rule the realm! Or become a fierce pirate king to smash and raid neighboring islands! Devise your own master plan to get bonus spins and steal other player Jackpots. 
Build your Island villages into Viking Settlements, Indian Palaces, Mystic Temples and many more unique world-inspired destinations with your closest family and friends. Raid coins from anyone and everyone, even friends! Love board games like monopoly, bingo or solitaire but want to play online with family and friends, try Island King today! 
【Spin the slot to earn coins and free Spins】 
Spin the magical slot to earn your fortune, attack, raid, or steal coins. Shield your islands and coins from other player raids. Build your island with coins and move up to unlock new destination islands. Become the Island King with the best island and the master of collecting coins! 
Spin the slot can also gain free Spins by finishing interesting puzzles and challenges! 
【Collect all valuable cards】 
Collect cards and exchange with your family and Facebook friends to complete the puzzle sets, you can win tons of coins for free! Finish building your islands and unlock the next set of cards. 
【Play with your friends】 
Join our Facebook Community to meet new friends, join a tribe, learn new game trivia, and earn millions of coins by the slot machines and scratch card mini games. Trade your cards in the community and play together to boost your progress! 
Follow us: https://www.facebook.com/IslandKingApp/ 
Any problems or feedback, please contact IslandKing@forevernine.com. Good Luck!"

bluejetty:00065640:ios.description:
Everyday shopping can be made even easier. Is it possible? Of course! There are special shopping apps for your phone. Usually, however, a separate app for the shopping list and a separate app for grocery shopping makes the whole process difficult. Fortunately, this is now a thing of the past.
Meet Frisco - operating for almost 16 years, the largest online supermarket in Poland. From now on, you don't have to worry about long queues and heavy bags. Our innovative shopping app will allow you to create a shopping list, control your spending, compare prices and save time. 
Not every shopping app gives you access to such a wide range. The extremely extensive grocery list definitely sets us apart from other shops. We pay particular attention to the quality and freshness of our goods. Vegetables and fruit come straight from the producers and are delivered 2x a day. 
An important advantage is the intuitiveness that characterises our app. Your shopping list is created in the blink of an eye! Search for your favourite products, add them to your basket and with just a few clicks, order your purchases for home delivery. You decide when we deliver them. Our one-hour delivery windows guarantee that your shopping is delivered at the time you specify (between 6am and 11pm) from Monday to Sunday. The delivery of your shopping to your home is carried out using a special FriscoVan - a refrigerated truck that guarantees that the goods stay fresh.
Don't want to have to search for your favourite items from scratch every time? We have ways! The first is a personalised grocery shopping list, which you can create yourself. In addition, Frisco allows you to re-fill a previous order with just one click.
Need products labelled organic, vege, vegan or gluten-free? Use special filters that will show you exactly what you are looking for. In addition, our specialised recommendation system will match the displayed products adequately to your preferences.
Are you planning to do some grocery shopping but would like to support local entrepreneurs at the same time? No problem! With us, you will find a wide range of carefully selected products from local suppliers. In addition, each item in our range contains a clear and easy-to-read list of ingredients and nutritional values. Using the Frisco app, grocery shopping with home delivery is a pleasure!
Discounts of up to -50%, prices rivalling those in hypermarkets, free delivery from £250, simple and secure payment methods. Ordering groceries at home is becoming a new trend. Online grocery shopping has found many followers, especially among people who value their time, who no longer have to waste it on travelling to the shops and standing in queues.
Online grocery shopping has never been easier. By choosing to replace the traditional market with an online one, you visit a virtual grocery shop with home delivery of your purchases. This means the advantages of traditional shopping, without its disadvantages - you don't have to look for a parking space, stand in kilometre-long traffic jams or queues.
Install and try out Frisco now. See for yourself that shopping on demand makes things simpler. It's safe to say that online shopping is life-changing, especially when, like with us, the groceries on offer are selected products of the highest quality.
The time and money you save can be used however you like! Both you and your whole family will benefit. Join the ranks of satisfied users and enjoy the possibilities of online grocery shopping. Do it on your phone or tablet when it's convenient for you. We are here for you 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. You will find groceries, cosmetics, cleaning products, items for children and pets and much more. Check it out!

bluejetty:00083220:ios.description:
A habit tracker with a story to come back to.
Take a walk. Read a few pages. Make time for someone you care about. Cheerly helps you keep track of the little things you want to do more often, with reminders, mood check-ins, and an adventure along the way.
Start with Free
Track up to 10 habits and check in with your mood. Take a Big Five personality quiz, create a personalized hero portrait, and play through Major Meme's original story. He's an astronaut sloth, and he's happy to take things one step at a time.
Find something for today
Browse activities for creativity, focus, confidence, organization, and connection. Write a reflection, try a guided practice, or come back to a daily quote. You can share progress with friends, too.
Make Your World with Cheerly Pro
Choose your setting, describe your hero, and pick an art style, story tone, and narrator. Pro uses AI to create your world and its companions. Talk with characters from your world and read your illustrated adventure in the Story Journal.
Pro also includes unlimited habits and a story shaped by what you do in real life. Your World opens after your first subscription payment. AI features have usage limits.
Subscriptions
Cheerly is free to start. Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription. You'll see the price and renewal terms before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled.
Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Cheerly is for wellbeing and self-reflection. It does not replace therapy, counselling, or medical care. AI-generated content can make mistakes and is not professional advice.
Terms of Use: https://cheerly.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://cheerly.app/privacy

Add books, e-books or audiobooks to your collections, use the timer to track your reading and get access to aw
bluejetty:00187735:ios.description:
Bookly helps you track your reading in real-time, manage your books, make a habit out of reading and see your progress over time.
Add books, e-books or audiobooks to your collections, use the timer to track your reading and get access to awesome stats that will help you improve and read even more. Set goals and reminders to stay motivated, get weekly and monthly or yearly reports on your progress. 
You can better rate your books by going beyond the classic five star ratings by adding custom ones like: inspiration, heartfelt, love, spice, humor, and many more. Bookly also allows half-star ratings. 
TRACK YOUR READING IN REAL-TIME
- Start the timer every time you read with a simple tap
- Record your current page number of the books you're reading
- See how long it will take you to finish the book at your current pace
- Set a Book Goal to finish your book by a given time
- Add your own rating, thoughts, and quotes for each book
- Play ambient sounds while you read 
- Generate awesome Infographics style reports for every book
- Unlock achievements to stay motivated and read even more
GET READING STATS & RESULTS
- Get tons of insightful Stats: total read time, pages read, reading speed, estimated book finish time, daily reading time, days you read in a row, reading streak and more
- Generate Reading Reports with graphs and stats per book/month/year
- Set Monthly or Yearly Goals in number of hours, pages or books
- Set daily reminders to keep you motivated to achieve your reading goals
- Use the powerful Bookly Assistant to read more, get personalized reading suggestions, reminders, reports and a lot more
- Share your progress directly from the app
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR BOOKS
- Track and manage your entire library of books, e-books and audiobooks
- Setup your own custom book Collections, like "Wishlist", "Favourites"
- Get book details by scanning the ISBN barcode or searching online directly in the app
- Store and sync your books among devices using iCloud
- Never lose a book again, mark a book as lent or borrowed
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR BOOK CHARACTERS
- Track and manage all characters that you meet in your reading journey
- Track how they evolve over time, what challenges they face, the relationships between them and much more. 
KEEP TRACK OF READATHONS
- Track your readathon progress in real time
- Track books read, reading time and pages for any period of time
- Track readathon prompts
- Get notifications and stay on track
- - -
Bookly is free to download and use. No online account or signup needed. The Pro version is free with a 7 day trial, after which we offer three subscription packages: $4.99/month (1 Month Subscription), $19.99/6 months (6 Month Subscription), and $29.99/year (1 Year Subscription). All other features remain free to use indefinitely.
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
Subscription service conditions:
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
- You can manage your subscription and switch off auto-renewal by accessing your Account Settings after purchase
- Refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
- All personal data is handled under the terms and conditions of Bookly’s privacy policy. More details can be found here:
http://getbookly.com/privacy-policy/
http://getbookly.com/terms-of-use/ 
*Important: This app is for book TRACKING and MANAGEMENT. Book content and the actual reading is not done in the app.*

bluejetty:00018861:ios.summary:

The golden acorns are und
bluejetty:00018861:ios.description:
READ THIS: This is a companion app and NOT a standalone game. MUST be initiated by a player with a VR headset and played with at least one person who joins the game on a mobile device (iOS 12.4, iPhone 6 and up). 
The golden acorns are under attack! It’s up to you and your friends to protect them or steal them - depending if you are playing on a VR headset to take on the role of an extraordinarily protective tree or as one of several crafty yet thieving squirrels on mobile - in the cross-platform party game, Acron: Attack of the Squirrels!, from Resolution Games.
This hilariously fun experience must be initiated by a player with a VR headset (Meta Quest, Pico Neo3, Pico 4, Oculus Rift, HTC Vive, Valve Index or Windows Mixed Reality) who creates a room. He or she then connects to one to eight frenemies on their phone and/or tablet devices by giving them the assigned room number that they enter into their device when prompted in order to become rebel squirrels that'll do anything to steal the golden acorns using an arsenal of unique abilities. 
The game is at its best when played as a couch party game together with a group of friends and is both competitive and cooperative in nature for players across VR and mobile devices. Once in the game, one player in VR takes on the role of a large, ancient tree that tries to knock out the squirrels that are out to steal the nuts by using the controllers to grab and hurl wood chunks, boulders and sticky sap to keep the squirrels at bay. Meanwhile, the band of squirrels (players on mobile) can leverage a myriad of tools and distraction tactics - including the ability to pick up and plant seeds that grow into pumpkin barriers, plant bushes to hide behind, place mushrooms they can use as leaping pads and more - while working together to develop strategies to outsmart the tree in order to scurry around and gather as many acorns as they can.
Meet the band of rebellious squirrels out to steal the golden acorns:
* Zip - quick witted and light-footed; she’s the fastest squirrel and has speed running abilities
* Chunk - the gentle giant with a heart of gold who protects his friends by carrying a shield
* Doug - not the smartest acorn in the bunch, but channels his rage issues to dig tunnels that allow for safe travel underground
* Sim - a crafty little rodent who’s kind of nutty and builds ramps for vertical movement

Welcome to a better way to manage your account with our customer mobile app. You can view and pay your bill, report an outage, check outage status, manage your accounts, view billing history, and more! Features include:

OUTAGE INFORMATION

- Check outage status and track restoration progress
- Easy access to view outage maps in your area

ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
- Choose "Remember me" to skip logging in each time you use the app*

ENERGY USAGE

SETTINGS

- Enroll in and manage billing and outage alerts


*Logging into the PSO app requires an active account that is registered online at PSOklahoma.com

bluejetty:00174658:ios.description:
If you are looking for a daily horoscope app offering accurate daily and monthly horoscopes, compatibility reports, essays, and more, you have come to the right place. Astrology Zone is an award-winning app that offers everything you need to know to plan your day, month or year ahead.
Astrology Zone has two versions.
What You Get
1-The FREE version: will give you short daily horoscopes for all 12 signs a day, plus Susan's highly popular detailed monthly horoscope for 12 signs. If you are reading the monthly Astrology Zone horoscopes on your cell phone browser, you will find using the app to be easier to navigate. Astrology Zone's short daily horoscopes give you yesterday, today, and tomorrow's predictions. You can read Susan's current month or last month's monthly horoscope. The free version includes ads. Purchase the premium version for no ads.
2-The Premium Subscription Version: Once you have the free edition of the Astrology Zone app, you can decide if you'd like to upgrade to the PREMIUM paid subscriber edition, which will give you substantially more comprehensive daily horoscopes that most readers prefer, along with Susan's exciting monthly horoscopes for all 12 signs. On the Premium version, the daily horoscope for Sundays offers a look at the week ahead so you can plan your week productively. Again, the Premium version gives you today, yesterday, and tomorrow's daily horoscope as well as last month's monthly forecast. 
The premium version of the app also features a large number of Susan's essays on a wide variety of topics, including the meaning of Mercury retrograde, why you need to note the year's eclipses, plus compatibility reports, & more. If you wondered whether there is a 13th sign after reading news reports, read Susan's essay on the topic, where she gives evidence to show why you must continue to read for your traditional birth sign. 
Under key dates on your Premium app, you can locate your best days to stage an initiation. Check out the Learn Astrology section, about the planets, the elements, and the qualities, and a description of your most loveable characteristics. There is also an area that will tell you about Susan's various appearances. 
Cost of Premium Version for the Astrology Zone app is $4.99 for one month, $12.99 for 3 months, or $49.99 for a full year. The 3 months & yearly subscriptions reflect a 15% discount over the monthly subscription. 
• NO ads with Premium version
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, & identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user & auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Terms of use - https://www.astrologyzone.com/terms-of-use/
Bio
Susan Miller is an accredited astrologer known for her beautifully written, accurate, and easy-to-understand, practical predictions. Her loving, optimistic style is what readers enjoy most about her work. 
Susan is currently a regular contributing editor for 10 international magazines such as Vogue Germany, Vogue Japan, Grazia France, Vogue China, Claudia Brazil, GQ, Details, and more.
Based in NYC, she is a frequent guest on TV shows such as Access Hollywood, Good Morning America and others in the US and is also currently on Sirius radio as a regular guest. 
Susan Miller founded her popular website Astrology Zone in 1995, a site visited by 10.8 million unique visitors a year, serving 105 million page views a year. 
Honors
This year Susan's app won the Media Excellence Award for Best Daily Connected Content. Susan's app was also honored last year as a finalist for best content in the Appy Awards, and was named an honoree in the Webby Awards in 2017 & 2018.

bluejetty:00077226:ios.description:
Get near real time crime information and crime alerts for most areas in the US, United Kingdom, and parts of Canada.
Buying a new home or traveling to a new area - check your safety with the SpotCrime App.
The app provides a crime map linked to many crime sources around the country. Giving you nearby details on:
* Robberies
* Thefts
* Arsons
* Shootings
* Arrests
* Burglaries
* Assaults
* Vandalisms
By pinpointing your location through the GPS on your phone, SpotCrime accesses its current database to provide you with current events and breaking crime stories around you.
Get crime in your zip code right down to your neighborhood and street block.
We are committed to help inform the public and increase everyone’s safety.
Spot crime with SpotCrime, and get out of the crime spot. Don’t let anyone take your mojo.
Crime data is provided by police departments, sheriff agencies, news media. In some cases, data is provided through 911 CAD (dispatch services) and information may be updated at a later time.
This is a great tool for neighborhood watch organizations. If you don’t see crime data on the map, ask your local police department to be transparent with their crime data and SpotCrime will map it for free. No charge to the police department, no charge to you, and free email alerts!
We are not providing sex offender information at this time.

This game offers a playground of possibilities that allows the players to experiment, manipulate and h
bluejetty:00072695:ios.description:
Players are invited to unleash their creativity and explore the fascinating world of ragdoll physics in the Ragdolls Fun Playground Games
This game offers a playground of possibilities that allows the players to experiment, manipulate and have endless fun with ragdoll characters. The characters in these games are governed by the laws of physics, which adds a layer of realism and dynamism to the overall experience. Players must carefully manipulate the character's limbs and body to maintain balance, traverse obstacles and interact with the game world. This stickman ragdoll game delivers an experience that combines the thrill of different challenging levels, upgradeable skills and competitive elements. This physics based simulation is the satisfaction of saving helpless ragdolls from various challenging modes.
An adrenaline pumping ragdoll playground game challenges the players to face an environment where they will find many oncoming cars with high speed to crash the ragdoll. These destructive cars are coming towards ragdoll so you should try to rescue the helpless ragdoll from this situation to save his precious life. Players need to demonstrate quick reflexes, precise timing and adapt rescue strategies to save sandbox from the collision of cars. The shattered mirror glasses also introduce an element of danger as ragdoll has to survive from giant glass bridge. The broken mirror glasses add an extra layer of complexity and unpredictability to the gameplay. As the ragdoll character moves, jumps and interacts with the environment the broken mirror glasses create fragmented and distorted reflections. Players need to be strategic in their movements and try their best not to jump on broken glass otherwise they will fall down. The pyramid challenge consists of a large pyramid structure made up of platforms, ramps and obstacles. The goal is to reach the destination point facing different levels or tiers, each with its own set of obstacles and difficulties. These obstacles can include moving platforms, rotating pillars, swinging pendulums, collapsing floors, spikes and more.

Penny Dell Logic Puzzles to keep your brain active. These classic magazine puzzles are for the true logic problem fanatic and tend to be harder than others. Try the first ten puzzles for free with no ads, no nags and full functionality. 720 more puzzles are available for purchase in groups of thirty, for hours of puzzling fun!

"Easy to use. I enjoy these more than the books."

"I've always loved Dell's logic problems and this app is just like the classics."

"I found it to be incredibly intuitive and user friendly. Def worth 5 stars!!!"

"Always enjoyed the puzzle books before...But this app is great...Very challenging and fun to solve."

Quality software by Egghead Games. Contact us with questions at support@eggheadgames.com.

The best weather app in the Tennessee Valley gets even better!
You spoke, and we've listened. Local 3 knows that weather plays an important role in your life. It determines the route you take to work, how you make plans for the weekend and if the kids will have soccer practice. 
We've worked closely with our app development team to re-vamp the Local 3 Weather app. 
Current conditions, with information generated by the Local 3 Storm Alert Team, gives you a quick glimpse into what's going on outside right now. By scrolling down you can find conditions for the week ahead, our Live Stream, School Closings and new Traffic/Road Conditions.
The new, high-resolution radar now has Storm Tracks, so you can tell if the storm is headed your way, and what areas around you may be affected.
Be sure to turn on Alerts and enable Locations to be warned of dangerous weather in your locations. You'll be notified by our team of meteorologists and be prepared.

Do you feel tired to the bone? Do you miss a good sleep? It’s time to lose control over your body like a ragdoll and flip-flip-flip to your bed! 
In Home Flip: Crazy Jump Master you should get ready to jump and fly through all the obstacles in your house to a bedroom. Watch out and don’t touch the floor!

Keep in mind one key rule when jumping at home – DON’T TOUCH THE FLOOR! Try not to fall to the ground and get to the bed safely!

Why you’ll love this flipping game:
- Dozens of fun levels
- Lots of jumping experience
- Addictive flipping gameplay 
- Tons of obstacles to overcome 
- Easy controls
- Bright graphics
- Ragdoll physics
Flipping at home has never been this fun before! Download Home Flip: Crazy Jump Master and let’s go playing!

bluejetty:00156977:ios.description:
What is CTLS Parent?
CTLS Parent helps CCSD schools and families stay connected and informed—all in one easy place. Whether it’s a quick message from a teacher, an important alert from the district, or a reminder about tomorrow’s field trip, CTLS Parent makes sure families never miss a thing.
Why families and teachers love CTLS Parent:
• Simple, easy-to-use app and website
• Messages are automatically translated into 190+ languages
• Best-in-class safety and security practices
• One place for all school updates, alerts, and messages
With CTLS Parent, families and staff save time and stay connected—so everyone can focus on helping students succeed.
CTLS Parent for iOS
The CLTS Parent app makes it easy for families to stay in the loop and engage with their child’s school community. With the app, parents and guardians can:
• See school news, classroom updates, and photos
• Receive important notices like attendance alerts and cafeteria balances
• Message teachers and staff directly
• Join group conversations
• Sign up for wishlist items, volunteering, and conferences
• Respond to absences or tardies
 ...and much, much more!

bluejetty:00148175:ios.summary:

ZIINA VIOLET 
Z
bluejetty:00148175:ios.description:
Ziina is the fast, secure way for individuals and businesses in the UAE to send, receive and manage money. Whether you’re growing your business or paying your share of the rent, Ziina helps you move money simply and safely.
ZIINA VIOLET 
Ziina Violet is a membership built for how you live, work and move in the UAE. Enjoy premium monthly benefits from 12 brands and services like ClassPass, SALT, Ounass and more. From workouts and coffee runs to fuel delivery and laundry, Ziina Violet gets you more from the things you already do—and pays for itself with just 1-2 benefits. Plus, enjoy monthly cashback, 0 currency fees online or abroad, priority support and your exclusive Violet Card.
ZIINA PERSONAL
Ziina makes transfers as easy as a text. Send or receive payments in seconds, whether you’re splitting dinner, paying a friend back or covering the little things that make up everyday life. Accept payments through QR codes or payment links, with support for credit cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay. Everything stays secure, organized and easy to track in your Ziina account. Keep your balance for future spending or cash out instantly.
ZIINA BUSINESS
Ziina Business is the one-stop shop for all your business needs. Get 1,000 AED in fee-free processing when you join. Plus, when you invite another business to the Ziina family, both of you can earn an extra 5,000 AED in free processing. Whether you're launching a startup or managing an established business, Ziina Business is here to help you with all the tools you need to keep your business running smoothly.
ZIINA CARD
Spend your Ziina balance directly with your digital Ziina Card. Use your funds to cover your business or personal expenses, and manage everything in one place. Add your card to your Apple or Google wallet and enjoy 0 currency fees on all non-AED spend, online and abroad. 
TAP TO PAY ON iPHONE
With Tap to Pay on iPhone and Ziina, you can accept contactless, in-person payments directly on your iPhone—no extra hardware needed. Just open the Ziina app and start accepting payments in seconds. Fast, secure and ideal for cafes, salons, fitness studios, pop-ups and mobile businesses.
SECURE PAYMENT GATEWAY
Ziina’s payment gateway integrates seamlessly with Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress and custom websites. Accept payments in up to 10 currencies, making it easy to sell locally and internationally while keeping cashflow secure and easy to manage.
PAYMENT LINKS
Create and send secure payment links on demand. Get paid by customers via Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Apple Pay or Google Pay—locally or internationally.
PAYMENT KEYBOARD
Send invoices without leaving your chats. With ZiiBoard, create and send payment requests directly inside WhatsApp, Instagram or any messaging app. No switching apps. No lost conversations.
QR STANDS AND NFC CARDS
Accept in-person payments anywhere with custom QR stands and NFC cards—simple, fast, and ready for pop-ups, markets or mobile stalls. Customers scan or tap and pay with Apple Pay, Google Pay or their card. Funds appear instantly in your Ziina account.
FAST CASH OUTS
Ziina supports all UAE banks, including RAKBANK, ADCB, Emirates NBD, Citibank UAE, HSBC and more. Transfers arrive within a few hours, at most 1-2 working days.
PRIVACY AND SECURITY
Ziina Payment LLC is licensed by the Central Bank of the UAE (License No. 1112672). Your account is protected with biometric authentication and PCI-DSS–certified technology to safeguard payment card information.
Get paid the Ziina way. Download the app today to sign up and get started in under a minute.
