bluejetty:00037628:ios.description:
微脉水印相机——原名 微商水印相机，上线于2015年，超过10年服务私域生态，用户规模过亿，完全口碑传播，无付费推广。主打朋友圈内容创作和私域团队管理，是当之无愧的私域运营领域专家，叠加AI生图能力，一站式搞定私域传播与内容创作！
2026年，推出AI+海报模板，免费体验AI生图，强化作图能力！穿越从微商到私域的周期！
核心亮点： 私域专属，销冠必备：批量水印100张、团队素材一键下发、快速发到朋友圈，提升社群运营效率。 
AI生图、做同款，智能抠图、DIY画布自由设计，轻松生成个性化海报。 
海量模板：数十万个海报/视频模板，覆盖多行业分类，素材转发随手可用。全链路编辑：画笔、马赛克、箭头、圈框、全屏水印；
视频加水印/拼接/剪辑/轮播；拼图拼视频（图片+视频混拼）。
主要功能特色：
1.批量水印：支持live实况编辑，可以一次选择最多100张图片，批量添加水印。支持在线模板，相册上传水印。支持添加文字水印、标签、贴纸、圈框画笔、突显效果、滤镜、剪裁，以及对上传的照片进行自由裁切和抠图、正片叠底、加阴影等处理！
2.海报模板+发圈28晒：不用花钱找设计师，分分钟设计出自己的海报，只需修改图片和文字，海报主题针对微商经营场景设计，支持添加图片抠图、翻转照片、支持上传视频、添加视频声音等；
3.DIY画布：自定义背景，做LOGO，做水印，可以灵活的发挥创意，做出更符合自己需求的图。
4.动效视频（在海报里-动效视频）：炫酷的动态视频制作，轻松搞定！
5.拼图拼视频：支持多种模板，图片和图片拼图，图片和视频拼图，视频和视频拼，也支持长图拼接。
6.拍照水印和视频拍摄：选择好水印模板或者上传的水印，直接拍照，直接保存带水印的照片；
7.视频加字幕：录制视频或导入视频直接加字幕；
8.视频工具箱
9.素材转发：通过创建团队，让代理、成员可以共享素材；
10.九格切图，六、四、三格切图！
11.文案卡，支持自动切换文案和样式~
12.提词器
15.表情广场
16.首页发圈素材图文。
更多功能，敬请期待~

在AppStore右上角点头像-订阅-找到微脉水印相机—取消订阅
之前已经订阅的价格是 168元每年（人民币，其他国家按汇率换算）
隐私协议:https://confssl.lingtuo.cn/ys_wmsy.html
自动续费服务协议:https://confssl.lingtuo.cn/pay_dingyue.html

bluejetty:00161868:ios.description:
The Skinny app makes it easy to manage your account – check your balance, top up, and customise your plan with Add-Ons when you’re on the go.
Do your thing better with the Skinny app:
1. Top up using a voucher, your pre-registered card, or a new card.
2. Check your balance and see if you’re running low on minutes, texts, or data.
3. Get unlimited data for up to 12 hours with Data Binge – perfect for any online bingeing sessions.
4. Manage your plan and Add-Ons ¬– check what plan you’re on and customise it with Add-Ons. You can even switch to a new plan if you want to mix it up.
There are heaps of other cool things that you can do on the app, like transferring credit to your mates, or gifting them with data or minutes. Download the app and start making the most of it.
The app is free, but just a heads up: You’ll use a little bit of data downloading it, so be savvy and hook into some Wi-Fi if you’re running low on data.
*****Handy tips for getting the app setup with your number*****
In the setup you’ll need to enter your mobile number in one of the following ways:
• You can enter your mobile number with the +64 at the front, but make sure you drop the first 0. For example +64 204 123 456
• You can enter your mobile number without the +64 at the front. In this case you keep the first 0. For example 0204 123 456

bluejetty:00123711:ios.name: Barnyard Games For Kids
bluejetty:00123711:ios.summary:
Millions of parents and teachers use RosiMosi games to educate and entertain young children.
Barnyard Games for Kids is an educational app that helps 2-5-year-old kids play and interact with barnyard & zoo animals, see how they move, and h
bluejetty:00123711:ios.description:
Millions of parents and teachers use RosiMosi games to educate and entertain young children.
Barnyard Games for Kids is an educational app that helps 2-5-year-old kids play and interact with barnyard & zoo animals, see how they move, and hear their sounds. On top of that, your child will learn about shapes & colors, numbers, ABC’s, and so much more. In Barnyard Games, learning and having fun is done in one place. 
Fun Games:
- Tap Farm: Fun animal sounds and animations at the farm, including cows, dogs, pigs, cats, and more
- Tap Zoo: More animal sounds and animations at the zoo, including elephants, bears, lions, monkeys, and more
- Tap Ocean: Interact with playful and interesting ocean life, make them swim, play, do flips, or more!
- Shapes and Colors: Learn shapes and colors with helpful voice narration
- Alphabet Bounce: Teach your kids the alphabet with colorful bouncing balls, the first step towards reading
- Farm Puzzles: Drag and drop animals to construct fun farm puzzles
- Two-Step Directions: Help your toddler learn to listen better and follow multi-step directions
- Categories: Learn to group similar objects into categories
- Balloon Burst: Great for hand-eye coordination and keeping kids entertained
- Animal Find: Help kids identify animals and their sounds
- Counting Jumble: Help with counting to 10
- What's Missing: Help your toddler pay attention and notice things that are missing
- Animal Matching: Improve memorization skills in this matching game for children
- Number Order: Go beyond counting by learning what comes before and after each number
- Fruit Slingshot: Just plain fun for toddlers and kids
- Shadow Matching: Improve your child's critical thinking by identifying a shadow and outline
- Toy Box Numbers: Helps kids learn numbers and counting while putting toys away
- Butterfly Catch: Have fun catching colorful butterflies while improving color recognition
- Color and Size Sorting: Children follow directions and identify different sizes and colors
- Alphabet and Number Bingo: Helpful voices call out numbers and letters to identify, important math and reading skills!
- Tap Music: Make music and have fun with a variety of instruments and the ability to record your song
- Can Toss: Knock down the cans with a baseball in this carnival-style game
- Light & Dark: Identify and order objects from light to dark, an important preschool skill
- Mazes: Play endless number of randomly generated mazes, and help animals get to the center
Advanced Features Include:
- Detailed Progress Reports to help track your child's development
- Lesson Builder to create specific plans for your toddler to follow and play
- Multiple User support so up to 6 kids can play on the same app
- Avatars, stickers, and backgrounds for your toddler to unlock as they learn
===================================
ALREADY PURCHASED?
If you have purchased the games already and they are now showing locked you can tap the Parents icon in the upper right corner, and then tap 'Restore Purchase' to unlock the games again for free!
PROBLEMS WITH THE GAME?
If you are having any issues with the game, please email us at help@rosimosi.com and we will get it fixed for you ASAP.
LEAVE US A REVIEW!
If you're enjoying the game then we'd love for you to leave us a review! Reviews help small developers like us keep improving this game.
===================================
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://www.rosimosi.com/privacy

bluejetty:00017364:ios.name: Vegas.com
bluejetty:00017364:ios.summary: The Vegas.com app puts the Vegas lowdown at your fingertips, and delivers a heck of a time. Its mission is to go where no app has gone before in answering the age-old Las Vegas question: “What now?” Because having the most fun in Las Vegas
bluejetty:00017364:ios.description:
The Vegas.com app puts the Vegas lowdown at your fingertips, and delivers a heck of a time. Its mission is to go where no app has gone before in answering the age-old Las Vegas question: “What now?” Because having the most fun in Las Vegas isn’t just about what you’re doing now. It’s about what you’re doing next.
This is a useful, intuitive-to you, real-time, insider-sourced, comprehensive connection to fun in Las Vegas, serving up all the information you need, the way you want it, so you can have the best time possible when you’re in Las Vegas. 
If you're not in Vegas, the app allows you to easily plan and book your upcoming Vegas vacation. And, when you're in Vegas, the app really shines.It:
• Geo-informs results so you know what’s happening near you.
• Geo-locates you in relation to target destinations. So “where’s the bathroom?” is really “where’s the nearest bathroom?”
• Allows you to wishlist all your favorite Vegas experiences.
• Presents information in both object and theme sets, so for instance, you can look up spas, bars, or magic shows as easily as you can look up Off the Beaten Path, All-Night Party, or Hangover Helpers (most likely in that order). 
• Allows you to search for your Vegas experience by date, interest, staff picks and more.
ABOUT VEGAS.COM:
Vegas.com is the only online travel agency in the world that can invite you to Las Vegas, not just tell you to go there. We live in Vegas. We work here, play here and party here, and we know this city cold. We’re your Vegas insiders. That means we can give you all the on-the-ground and behind-the-scenes intelligence you need to know what’s happening and what’s hot. Plus, we serve up the best deals on hotels, air + hotel packages, shows, tours, attractions, dining and nightlife. In a city with lots to do and lots of secrets, it pays to know someone who can help you go from having a nice, pleasant time to having the time of your life. We’re Vegas.com. We give you Vegas From the Inside™.

bluejetty:00144207:ios.name: Flashcards maker - Easy to use
bluejetty:00144207:ios.summary:
Features
- Quickly create cards with easy operation
Easy to use and made with a thorough focus on ease of use. Quickly create cards.
- Customize it to fit your needs
You can customize it to suit yourself by displaying only the cards you h
bluejetty:00144207:ios.description:
Features
- Quickly create cards with easy operation
Easy to use and made with a thorough focus on ease of use. Quickly create cards.
- Customize it to fit your needs
You can customize it to suit yourself by displaying only the cards you have difficulty with or rearranging them in any order you like. You can also search for words, copy cards, and more.
- Text-to-speech function
Text-to-speech reading of cards is supported. The cards can be read out loud, not only in English, but also in several other languages, making it ideal for listening comprehension. The cards can also be played back repeatedly, making it useful in a variety of situations, such as listening while on the move. The reading speed can also be adjusted, so if you have difficulty understanding the text, you can slow down the speed of the reading.
- Support for attaching images and sounds
Images and sounds can be attached to the card. You can launch the camera or voice recorder from within the app and quickly attach them to the card.
- Test mode
Multiple test modes make learning fun and game-like with the cards you create. You can freely set the scope of the test, for example, to test only the cards you have difficulty with.
- Edit flashcards on PC
CSV file output and import are supported. You can output a template from the application and import it to your PC to register cards at once using your PC.
- Share created flashcards with friends
The app is equipped with a function for outputting flashcards, allowing you to easily share card data.
- Study only the cards you are weak in
You can set the memorization level for each card. You can also display and test only the cards you have difficulty with.
- Speech recognition function
Easy pronunciation practice.
- Backup function
Backup files can be exported.
- Beautiful App Design
We aimed to create an app with a beautiful and sophisticated design that makes you want to touch it.

bluejetty:00096906:ios.description:
Bring your dreams to life with Vision Board—an easy, aesthetic vision board maker designed to help you stay inspired every day. Create your board in minutes using templates, manifestation quotes, and beautiful layouts made for your home screen, lock screen, and Instagram.
Vision Board makes it simple to visualize what you want: a new career, financial abundance, love, wellness, confidence, creativity, or your best year ever. Your goals become something you see every time you unlock your phone.
—
CREATE A BEAUTIFUL VISION BOARD
Start with a blank canvas or choose from dozens of curated templates. Build a modern, aesthetic board using your photos, colors, affirmations, and manifestation statements. Everything is customizable so your board matches your exact style and goals.
—
HUNDREDS OF MANIFESTATIONS
Browse a large library of curated manifestations and affirmation phrases. Add goals for abundance, love, career, health, self-growth, travel, mindset, and more. You can edit each manifestation to make it personal and aligned with your intentions.
—
WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Turn your phone into a daily reminder of who you want to become. Add your vision board to your home screen using widgets in multiple sizes and styles. Keep your goals visible throughout the day so you stay focused and motivated.
—
SET AS WALLPAPER
Your wallpaper becomes your vision board. Export perfectly sized images for your lock screen and home screen. Seeing your goals every day helps reinforce your mindset and strengthen your manifestations.
—
SHARE YOUR BOARD
Create Instagram-ready vision boards that look clean, modern, and aesthetic. Share your board as a Story or post to inspire others or document your goals for the year ahead.
—
WHY PEOPLE LOVE VISION BOARD
• Fast, simple, and intuitive
• Modern templates that look good anywhere
• A huge library of affirmations and manifestations
• Widgets and wallpapers for constant visibility
• Perfect for manifestation, goal setting, and self-growth
• Ideal for aesthetic mood boards and yearly vision boards
—
PERFECT FOR ANY GOAL
Vision Board works for anything you want to call into your life:
• Money and abundance
• Career success
• Creativity and passion projects
• Relationships and love
• Health, fitness, and wellness
• Travel dreams
• Confidence and self-growth
• Daily motivation and positive mindset
—
YOUR DREAMS, FRONT AND CENTER
A vision board is most powerful when you see it often. Vision Board keeps your goals where they matter—on your home screen, lock screen, and in widgets you view every day. Small reminders lead to big changes over time.
Start creating the life you want with Vision Board—your goals, your aesthetic, your future.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Several advanced features are available as a monthly subscription called Vision Board Pro. Vision Board Pro will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your subscription and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://moodboardapp.com/visionboard-privacy/

bluejetty:00026513:ios.name: Undawn
bluejetty:00026513:ios.summary: Explore, adapt, and survive in Undawn, a free-to-play open-world survival RPG for mobile and PC developed by LightSpeed Studios and published by Level Infinite. Embark on an adventure with other survivors four years after a worldwide disast
bluejetty:00026513:ios.description:
Explore, adapt, and survive in Undawn, a free-to-play open-world survival RPG for mobile and PC developed by LightSpeed Studios and published by Level Infinite. Embark on an adventure with other survivors four years after a worldwide disaster where hordes of infected roam a shattered world. Undawn combines PvP and PvE modes as players fend off dual threats of the infected and other humans as they fight to survive in this apocalyptic wasteland.
SURVIVE YOUR WAY
Become the ultimate endurance expert. Protect your home, allies, and what's left of humanity against overwhelming odds. The seamless open world of Undawn is filled with realistic details, made using Unreal Engine 4. In this world, players must brave rain, heat, snow, and storms and track their character’s survival indicators such as Hunger, Body Type, Vigor, Health, Hydration, and even Mood. Changes in the environment will also affect these survival indicators in real time. Players can customize their character’s appearance and outfits, interact with other players to trade weapons and resources, and fight to protect their resources.
EXPLORE AN EXPANSIVE OPEN WORLD
Dare to explore a huge seamless map filled with distinct terrains such as plains, mines, deserts, swamps, and abandoned cities, each with diverse ecosystems filled with animals, plants, and weather systems. While exploring the remains of society, players can discover special game modes through interactive environmental items, embattled strongholds, and dynamic weekly events and side quests. Players must bravely explore the continent, learning to craft tools, master different weapons, build a shelter, search for survival buddies, and do everything they can to stay alive. The infected can appear anytime as you are exploring and are a huge threat to your continued existence!
REBUILD THE RUINS
Rebuild a new home and a new civilization with the wisdom of humanity – build your base of operations to your specifications and survive on your own or with your friends inside a massive 1-acre manor. The robust free building system allows more than 1,000 types and styles of furniture and structures, as well as ways to grow your settlement over time. Search for other outposts to form alliances and fight back against the infected together to keep your home safe.
SQUAD UP TO SURVIVE
Set yourself up for success as a member of the storied Raven Squad. The raven is traditionally a symbol of death and bad omens but can also stand for prophecy and insight. Your squad lives between these two meanings each day and night. In the new world, four years after the disaster, survivors have split into different factions, each with their own rules of survival. Face off against members of the Clowns, Eagles, Night Owls, and Reivers for territory, and get through some darkest nights for the next sunrise.
ARM YOURSELF FOR THE APOCALYPSE
Protect your home, allies, and what's left of humanity against all odds with a wide variety of weapons and armor for you and your homebase. Beyond the standard weapons, players can also use other tactical gear including melee weapons, drones, decoy bombs, auto turrets and more to level the playing field. Choose from more than 50 types of vehicles for quick supply runs and to conquer new lands, while utilizing tailored-to-environment tactics to dominate the various infected zones found throughout the game.
PLAY YOUR WAY
Expand your world and define your way of survival in the world of Undawn. Discover how you can make the best out of the apocalypse with a variety of game modes and activities to engage in as you rebuild your life. Whether you choose to get competitive in a Grand Prix race, hop into a futuristic mech to bring into battle, or even compose and play your own music in Band mode, the choice is yours to make.
Please read Undawn's Privacy Policy and User Agreement
Privacy Policy: https://www.undawn.game/privacypolicy.html
User Agreement: https://www.undawn.game/terms.html

bluejetty:00114661:ios.description:
66 Days Prep is an AI-powered career preparation platform designed to help candidates master interviews for banking and consulting roles through structured, daily progress.
The app combines personalized coaching, habit tracking, and analytics to transform your preparation into a consistent 66-day journey. Each day you’ll train across behavioral, technical, cases or market-based questions while receiving instant feedback from an AI coach.
The goal is simple — make interview mastery a daily habit. Your progress is visualized through a 66-day heat map that tracks consistency, focus, and improvement. Every session compounds your learning so that when interview season arrives, you’re confident, sharp, and ready to perform.
Key features:
• AI interview coach for personalized feedback on real questions
• Daily drills in behavioral, technical, cases, and market news
• 66-day heat map that tracks performance and consistency
• Resume checker to strengthen clarity and impact
• Excel and valuation tools for technical accuracy
• Productivity features including timers and streak reminders
• Analytics dashboard that highlights your growth over time
Built by former bankers and consultants, 66 Days Prep mirrors real recruiting standards at leading firms such as Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, McKinsey, and Bain. The app ensures that every minute spent practicing is focused on what matters most — structured thinking, confident delivery, and business intuition.
Whether you are recruiting for your first internship, preparing for post-graduate consulting interviews, or advancing your career in finance, 66 Days Prep provides a disciplined path to daily improvement.
Consistency is what separates good candidates from great ones. 66 Days Prep helps you build that consistency through smart repetition, clear feedback, and visible progress you can track.
Build momentum, develop confidence, and master your interviews with 66 Days Prep — your AI career partner for banking and consulting success.
Some features, including the AI interview coach, require a subscription.
Please review our Privacy Policy at https://www.66daysprep.com/privacy.

apple-itunes:386426585.name: Flashlight & Morse Utility
apple-itunes:386426585.description:
-Light, Morse and Strobe
-Brightness Adjustment
-Screen Lock
Super fast start of the flashlight!!! 
This is the best torchlight App using the Flash Light of any iOS Device and it also supports iPhone 3G 3Gs and iPod touch using HQ graphics and animation.
We have a very fast starting of the App. Doesn't even take a second to start up the App. Once it is started you are ready to bring light in the dark.
There are 3 different modes.
The torch mode, which is the startup mode where you can switch your app on and off.
The morse mode lets you morse signals, also very fast performance of
this mode.
And we have a strobe mode where you can change the frequency.
The frequency is also showed in an indicator.
You can also morse any text you want, in case of world end scenario.
Furthermore we integrated some sounds and animations, that give you the feeling of real torch.
Never be scared in the dark again.
Please note that the usage of the flash light can clearly shorten your battery power.

apple-itunes:1119363456.name: So Social: Become an Internet Celebrity
apple-itunes:1119363456.description:
Have you got what it takes to rock social media? Put your social media prowess to test in this new game that will turn you into the web’s newest sensation!
So Social allows you to become a social media star! The best way to climb up the ladder to fame is by joining Friendbook and posting a selfie. When you least expect, you’ll be gathering thousands of likes and followers all around the world!
GIFS & HASHTAGS
However, internet fame is not just an avalanche of selfies! The internet people also love gifs, especially funny ones! Gather more followers and likes using famous hashtags - it’s the language of all the cool kids out there!
QUOTES & KITTENS
What’s a social media legend without the ability to inspire others? Post a motivational quote! Or, as any self respecting social media expert would know, how about posting a kitty video? The internet is craaaazy about kittens! 
AND, OF COURSE, MEMES
Put your influencing skills on display by making a live commentary about something that’s trending! Now, THAT is trendy! And finally, make it to the pantheon of social media by creating a meme and become a true legend! 
The fun doesn't stop at Friendbook though! Gather likes and followers enough to unlock other medias - such as Chiper and Lategram! Also, do not forget that a true star never forgets its fans! Make sure to read your posts comments and reap the rewards for being so friendly and down to earth!
HIGHLIGHTS
• PICK your avatar from different profiles
• GATHER followers and RECEIVE countless likes! Make the Internet LOVE you!
• BECOME a social media legend! Work it hard like it’s your profession!
• CHOOSE from a DOZEN types of posts!
• UNLOCK other social medias! 
Download So Social now and enjoy the stardom! 
Disclaimer: While this App is completely free to play, some additional content can be purchased for real money in-game. If you do not want to use this feature, please turn off in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Like our page on Facebook and be the first to know about our upcoming games and updates! http://fb.com/tappshq

apple-macos:6779159104.name: WBTRK - Music Studio
apple-macos:6779159104.description:
WBTRK is a complete music studio in your pocket: a fast tracker grid, 21 sound engines, a library of over 450 ready-made sounds, drum kits, a sampler, per-note effects, a twelve-channel mixer, a live performance mode, plug-in hosting and MIDI. One purchase for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
WRITE
 • PHRASES of 16/32/64 steps hold notes, chords, instrument, velocity and effects; they stack into CHAINS, and chains arrange into a twelve-channel SONG
 • Hold a cell and slide to set a note or a value — it plays as you go
 • Select, copy and paste cell by cell, transpose whole sections, and end a note exactly where you want with OFF
 • Every channel loops on its own and can run at its own tempo, locked to one clock
 • A hardware keyboard on iPad and Mac, a MIDI keyboard, or any Bluetooth game controller drives the whole tracker
SOUND
 • Over 450 ready-made sounds sorted by what they are — drums, bass, keys, bells, plucked, strings, winds, voice, leads, pads, fx — each one a tap away from playing, all balanced to the same loudness. Save your own for any engine
 • DRUM KIT: ten drum slots in one instrument — eight built-in kits, or build your own from any sound or sample
 • Classic synths: pulse, saw, triangle, FM, noise, supersaw pad, sub, pluck, wavetable and the dual-oscillator MODX, plus DRUM, an analog drum voice
 • WOVEN, a macro-oscillator with 24 models and 96 classic DX7 patches; ROUND, a resonator for strings, bars and bells; MODAL for struck percussion
 • SAMPLER: record or import, chop at transients, stretch to the tempo, loop, reverse, round-robin 
 • SPEECH sings your lyrics in English and Japanese; GRAIN turns any recording into clouds; DRONE, RESONATOR and TEXTURE build ambient beds
 • AUv3 hosting: play your instrument plug-ins and insert effect plug-ins on any channel
SHAPE
 • 32 effects on any note: delays, reverbs up to thirty seconds, tempo-synced gate and autopan, retrigger, chorus, flanger, ring mod, wavefold, bitcrush, slides, vibrato, arps, FOGGY granular clouds and more
 • AUT automation morphs an instrument and its effect across the rows
 • RANDOM dice, tables for instant arpeggios, a groove editor per instrument, scale lock
 • A twelve-channel mixer with volume, pan, mute, solo and plug-in inserts
PERFORM
 • LIVE MODE: launch phrases from six scenes on pads, quantized to the beat or the bar, and punch in delay and filters — or latch them 
CONNECT
 • MIDI in with step and live recording, MIDI out to hardware, MIDI clock and Ableton Link
KEEP 
 • Render to WAV (16 or 24 bit), stems and MIDI; share songs as files; your session autosaves
 • A lock-screen player with cover art in your theme
 • 28 themes — the studio look comes in dark and light and can follow your device — a theme editor, seven typefaces, hex numbers if you like
 • English and Japanese, and a demo song to start from
 Everything runs on your device. No account, no ads, no subscription, nothing collected.

apple-macos:6754842059.name: Enhance Photo Quality by Pixer
apple-macos:6754842059.description:
Bring blurry portraits, faded family archives, and low-resolution snapshots back into focus inside a tactile editorial darkroom—100% on your iPhone.
Pixer is an on-device AI photo and portrait restoration studio built for iOS 18. Unlike cloud enhancers that upload your private memories to remote servers and lock exports behind weekly paywalls, Pixer executes every neural pass locally on your iPhone's Apple Neural Engine—completely free.
100% ON-DEVICE PRIVACY
• Zero Cloud Uploads: Your photos never leave your device. No external servers, no account sign-ups, and no data tracking.
• Apple Neural Engine Acceleration: Hardware-accelerated CoreML pipelines deliver studio-grade restoration while protecting your privacy.
DUAL ON-DEVICE AI RESTORATION ENGINES
• Quick AI (Built-In): Bundled inside the app for instant, zero-wait sharpening, defogging, and detail recovery anytime—even completely offline.
• Studio Photo AI & Face Care AI (Up to 12 MP): Downloadable precision neural models that reconstruct fine skin texture, irises, eyelashes, hair strands, fabric weave, and natural edges up to 12 megapixels without plastic over-smoothing.
• Smart Face Detection: Automatically detects faces in portraits and group photos to activate dedicated facial reconstruction where it matters most.
TACTILE EDITORIAL DARKROOM
• 4x3 Tile-Matrix Live Developing Ritual: Watch your image develop tile by tile on the neural canvas with subtle haptic feedback.
• Vernier Tactile Optical Dial: Scrub the interactive Before/After split line across your photo with physical precision.
• 2.5x Split Optical Darkroom Loupe: Hold and drag anywhere on your image to inspect true pixel-level Before & After restoration under a coated 2.5x optical magnifier lens.
• 4 Signature Darkroom Print Finishes: Apply instant 0ms GPU optical stocks after restoration—Pure Optical (neutral master), Warm Silver (classic darkroom paper), Portrait Velvet (soft editorial contrast), or 35mm Grain (authentic analog silver halide texture).
60FPS STORY REVEAL VIDEO & EDITORIAL DIPTYCH
• 60fps Split-Reveal Story Video: Generate a smooth 2.4-second 60fps before-and-after curtain sweep video ready for Instagram Stories, Reels, TikTok, or Messages.
• Editorial Diptych Card: Create a museum-style side-by-side Before & After print for effortless sharing.
100% FREE — ZERO SUBSCRIPTIONS
• Unlimited Quick AI enhancements anytime.
• 3 Free Daily Studio AI Credits refreshed automatically every day.
• Need more Studio passes? Watch a single short optional ad anytime to unlock an additional Studio AI restoration—no subscriptions, no credit cards, and no watermarks on your saved photos.
